article.articleHeadline: Masyarakat diminta waspadai penularan campak saat silaturahmi Lebaran
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The public is urged to be vigilant about measles transmission during Eid al-Fitr gatherings.
article.articleSummary: As of 11 March 2026, Jakarta’s Health Department head Ani Ruspitawati urged vigilance for measles during Eid al-Fitr gatherings, advising people not to touch or kiss babies and young children whose immunity is most vulnerable. Although no measles cases have been confirmed in Jakarta, outbreaks have been reported in areas surrounding the capital. Pediatric specialist Dr. Arifianto of Pasar Rebo Regional General Hospital notes that measles persists due to incomplete immunization, with nearly weekly cases requiring ventilators or intensive care for children. He emphasizes vaccination as the key prevention, reminding parents to complete the measles-rubella immunization schedule: three doses at 9 months, 18 months, and 6–7 years. The public health message accompanies Lebaran preparations, highlighting the risk of transmission and the importance of immunization to strengthen children's defenses.

triage.triage_reason: 麻疹（はしか）のアウトブレイクがジャカルタ周辺地域で報告されており、ほぼ毎週小児症例が発生し集中治療を要する状況。不完全な予防接種率と宗教行事による接触増加のリスクがあり、IHR基準2つ以上（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク）およびWPRO基準複数項目に該当するため、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ジャカルタ首都圏では未確認だが周辺地域でアウトブレイク発生中。小児専門医によれば人工呼吸器・ICU管理を要する重症例がほぼ毎週発生。予防接種完遂率の低さが持続的流行の要因。イスラム教の祝祭イード・アル・フィトルでの家族訪問による接触増加が懸念され、保健当局が公式に警戒を呼びかけている。麻疹は空気感染し感染力が極めて高く、ワクチン未接種集団では国際的拡大リスクあり。インドネシアは人口大国で国際渡航も多い。

article.articleHeadline: 美國生蠔、蛤蜊驗出諾羅病毒 FDA 宣布大規模召回 | yam News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. raw oysters and clams tested positive for Norovirus; FDA announced a large-scale recall | yam News
article.articleSummary: FDA announced recalls of raw Manila clams harvested by Lummi Indian Business Council and raw oysters from Drayton Harbor Oyster Company due to suspected norovirus contamination. Manila clams were distributed to restaurants and retailers across nine states—Arizona, California, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Nevada, New York, Oregon, and Washington—with potential additional distribution elsewhere. Oysters were distributed only within Washington state, harvested February 13–March 3. Restaurants and retailers are urged to stop selling and discard affected shellfish, disposing of products or coordinating disposal through distributors. Norovirus infection presents with diarrhea, vomiting, nausea, stomach cramps, fever, headache, and body aches; onset commonly 12–48 hours after exposure, lasting 1–3 days. All ages can be affected; immunocompromised individuals may develop severe disease. FDA awaits more information on distribution and will monitor the investigation progress.

triage.triage_reason: 米国とフィリピン産の貝類からノロウイルスが検出され、FDAが大規模リコールを実施。米国9州に流通し、レストランや小売店に影響。ただし、現時点で実際の患者数や重症例の報告が記事に明記されていないため、公衆衛生への影響の深刻さが不明。続報による患者発生状況の確認が必要。
triage.notes: FDAによる大規模リコールという政府の対応があり、米国9州とフィリピンに跨る国際的な食品安全事案。ノロウイルス汚染貝類は2月13日〜3月3日に収穫され、レストランや小売店に既に流通済み。しかし記事には実際の患者発生数、入院・死亡例などの疫学情報が含まれていないため、公衆衛生上の深刻度を評価できない。ノロウイルスは一般的に自然治癒するが、免疫不全者では重症化の可能性あり。続報で患者発生状況を確認すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Malaria mosquito from Asia spreading to Africa
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-03-11, scientists report the invasive Anopheles stephensi malaria mosquito—originating in Asia—has spread to Africa, threatening urban populations where city-dwellers live. In Africa, the majority of global malaria deaths occur, but transmission is typically by a rural-adapted mosquito. An. stephensi, responsible for many urban cases in Indian and Iranian cities, breeds in urban water supplies and is resistant to most commonly used insecticides, hindering control efforts. The mosquito has already contributed to rising malaria cases in Djibouti and Ethiopia, complicating eradication. If the species spreads widely across the continent, researchers warn nearly 130 million people could be placed at risk. The shift to an urban-vector–driven malaria dynamic underscores the need for intensified urban surveillance and vector-control strategies.

triage.triage_reason: アジア原産の都市型マラリア媒介蚊のアフリカ大陸への侵入・拡大は、IHR基準で異常性と国際拡大リスクを満たし、WPRO基準でも複数該当。最大1.3億人がリスクに晒される可能性があり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が懸念される。
triage.notes: アジア原産Anopheles stephensiのアフリカ侵入は生態学的に異常で予想外。都市部での伝播特性、既存殺虫剤への抵抗性、ジブチ・エチオピアでの患者増加実績から重症度・流行可能性が高い。都市住民の長期曝露リスクあり。制御困難性から国際支援必要性が示唆される。ただし記事時点での具体的患者数・死亡数データや各国政府の対応状況は不明。都市型マラリア伝播への転換は従来の制御戦略の再構築を要する重要シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Masyarakat diminta waspadai penularan campak saat silaturahmi Lebaran - ANTARA News Kalimantan Barat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The public is urged to beware of measles transmission during Eid al-Fitr family gatherings - ANTARA News West Kalimantan
article.articleSummary: Measles transmission risk highlighted ahead of Eid al-Fitr family gatherings in Jakarta. DKI Jakarta Health Agency head Ani Ruspitawati urged the public to be vigilant and to avoid touching or kissing babies and young children, whose immune systems remain vulnerable. While Jakarta has not yet reported measles cases, authorities say the illness has been detected in areas surrounding the capital, necessitating heightened caution during the holiday period. Pediatric expert Dr. Arifianto, Sp.A, Subsp.Neuro(K) of RSUD Pasar Rebo notes measles remains a threat due to incomplete immunization, with several children admitted to ICUs or on ventilators for measles-related complications. He stresses vaccination, and recalls the three-dose measles-rubella schedule: first at 9 months, a booster at 18 months, and a second booster at 6–7 years.

triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・ジャカルタ周辺で麻疹の流行懸念があり、重症例も発生しているが、ジャカルタ市内では未報告。レバラン（断食明け祭）期間中の集団接触による拡大リスクが指摘されている。情報不足のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: ジャカルタ保健当局が断食明け祭期間中の麻疹・風疹感染拡大を警告。周辺地域で症例確認、ICU入院・人工呼吸器使用例あり。ワクチン接種不完全が要因。首都での症例数・死亡数が不明なため、続報による状況把握が必要。季節的宗教行事による人口移動が感染拡大を加速させる可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: ABC registra 348 casos suspeitos de dengue e dois óbitos em investigação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ABC reports 348 suspected Dengue cases and two deaths under investigation.
article.articleSummary: Dengue in the ABC region shows 348 suspected cases and two deaths under investigation in 2026, per the Ministry of Health. Diadema leads with 123 suspected; Santo André 69; São Bernardo do Campo 66 with one death under investigation; Mauá 34; Ribeirão Pires 24; Rio Grande da Serra 21; São Caetano do Sul 11. Nationally, Brazil reports 130,293 suspected dengue cases, 127 deaths under investigation and 28 confirmed. In São Paulo state, 28,026 suspected cases, 51 deaths under investigation and 3 confirmed. Dengue is transmitted by Aedes aegypti and follows a seasonal rise from October to May in Brazil. Urbanization, inadequate sanitation, and standing water promote vector breeding. Symptoms include high fever, headache, retro-orbital pain, nausea, fatigue, joint pains, and a red rash; severe forms may involve intense abdominal pain, vomiting, dizziness, breathing difficulty, and bleeding. Regional control: Diadema conducted two mutirões for home/business inspections; Rio Grande da Serra performs daily ADL; Ribeirão Pires installed over 900 traps; São Caetano conducts visits, ADL, and nebulization in affected areas.

triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのデング熱流行は季節的に予想される範囲内だが、全国で130,293疑い例・調査中死亡127例と規模が大きく、ABC地域で2名の死亡調査中。既存の流行パターンに沿うため異常性は低いが、規模と重症度から経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジルは10月〜5月に季節的デング熱流行を経験する風土病地域。2026年3月時点で全国13万例超の疑い例は規模として大きいが、記事からは過去データとの比較情報なし。ABC地域の348疑い例・2死亡調査中は地域レベルでの懸念だが、国レベルでは複数の自治体が積極的な媒介蚊対策（家庭訪問、トラップ設置、薬剤散布）を実施中。死亡例が調査中段階であり確定情報待ち。国際的拡大リスクや異常性の明確な証拠はないため、続報（死亡確定数、血清型情報、過去比較データ）を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Santo André registra 1º óbito no Estado em 2026 por leptospirose - Diário do Grande ABC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Santo André records 1st death in the state in 2026 due to leptospirosis - Diário do Grande ABC.
article.articleSummary: Santo André records the leptospirosis death in São Paulo state in 2026 as rains raise transmission risk. The Grande ABC region has two confirmed cases and one death this year, according to the GVE (Group of Epidemiological Surveillance). The victim was a 54-year-old homeless man treated at Centro Hospitalar Municipal. São Bernardo do Campo has cases; the state total reached 35 diagnoses as of March 5, 2026. In 2025, the region had 14 cases and 3 deaths; in 2024, 25 cases and 6 deaths. São Bernardo leads regional cases with 5; Rio Grande da Serra has 3; Diadema and Mauá have 2 each; São Caetano and Mauá have 1 each. Leptospirosis is caused by Leptospira bacteria and transmitted via contact with urine from infected animals or water contaminated by flood-related runoff. Severe disease can cause kidney failure, jaundice, and pulmonary hemorrhage. Prevention emphasizes drainage, rodent control, desratization, and drainage maintenance.

triage.triage_reason: 地域でのレプトスピラ症死亡例が報告されているが、散発的な発生パターンであり、例年の発生数と比較して異常な増加は認められない。雨季による感染リスク上昇は予測可能な範囲内。ただし州内初の死亡例であり続報の注視が必要。
triage.notes: 2026年3月時点でサンパウロ州全体で35例、Grande ABC地域で2例確認・1死亡。2025年は同地域で14例・3死亡、2024年は25例・6死亡と、むしろ減少傾向。レプトスピラ症は洪水・雨季に関連する環境性疾患であり、ホームレスなどハイリスク集団での散発例は予測範囲内。現時点で異常な集積や新規の伝播パターンは示唆されていない。地域サーベイランスシステムが機能しており国際支援は不要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue: Fortaleza registra redução de 84% nos casos em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue: Fortaleza records an 84% reduction in cases in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Fortaleza records an 84% reduction in dengue cases in 2026, with about a 70% drop versus the same period last year, according to Francisco Sousa Pires of Caucaia's Environmental Surveillance. The operation targets the Caucaia–Fortaleza border, a high-traffic zone, planning to inspect ~8,000 properties and coordinate with Eusébio and Itaitinga. Strategies combine arbovirus control and other vectorborne diseases like leptospirosis and visceral leishmaniasis. Primary measures include adult mosquito spraying and larviciding via fumigation vehicles; emphasis on eliminating breeding sites at strategic points such as junkyards and recyclers. Weather irregularity—choppy rainfall with hot, humid conditions—favors breeding, prompting household inspections to remove standing water; if water storage is needed, use closed containers for up to three days. Residents are encouraged to participate as volunteers; all agents wear uniforms and credentials to enter homes.

triage.triage_reason: 2026年のデング熱症例数が84%減少したという好転的な状況報告であり、疾患制御が成功している事例。異常・予想外の事態ではなく、公衆衛生上の懸念は低い。
triage.notes: 本報告は疾患アウトブレイクではなく、ブラジル・フォルタレザ市におけるデング熱制御の成功事例（84%減少）を伝えるもの。レプトスピラ症・内臓リーシュマニア症への言及は包括的ベクター対策の文脈。気象条件（不規則な降雨、高温多湿）によるリスクは継続するものの、現時点での公衆衛生上の脅威は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Hari Ketiga Banjir di Periuk Tangerang, Warga Terserang Penyakit
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Day Three of Flooding in Periuk, Tangerang, Residents Struck by Illness
article.articleSummary: Day three of flooding in Perumahan Periuk Damai, Periuk District, Tangerang City, Indonesia (as of March 11, 2026) with floodwaters still inundating the area. Persistent inundation has halted normal activities as residents guard belongings, monitor homes, and anticipate rising water levels. Health impacts include fatigue, sleep deprivation, and mild illnesses linked to prolonged flood conditions. Extended floodwater increases the risk of skin infections and fever among affected residents. People hope the floods recede soon so daily life and health conditions do not worsen. No case counts or laboratory-confirmed infections are reported in the piece. Hashtags note local coverage: #Banjir, #PeriukTangerang, and related terms.

triage.triage_reason: 洪水関連の健康被害が報告されているが、具体的な症例数・病原体・重症度が不明。環境災害に伴う二次的健康影響として経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 洪水3日目で疲労・睡眠不足・軽度の疾患が報告されているが、検査確定例なし。皮膚感染症や発熱リスクの言及あり。疾患が「Unknown Illness」と分類されており、具体的な病原体・症例数・重症度の情報が欠如。洪水に伴う一般的な健康影響の可能性が高いが、続報で感染症アウトブレイクに発展する可能性を排除できない。地域限定的で国際拡散リスクは現時点で低い。

article.articleHeadline: Mariela Gallinger: "Entre Ríos trabaja y se capacita para que el virus no llegue a la provincia"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mariela Gallinger: "Entre Ríos works and trains to prevent the virus from reaching the province."
article.articleSummary: As of March 11, 2026, four avian influenza cases have been confirmed in Argentina, with detections in Bolívar (Buenos Aires), Lobos, Ranchos (Buenos Aires Province), and a laying-hen farm in Alejo Ledesma, Córdoba. SENASA says domestic poultry production and consumption are not affected, and avian influenza is not transmitted to humans via chicken meat or eggs. The outbreak jeopardizes exports, delaying Argentina’s return to its status as a country free of avian influenza. After Ranchos, Argentina temporarily lost that status and suspended exports to several destinations under related agreements. The main product affected is fresh poultry meat, restricted in about 40 markets including China, though shipments continue to more than 35 countries recognizing regionalization. 2025 exports: 169,000 t worth USD 218 million. Containment includes interdiction of the establishment; a 3 km perifocal zone with movement restrictions; a 7 km surveillance area; notification to the World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH).

triage.triage_reason: アルゼンチンにおける鳥インフルエンザの家禽への影響であり、ヒト感染例の報告はない。輸出への経済的影響はあるが、現時点では公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念は限定的。ヒト感染リスクに関する情報が不足しているため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 家禽における鳥インフルエンザ（H5N1等の亜型は記載なし）の発生で、ヒト感染例はなし。SENASAは鶏肉・卵を通じたヒトへの感染はないと明言。封じ込め措置（発生施設の隔離、3km制限区域、7km監視区域）が実施されており、輸出への影響が主要な懸念事項。ヒト感染リスクや病原体の詳細情報が不足しているため、続報でヒト感染事例の有無や亜型情報を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Waspada Penularan Campak saat Silaturahmi Lebaran
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beware Measles Transmission During Eid al-Fitr Gatherings.
article.articleSummary: As of March 11, 2026, Jakarta health officials caution about measles during Eid al-Fitr gatherings. No measles cases have been reported in Jakarta, but the disease has been detected in areas surrounding the capital, prompting heightened vigilance ahead of the holiday. Jakarta's Health Office chief Ani Ruspitawati advises limiting close contact with children, especially infants and toddlers, and avoiding holding or kissing them to reduce transmission risk. Pediatricians at RSUD Pasar Rebo note measles remains common due to incomplete immunization, with nearly every week a child requiring intensive care for complications, some needing ventilators in the Pediatric Intensive Care Unit (PICU). Experts emphasize vaccination as the key preventive measure; ensuring complete immunization strengthens a child’s antibodies and helps the immune system recognize and fight measles and other pathogens.

triage.triage_reason: ジャカルタでは麻疹症例の報告はないが周辺地域で検出されており、イード休暇中の集団感染リスクと不完全な予防接種による重症例の発生が懸念される。現時点では予防的警告段階だが、休暇後の発生動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 現時点ではジャカルタ市内での症例報告はなく予防的警告段階。ただし、①周辺地域での検出、②イード休暇中の人の移動・集団接触、③不完全な予防接種状況（ほぼ毎週ICU入院例あり）、④乳幼児への感染リスクという複数の懸念要因が存在。WPROスクリーニング基準では重症度・長期曝露・流行しやすさで該当するが、実際の症例報告がないため「WATCH」と判定。イード休暇後（3月中旬以降）の発生動向、特にジャカルタ市内での症例報告の有無を継続監視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes Tegaskan Vaksin MR Aman, Stok Jutaan Dosis Disiapkan Hadapi Lonjakan Campak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health Reaffirms Measles-Rubella (MR) Vaccine Is Safe, Stock of Millions of Doses Prepared to Face a Measles Surge
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's Ministry of Health reaffirmed that the measles-rubella (MR) vaccine stock is sufficient to support intensified immunization as measles cases rise in several regions. Rizka Andalusia, Director General of Pharmacy and Medical Devices, said vaccine supply is a key factor alongside surveillance and early detection in controlling the outbreak, with plans to accelerate Outbreak Response Immunization (ORI) in high-case areas. As of 6 March 2026, central stock stands at about 9.5 million doses, while roughly 6.6 million doses have been distributed to provinces, districts/cities, and health facilities. All provinces currently report vaccine stockpiles above two months. The government will continue central-to-regional distribution, focusing on areas with declining stock. The measures accompany ongoing surveillance to respond to the measles surge across Indonesia.

triage.triage_reason: インドネシア政府による麻疹増加への対応措置（ワクチン備蓄確保・予防接種強化）を報じる内容。アウトブレイク対応が既に進行中だが、疫学的詳細（症例数・死亡数・地理的分布・重症度）が不明のため、フルRRAに進む前に続報で状況を確認すべき。
triage.notes: 政府が「複数地域での麻疹症例増加」を認識しORI（Outbreak Response Immunization）を計画しているため、一定規模のアウトブレイクが進行中と推測される。しかし記事は政策対応に焦点を当てており、症例数・死亡数・年齢分布・ワクチン接種率・地理的広がりなどの疫学情報が欠如。インドネシアは人口2.7億超の国であり、麻疹は高度に感染しやすい（epidemic_prone=Yes）。国は自国でワクチン備蓄・配布を管理しており外部支援は不要（manageability=No）。続報で症例数・重症度・国際的拡大リスクを確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes DKI: Belum ada temuan kasus campak di Jakarta - ANTARA News Megapolitan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DKI Health Office: No measles cases found in Jakarta yet - ANTARA News Megapolitan
article.articleSummary: Jakarta, Indonesia: DKI Jakarta Health Office reports no confirmed measles cases in the capital as of March 10, 2026, with ongoing surveillance and laboratory confirmation for any suspected cases. Measles activity exists in surrounding areas, prompting vigilance ahead of Idul Fitri when gatherings increase, particularly protecting infants and children. In September 2025, DKI logged 218 measles cases with no deaths, including 38 cases in Kelurahan Kapuk. To curb outbreaks, the Health Office conducted mass Outbreak Response Immunization (ORI) targeting 9,000 children. By September 2025, overall measles immunization coverage reached about 77.22%. Ongoing laboratory testing and SARI surveillance at selected health facilities remain in place to detect symptomatic cases promptly.

triage.triage_reason: 現時点でジャカルタでは確定症例ゼロだが、2025年9月に218例の麻疹発生歴があり、周辺地域での活動継続中。祝祭期（Idul Fitri）前の警戒強化と継続的サーベイランスが必要な状況。
triage.notes: 2026年3月10日時点でジャカルタ首都特別州での確定症例なし。ただし2025年9月に218例（死亡なし、Kapuk地区で38例含む）の発生があり、9,000人の小児を対象とした集団ORI実施済み。麻疹予防接種率77.22%。周辺地域での活動継続とIdul Fitri期の集団集会リスクから予防的サーベイランス強化中。現時点では新規アウトブレイクではなく、過去発生への対応継続段階。情報更新があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Campak Serang Anak Belum Imunisasi, Dinkes Balangan Perketat  Program Imunisasi Campak - Banjarmasinpost.co.id
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles Strikes Unimmunized Children, Balangan Health Office Tightens Measles Immunization Program
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in Balangan Regency, South Kalimantan, Indonesia, driven by unimmunized children. Balangan Health Office reports 15 laboratory-confirmed measles cases from 24 samples, across four districts: Paringin (6), Paringin Selatan (5), Halong (2), and Batumandi (2). Total activity shows 14 cases in 2025 and 14 cases in March 2026 to date. Most patients are children without complete immunization; MR (measles-rubella) vaccination efforts are being tightened, with vaccines available at Posyandu and Puskesmas. Immunization targets nine months, continuing at 18 months, and extends to school-age children. Symptoms tracked include fever and rash; treatment focuses on symptom relief, hydration, rest, and high-dose vitamin A, with no specific antiviral. Provincial authorities urge complete immunization to reduce transmission, especially for pregnant women and infants, and maintain active surveillance with weekly reporting.

triage.triage_reason: 麻疹・風疹の地域アウトブレイクで実験室確認例15例あり。ただし国際的拡大リスクや重症度の詳細が不明確で、地域的な予防接種強化で管理可能と思われるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: インドネシア・南カリマンタン州バランガン県で麻疹アウトブレイク。24検体中15例が検査確認済み。4地区で発生（Paringin 6例、Paringin Selatan 5例、Halong 2例、Batumandi 2例）。患者の多くは未接種または不完全接種の小児。地域保健当局はMRワクチン接種強化中で、Posyandu・Puskesmasで接種可能。麻疹は高い感染力を持ち継続曝露リスクがあるが、ワクチンで予防可能な疾患であり、現時点では地域レベルで管理されている。死亡例や重症化率、国際的拡大の具体的リスクに関する情報が不足しているため、続報を注視すべき状況。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Campak di Kulonprogo Masih Minim, Dinkes Tetap Siaga - Harianjogja.com
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles Cases in Kulon Progo Remain Low; the Health Office Remains on Alert
article.articleSummary: As of 11 March 2026, Kulonprogo Regency, Indonesia, reports only one laboratory-confirmed measles case in 2026 in the Bumi Binangun area, with 36 suspected cases that year; two suspects clinically but without samples. There is no local transmission and the case is not considered a public health emergency (KLB). The Dinas Kesehatan Kulonprogo (Dinkes) says authorities will issue a local SE following a Ministry of Health circular urging heightened vigilance after increases in measles elsewhere in Indonesia. Prevention emphasized via full MR (measles-rubella) immunization and continued hygiene. Measles is highly contagious, spreading by droplets and potentially airborne; early symptoms include high fever, cough, runny nose, and a red facial rash that typically spreads to the body. Public education and complete vaccination are urged to protect children.

triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで麻疹症例が報告されているが、現時点では1例の検査確定例と36例の疑い例のみで、地域伝播なし。ただし保健省が全国的に警戒強化を指示しており、他地域での増加傾向を踏まえた経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: クロンプロゴ県では現時点で公衆衛生上の緊急事態（KLB）とは認定されていないが、保健省の通達により地方レベルでの警戒態勢が敷かれている。インドネシア国内の他地域での麻疹増加傾向が背景にあり、MRワクチン接種強化が呼びかけられている。地域伝播が確認されず、症例数も限定的であるため現段階ではWATCH判定とするが、続報で症例増加や地域伝播が確認された場合は再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Waspadai Penularan Campak saat Silaturahmi Lebaran, Dinas Kesehatan: Jangan Pegang dan Cium Anak-Anak Terutama Balita
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beware of Measles Transmission During Eid al-Fitr Gatherings, Health Department: Do Not Touch or Kiss Children, Especially Toddlers.
article.articleSummary: As of 11 March 2026, Jakarta health officials warn of measles transmission risk during Eid al-Fitr gatherings, urging the public not to touch or kiss children, especially infants and toddlers, to protect vulnerable immune systems. Although no measles cases have been confirmed in Jakarta, health chief Ani Ruspitawati notes that the disease has been detected in areas surrounding the capital, prompting heightened vigilance ahead of the holiday. Pediatrician Arifianto of RSUD Pasar Rebo adds that measles remains a threat due to incomplete immunization, and stresses vaccination as the best defense. He reiterates the measles-rubella immunization schedule, providing three doses: at 9 months, then booster shots at 18 months and again at 6–7 years. Encouraging families to complete their children's vaccines, the officials emphasize building antibodies to withstand exposure to viruses during family gatherings.

triage.triage_reason: ジャカルタでは麻疹症例は未確認だが、周辺地域で検出されており、レバラン（イスラム断食明け大祭）での大規模人口移動による感染拡大リスクがある。ワクチン接種率の情報が不明で、実際の症例数・重症度も不明確なため、続報を注視すべき。
triage.notes: 麻疹は高い感染力を持つワクチン予防可能疾患。レバラン期間中の大規模人口移動（帰省・家族訪問）は感染拡大の重要なリスク要因。ジャカルタ保健当局が予防的警告を発している点は注目すべきだが、現時点で首都内での確定症例なし。周辺地域での検出状況、ワクチン接種率、実際の症例数の続報が必要。インドネシアは麻疹風疹ワクチンキャンペーンを実施中の国であり、接種完了率のデータが評価の鍵となる。

article.articleHeadline: March 11, 2020: COVID-19 Declared A Pandemic - India's Cases, Lockdowns And Response
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 was declared a global pandemic by the WHO on March 11, 2020, signaling a rapid spread and the need for urgent public health action in India, a country with over 1.3 billion people and just over 70 confirmed cases at the time. India implemented pre-emptive measures such as thermal screening at international airports, multilingual health advisories, hand hygiene, masks, and social distancing. After the declaration, central and state authorities intensified awareness campaigns and containment efforts, culminating in Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s March 24 nationwide 21-day lockdown to curb transmission, with phased extensions and localized lockdowns as cases rose. By April 2020, India reported over 5,000 cases and 150 deaths. Vaccination began January 2021 (Covishield, Covaxin), expanding to seniors, frontline workers, boosters, and children 12–18 by mid-2022, reducing severe disease and deaths. The episode reshaped daily life and public health preparedness.

triage.triage_reason: 2020年3月のCOVID-19パンデミック宣言に関する回顧的記事であり、現在進行中の新規イベントではない。歴史的振り返りのため緊急性・リスク評価の必要性なし。
triage.notes: 配信日時は2026年3月だが、内容は2020年3月11日のWHOパンデミック宣言とその後のインドの対応を振り返る歴史的記事。現在の新規感染症イベントではなく、過去の出来事の総括であるため、リアルタイムサーベイランス対象外。すべての評価基準で「No」と判定。

article.articleHeadline: 32-fold increase in coliform bacteria: CAG flags untreated sewage discharge into Ganga in Uttarakhand
article.articleSummary: 32-fold rise in total coliform bacteria in the Ganga between Devprayag and Haridwar; a Namami Gange audit (2018–2023) flags 32% of sewage treatment plants discharging untreated sewage and widespread non-compliance with NGT norms in Uttarakhand. Water quality: Devprayag A-category; Rishikesh mostly B-category (2019–2023) with temporary A during 2020–21 COVID period; Haridwar B throughout. The increase in coliform by Oct 2023 is linked to untreated sewage. Uttarakhand Pollution Control Board lacks NABL accreditation; online effluent monitoring via Ganga Tarang Portal is inadequately used and not public. Tendering lapses and dilution of faecal coliform limits from 0 to 100 MPN/100 ml are reported. District Ganga plans were not prepared; no funds allocated for Ganga Front Town sewer projects. 21 STPs remained unconnected to households; 12 STPs discharged untreated sewage due to capacity gaps. Overall targets achieved only 34%, 9%, 6% and 14% in respective landscapes.

triage.triage_reason: 本イベントは環境汚染（ガンジス川への未処理下水排出）に関する報告であり、疾患名としてCOVID-19がタグ付けされているものの、記事内容は水質汚染と大腸菌群の増加を扱っており、直接的な感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示していない。COVID-19への言及は2020-21年のロックダウン期間中の一時的な水質改善の文脈のみで、感染症イベントとしての評価対象外と判断する。
triage.notes: 本記事は会計検査院（CAG）による環境監査報告（Namami Gangeプロジェクト）であり、感染症サーベイランスとは性質が異なる。大腸菌群の32倍増加は水質汚染指標であり、特定の感染症アウトブレイクを示すものではない。疾患タグの誤分類またはシステムエラーの可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: மலேரியா, டெங்கு காய்ச்சல் பரவும் அபாயம்: கொசு உற்பத்தியை தடுக்க அரசு எடுத்த நடவடிக்கை என்ன? - நீதிமன்றம் கேள்வி
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The danger of malaria and dengue fever spreading: What steps has the government taken to prevent mosquito breeding? - Court questions.
article.articleSummary: As of March 11, 2026, the Madras High Court questioned the Tamil Nadu government about steps taken to curb mosquito breeding across the state to prevent malaria and dengue fever spread. The case stems from a petition by Vijayraja of Kotturpuram, Chennai, who alleged a recent multi-fold rise in mosquito breeding within areas under the Chennai Municipal Corporation. The court ordered the government to respond with details of measures implemented to control mosquito breeding and address the public health risk from malaria and dengue. The proceedings highlight concerns over vector control and the need for timely, statewide action to curb mosquito populations. The article focuses on judicial scrutiny of government actions rather than reporting on confirmed outbreaks or case numbers.

triage.triage_reason: マドラス高等裁判所が政府の蚊対策を問題視し、マラリア・デング熱のリスクに対する懸念を示しているが、実際の症例数・流行状況が不明。社会的・政治的関心は高いものの、疫学的情報不足のため続報を注視すべき。
triage.notes: 本記事は実際の流行報告ではなく、裁判所による行政監督に関するもの。チェンナイ市での蚊の繁殖増加が指摘されているが、マラリア・デング熱の具体的な症例数、発生動向、重症度などの疫学情報が欠如。WPROスクリーニング基準では長期曝露・流行しやすさ・管理可能性で懸念があり、政府・司法の関心も高いが、疫学的エビデンス不足のためフルRRAに進むには情報不十分。続報で実際の症例数・流行規模が報告された場合は再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 11 मार्च : डब्ल्यूएचओ ने कोविड-19 को वैश्विक महामारी किया घोषित
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: March 11: WHO declared COVID-19 a global pandemic.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19, arising from China in late 2019, rapidly caused global disruption. By March 11, 2021, the pandemic had affected more than 110 million people worldwide. The World Health Organization declared COVID-19 a global pandemic on March 11, 2020, prompting an urgent international response. In January 2020, WHO reported a pneumonia‑like illness linked to an unknown cause but had not yet identified the pathogen. India reported its first COVID-19 case on January 31, and the same day WHO declared a health emergency. The article also presents a March 11 historical chronology, noting other events across centuries, but centers on the pandemic’s emergence and early global response.

triage.triage_reason: 2020年のCOVID-19パンデミック宣言に関する歴史的回顧記事であり、新規の感染症イベントではない。現在進行中の公衆衛生上の脅威を示す情報は含まれていない。
triage.notes: 配信日時は2026年3月11日となっているが、内容は2020年3月11日のWHOによるパンデミック宣言を振り返る歴史的記事。新規症例や現在の感染状況に関する情報は含まれておらず、過去の出来事の記念日的な報道と判断される。シグナルトリアージの対象となる新規感染症イベントには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Jelang Lebaran, Dinkes DKI Ingatkan Warga Waspada Campak, Bayi dan Balita Paling Rentan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ahead of Eid al-Fitr, the Jakarta Health Office reminds residents to be vigilant about measles; infants and toddlers are the most vulnerable.
article.articleSummary: Measles vigilance in Jakarta ahead of Eid al-Fitr (Lebaran) as Jakarta Health Office reports no confirmed measles cases among residents to date (as of 2026-03-11). Authorities intensified surveillance at health facilities using Influenza-Like Illness (ILI) and Severe Acute Respiratory Infection (SARI) monitoring to detect fever, cough, or skin rash that could indicate measles, with laboratory testing for any suspicious cases. While Jakarta remains measles-free to date, neighboring areas have reported measles detections, keeping vigilance high. The Lebaran period, marked by high mobility and family gatherings, could raise transmission risk, particularly for infants and toddlers, the most vulnerable. Health officials urge continued vigilance, rapid testing of suspected cases, and isolation when appropriate, to prevent outbreaks during the travel and holiday season.

triage.triage_reason: ジャカルタでは現時点で麻疹確定例なしだが、近隣地域で検出あり。イスラム祝祭期の人口移動増加により感染拡大リスクが懸念される予防的サーベイランス強化の段階。確定例発生や拡大の続報を注視すべき。
triage.notes: ジャカルタ保健当局が2026年3月11日時点で確定麻疹例ゼロを報告。近隣地域での検出と祝祭期（Lebaran/Eid al-Fitr）の高移動期を前に予防的サーベイランス（ILI/SARI）を強化中。乳幼児が最脆弱層として注意喚起。現時点では実際のアウトブレイクではなく予防的警戒段階のため、epidemic_proneのみ該当（麻疹の高感染性と脆弱人口の存在）。続報で確定例増加や近隣国への拡大があればPICKUPに格上げを検討。

article.articleHeadline: 研究揭开口蹄疫Asia1型疫苗高效之谜
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Research Unveils the Mystery Behind the High Efficacy of the Asia1-type Foot-and-Mouth Disease Vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD), Asia1 serotype, in China. Researchers from the Lanzhou Veterinary Research Institute, Chinese Academy of Agricultural Sciences, reported in PLOS Pathogens that, through compulsory immunization, Asia1-type outbreaks in China were eliminated by 2018. The study uncovers antigenic features of Asia1 vaccine strains: vaccination elicits protective antibodies that broadly and evenly cover multiple key epitopes on the virus capsid, rather than targeting a single site. This expanded antibody diversity enhances immune protection, explaining the Asia1 vaccine’s high efficacy at the molecular level. The findings provide a theoretical basis for designing future broad-spectrum FMD vaccines and have implications for improving vaccination strategies and outbreak prevention in affected regions. Key terms: Foot-and-mouth disease, Asia1, China, vaccine antigen structure, broad protection, PLOS Pathogens.

article.articleHeadline: Waspada! Kasus Campak di Indonesia Meningkat, Ketahui Gejala & Pencegahannya yuk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Be vigilant! Measles cases in Indonesia are rising; learn the symptoms and how to prevent them.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases rise in Indonesia: as of February 2026, there are 8,810 suspected measles cases and 12 outbreak events (KLB) confirmed across six provinces. Measles is highly contagious, with an infected person potentially transmitting the virus to up to 18 others. Incubation is about 10 days; early symptoms include fever and rash, with risk of serious complications, especially in children. Prevention centers on vaccination: measles vaccine at 9 months, followed by MMR at 12–18 months and a second MMR dose at 5–7 years. Adults without vaccination can receive two doses of measles or MMR, 28 days apart; MMR is not given to pregnant women. The Indonesian Ministry of Health (Kemenkes RI) is implementing measures to curb transmission. Public health guidance emphasizes recognizing symptoms promptly and maintaining vaccination coverage to reduce transmission.

triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで麻疹の急増が確認され、6つの州で12件のアウトブレイクが宣言されている。高い感染性（1人から最大18人への伝播）と深刻な合併症リスクがあり、国際的拡大の懸念がある。IHR基準3つ、WPROスクリーニング基準4つに該当し、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 2026年2月時点で8,810件の疑い例と12件のKLB（アウトブレイク）が6州で確認。麻疹は感染力が極めて高く（R0=18）、特に小児での重症化リスクあり。インドネシア保健省が対策を実施中。ワクチン接種状況やアウトブレイクの地理的分布の詳細は不明だが、複数州での同時発生は懸念材料。近隣国への波及リスクを考慮し、続報とワクチン接種率データの確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Bé gái 6 tuổi tử vong, nghi do bị chó dại cắn từ 3 tháng trước
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Six-year-old girl dies, suspected to have been bitten by a rabid dog three months ago.
article.articleSummary: Rabies death in a 6-year-old girl from Quảng Trị Province, Vietnam, after a dog bite suspected three months earlier. The patient, C.G.H. (born 2020) of Kim Phú Commune, presented on 9 March 2026 with vomiting, foaming at the mouth, and agitation, later developing hypersalivation, delirium, photophobia, hydrophobia, and fever. She was admitted to Minh Hóa Regional General Hospital and then transferred to the Vietnam–Cuba Friendship Hospital in Dong Hoi. Clinicians diagnosed meningitis with a high suspicion of rabies following dog exposure and intensified treatment, but she died at 22:00 the same day. Family reported a December 2025 hand injury suspected to be a dog bite, with no wound care or rabies vaccination. This case underscores the ongoing rabies risk in Quảng Trị and similar regions where dogs may be unvaccinated and post-exposure prophylaxis is not administered, highlighting the importance of timely vaccination after exposure.

triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準4つ該当（重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）。狂犬病の致死例であり、曝露後予防接種の欠如という公衆衛生上の重大なギャップが明確。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は致死率ほぼ100%の重篤な人獣共通感染症。本例は曝露後3ヶ月経過後の発症死亡例で、創傷処置・ワクチン接種がなされなかったことが原因。ベトナム・Quảng Trị省における犬のワクチン接種率の低さと曝露後予防の不徹底が示唆される。地域的な狂犬病コントロールプログラムの評価が必要。ただし、単発例であり、ベトナムでは狂犬病は風土病的に存在するため「異常・予想外」ではない。国際的拡大リスクは犬の移動や旅行者の曝露可能性から「Yes」と評価。

article.articleHeadline: Peter Daszak le papa du Covid et ses copains de Wuhan continuent leurs manipulations génétiques sur le syndrome de diarrhée aiguë porcine (SADS)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Peter Daszak, the father of COVID, and his Wuhan friends continue their genetic manipulations on Porcine Acute Diarrheal Syndrome (PADS).
article.articleSummary: Nature Health Global (NHG) released in August 2025 a study in mBio—Diversity and spillover risk of Swine Acute Diarrhea Syndrome (SADS) and related coronaviruses in China and Southeast Asia—analyzing 523 coronavirus sequences, including 186 new bat-derived genomes. The work maps diversity, evolution, and spillover risk to pigs and humans, identifying hotspots in southern China, northern Vietnam, Java, and central Thailand. Key collaborations acknowledged with the Wuhan Institute of Virology and Kunming Institute of Zoology, including Ben Hu, Bei Li, Wei Zhang, and Zheng-Li Shi. Funding includes Samuel Freeman Charitable Trust, The Wallace Fund, an anonymous Schwab Charitable Fund donor, NIH grants R01AI110964 and U01AI151797, and USAID PREDICT. NHG emerged in April 2025 after EcoHealth Alliance suspended operations. The study notes SADS-CoV originated in bats and caused porcine outbreaks in China, with potential human cell infection in vitro. Daszak continues coronavirus research via NHG.

triage.triage_reason: 研究活動に関する報道であり、新規のアウトブレイクではない。SADS-CoVの人獣共通感染リスクに関する研究結果の公表であるが、実際の感染事例の報告は含まれていないため、現時点では経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: これは2025年8月に発表された研究論文（mBio誌）に関する報道であり、実際の疾患アウトブレイクではない。SADS-CoVの人獣共通感染リスクに関する研究結果であり、in vitroでの人細胞感染可能性が示されているが、実際のヒト感染事例は報告されていない。武漢ウイルス研究所との共同研究という点で社会的関心は高い可能性があるが、公衆衛生上の緊急事態ではない。今後の研究動向や実際の感染事例の有無を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: ภัยเงียบ ซิฟิลิสในวัยรุ่นไทย พุ่ง 10 เท่าใน 10 ปี เช็กสัญญาณเตือนที่ไม่ควรมองข้าม
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Silent Threat: Syphilis Among Thai Teens Surges Tenfold in Ten Years—Check Warning Signs You Shouldn't Overlook.
article.articleSummary: Syphilis among Thai teens has surged tenfold over the past decade, rising from 14.41 to 134.68 cases per 100,000 people in Thailand. The Department of Disease Control cites behavioral and environmental changes among youth, urging comprehensive sexual health education, greater condom access, and stigma-free testing. Syphilis is sexually transmitted and can spread via blood transfusion or mother-to-child transmission. Early signs include a genital ulcer; later, rashes may appear on the body, including palms and soles, with patchy hair loss in some cases. Some individuals remain asymptomatic for years, and untreated infection can damage the brain, heart, and blood vessels after about a decade. Diagnosis is typically by blood tests, such as prenatal or pre-donation screening. Cure is possible with proper treatment and ongoing follow-up serology; community involvement is essential for prevention.

triage.triage_reason: タイにおける青少年の梅毒感染が10年間で10倍に急増（14.41→134.68/10万人）しており、IHR基準の「深刻な公衆衛生への影響」「異常・予想外の事象」に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも「異常性」「重症度（未治療時の脳・心臓・血管への重篤な損傷）」「流行しやすさ（若年層の行動変化、無症状感染者の存在）」に該当し、疾病管理局が包括的性教育と検査体制強化を求めるなど政府レベルの関心も高い。
triage.notes: 10年間で約10倍の増加は疫学的に顕著な異常パターン。母子感染や血液感染経路の存在、無症状期間の長さ（数年間）により感染拡大リスクが高い。未治療の場合約10年後に重篤な合併症（脳・心血管系障害）を引き起こす。タイ国内の若年層における性行動・環境変化が背景にあり、包括的対策（教育・検査・コンドーム配布・スティグマ除去）の必要性が当局から示されている。国際的拡大リスクは記事では言及されていないが、性感染症の性質上、人の移動に伴う越境リスクは潜在的に存在。

article.articleHeadline: Tamil Nadu: 43 Coimbatore Students Fall Ill After Lizard Contaminates Midday Meal, Officials Investigate - The Logical Indian
article.articleSummary: 43–44 students at Corporation Middle School, Kavundampalayam, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, fell ill on March 10, 2026, after a dead lizard was reportedly found in their midday meal. Most affected students are in Classes 4–6; they were hospitalized at Government Medical College Hospital and are stable under the supervision of five doctors and nurses. The Coimbatore City Municipal Corporation (CCMC) and school authorities launched a formal probe into catering and hygiene, planning kitchen inspections, storage and handling reviews, and issuing a circular to enforce stricter food-safety practices across schools. Laboratory testing of food samples will determine the contamination source and inform pest-proofing policy in school kitchens. Experts note lizards can carry bacteria such as Salmonella even without toxins. The incident heightens scrutiny of Tamil Nadu’s noon meal programme, with calls for accountability and enhanced oversight."

triage.triage_reason: 学校給食での散発的食中毒事例であり、43-44名の児童が体調不良を訴えたが全員安定状態。異常な重症度や国際的拡大リスクは認められず、地域的な食品衛生管理の問題として対処されている。
triage.notes: 腸チフス・パラチフスとタグ付けされているが、記事内容は食中毒（Salmonella等の細菌性食中毒の可能性）を示唆。全患児が安定し入院治療中。地方自治体による衛生管理強化が既に実施されており、通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内。疾患タグと実際の内容に乖離がある可能性に注意。

article.articleHeadline: ऐन उन्हाळ्यात राज्यात मलेरिया - डेंग्यूचा कहर! मुंबईत मलेरियाच्या ९१८ रुग्णांची नोंद; तीन महिन्यांतील एकूण रुग्णसंख्या २,३९२
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria in the state at the height of summer — Dengue outbreak! 918 malaria cases reported in Mumbai; three-month total cases: 2,392.
article.articleSummary: From January to 7 March 2026, Maharashtra reported 2,392 vector-borne illness cases, dominated by malaria, dengue, and chikungunya. State totals in this period: malaria 1,335; dengue 823; chikungunya 234, with no deaths. By 7 March 2026, state totals rose to malaria 2,336; dengue 253; chikungunya 236, still with zero fatalities. Mumbai is the hotspot, recording 918 malaria cases (222 Plasmodium falciparum), 182 dengue cases, and 9 chikungunya cases; 104 malaria cases were imported. Outbreaks occur in summer and are extending beyond the monsoon season, per national vector-borne disease data. Context from 2025 shows Maharashtra malaria 32,686 (28 deaths), dengue 14,965 (34 deaths), and chikungunya 1,184 (no deaths).

triage.triage_reason: マハラシュトラ州における季節性ベクター媒介疾患の増加報告だが、死亡者ゼロで2025年の症例数（マラリア32,686例、デング14,965例）と比較して2026年初頭の数値は大幅に低い。通常の季節パターンの範囲内の可能性が高いが、夏季・モンスーン期外への拡大傾向は継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 2026年1月～3月7日の累計データ（マラリア2,336例、デング253例、チクングニア236例、死亡0）は、2025年通年データ（マラリア32,686例・28死亡、デング14,965例・34死亡）と比較すると年初の段階で顕著に低い。ムンバイが最多（マラリア918例中222例が熱帯熱マラリア、104例は輸入症例）。モンスーン期外への流行拡大傾向は注目すべき点だが、現時点で異常事態とは判断しがたい。続報で症例数の急増や重症化傾向が確認されれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 3 Vietnamese children suspected of botulinum poisoning after eating fermented fish
article.articleSummary: Three boys in Da Nang City, central Vietnam, were hospitalized with suspected botulinum food poisoning after eating 'ca u chua', a fermented fish dish from Quang Nam highlands. Six family members who shared the meal on Saturday fell ill; by 6:00 pm three children, H.N.T., 15; H.Q.N., 7; H.Q.B., 11, developed abdominal pain, vomiting and fatigue. The 15-year-old was admitted in a coma with breathing difficulties, dilated pupils, weak pulse and bladder loss, placed on a ventilator; plasma exchange with albumin was performed after consultation with Cho Ray Hospital specialists in Ho Chi Minh City. The two younger boys showed ptosis, muscle weakness and breathing problems; one required mechanical ventilation, the other assisted breathing. All were transferred to Da Nang Hospital for Women and Children. The dish, made from fermenting freshwater fish with rice, salt and spices, has been linked to several botulinum cases recently, including a 2023 Phuoc Son incident.

triage.triage_reason: 集団発生（6名発症、うち小児3名が重症・人工呼吸管理）で重症度が高く、発酵食品による複数事例の発生歴があり公衆衛生上の対応が必要。ボツリヌス毒素は致死性が高く、国際的な関心事項となりうる。
triage.notes: ボツリヌス中毒は重篤な食中毒で、15歳児が昏睡・呼吸困難で人工呼吸管理、血漿交換を要する重症例。2023年にも同地域で同様の発酵魚製品による事例あり。伝統的発酵食品（ca u chua）が原因であり、食品安全管理・住民啓発が課題。ヒト-ヒト感染はないが、同一食品による追加患者発生リスクあり。Cho Ray病院（ホーチミン市）との遠隔コンサルテーションで対応しており、国内で医療対応は可能と判断されるが、再発防止策の検討が必要。IHR基準は1つのみ該当だが、WPRO基準2つ該当＋社会的関心ありのためPICKUP判定。

article.articleHeadline: Waspada Campak di Yogyakarta, Dinkes Temukan 6 Kasus Positif pada Awal 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles Alert in Yogyakarta: Health Office Finds 6 Positive Cases in Early 2026
article.articleSummary: As of March 11, 2026, a measles alert is underway in Yogyakarta City, Indonesia, after six laboratory-confirmed measles cases were detected from January through week 8 of 2026. The City Health Office (Dinkes) is conducting an epidemiological investigation; total suspected measles cases reached 45, with six confirmed by lab tests. Confirmed cases span ages from under 1 year to 28 years, including 4-, 8-, 11-, and 15-year-olds, and one adult. The majority are school-age children. To prevent classroom transmission, infected students are instructed to stay out of school until fully recovered. Historical context shows rising detections early in the year compared with prior years: 2024 had 19 cases, 2025 had 13 cases, with Solikhin Dwi Ramtana noting an increased frequency of findings relative to the early-year average.

triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・ジョグジャカルタ市で2026年初頭に麻疹6例が検査確定。過去2年（2024年19例、2025年13例）と比較して増加傾向にあり、年齢層も1歳未満～28歳と幅広い。学校閉鎖等の対策実施中だが、疑い例45例中6例のみ確定のため情報不足。続報待ちが適切。
triage.notes: 確定例6例は限定的だが疑い例45例の詳細不明。麻疹はワクチン予防可能疾患であり、年齢分布（1歳未満～成人）から予防接種歴の確認が重要。地方都市レベルでの探知であり、現時点では国際的拡大リスクは低いが、インドネシアは人口大国かつ観光地のため続報次第でPICKUPへ格上げの可能性あり。疫学調査進行中のため48-72時間後の続報を要注視。

article.articleHeadline: Waspada Penularan Campak, Dinkes DKI Jakarta Perketat Surveilans di Fasilitas Kesehatan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Be vigilant for measles transmission as Jakarta Health Office tightens surveillance at health facilities.
article.articleSummary: Measles surveillance in Jakarta, Indonesia, is intensified as of March 11, 2026, with DKI Jakarta Health Office (Dinkes) tightening monitoring at health facilities across the capital. There are no confirmed measles cases in Jakarta to date, though infections have been reported in surrounding areas, prompting proactive containment. Surveillance points focus on patients with influenza-like illness (ILI) or severe acute respiratory infection (SARI), and clinically suspected measles cases will undergo laboratory confirmation. Increased mobility ahead of Lebaran raises transmission risk, underscoring the need for vigilance. Infants and young children are most vulnerable due to immature immunity, so authorities urge careful interactions with small children and prompt medical evaluation for high fever with a red rash. These measures seek to avert a measles outbreak in Jakarta and nearby regions.

triage.triage_reason: ジャカルタでは現時点で確定症例なく、周辺地域での発生を受けた予防的サーベイランス強化段階。情報不足のため経過観察が適切だが、レバラン前の人口移動増加による感染拡大リスクに注視が必要。
triage.notes: ジャカルタ首都圏では確定症例ゼロだが、周辺地域での麻疹報告を受けて予防的にサーベイランスを強化。レバラン（イスラム祝祭）前の人口移動増加が懸念材料。乳幼児が最も脆弱な集団。現段階では予防措置の段階だが、周辺地域の症例数・重症度の続報と、ジャカルタでの初発例の有無を注視する必要あり。インフルエンザ様疾患(ILI)/重症急性呼吸器感染症(SARI)サーベイランスポイントで麻疹も監視する体制。

article.articleHeadline: Bé gái ở Quảng Trị tử vong sau 4 tháng bị chó cắn, nghi bệnh dại
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A girl in Quảng Trị dies four months after being bitten by a dog, suspected rabies.
article.articleSummary: On 9 March 2026, a girl born in 2020 from Kim Phú commune, Quảng Trị Province, Vietnam, died four months after a dog bite in December 2025. The bite was unvaccinated; presentation included vomiting and foaming at the mouth, with meningitis suspected. She was treated at Minh Hóa Regional General Hospital and transferred at 19:50 to Viet Nam–Cuba Friendship Hospital in Đồng Hới. By 20:30 she developed hypersalivation, delirium, photophobia, phonophobia, hydrophobia, and high fever; pupils were 3 mm with poor light reflex. She stopped breathing and had cardiac arrest at 22:00; resuscitation briefly restored a pulse, but she died after returning home. The diagnosis remained suspected rabies with meningitis; no laboratory confirmation was reported. The case highlights rabies risk after an unvaccinated dog bite in the region.

triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病による死亡例であり、ワクチン未接種の犬咬傷後4ヶ月での発症は予防対策の不備を示唆。IHR基準2つ該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当するためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は致死率ほぼ100%の重大疾患。本症例は犬咬傷後の曝露後予防（PEP）未実施による予防可能死であり、地域の狂犬病対策・ワクチン接種体制の脆弱性を示唆。ベトナムは狂犬病流行国であり本症例自体は予想外ではないが、4ヶ月の潜伏期間と典型的な臨床経過（恐水症・恐音症等）を呈しており、地域住民の継続的な犬咬傷リスク曝露と予防体制の不備が懸念される。実験室確定診断なしでの臨床診断による死亡報告のため、サーベイランス体制の評価も必要。IHR基準のカウントは1だが、WPROスクリーニング基準4項目該当により、地域の狂犬病予防・管理体制の包括的評価のためPICKUPと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Waspadai Penularan Campak Saat Silaturahmi Lebaran, Cegah Penyakit dengan Vaksin
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beware of Measles Transmission During Eid al-Fitr Gatherings; Prevent Disease with Vaccination.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases are rising nationwide in Indonesia as Eid al-Fitr 2026 approaches (as of March 11, 2026). In Jakarta, health officials urge parents of babies and toddlers to be vigilant during Idul Fitri gatherings and avoid close contact with young children, especially infants, given their vulnerability. While Jakarta has not yet confirmed cases, measles has been detected in areas surrounding the capital, including East Jakarta (Pasar Rebo). Pediatrician Dr. Arifianto notes ongoing severe cases due to incomplete immunization, with some children requiring ventilators or PICU care. Vaccination remains the key preventive measure: the Measles-Rubella (MR) vaccine is administered in three doses at 9 months, 18 months, and 6–7 years. The Health Ministry confirms MR vaccine availability to support intensified immunization amid rising cases, alongside surveillance and early detection. Parents are urged to complete immunizations to strengthen protection before the holiday.

triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで麻疹症例が全国的に増加しており、ワクチン未接種による重症例（人工呼吸器・PICU管理）が報告されている。イスラム教の大型連休（Eid al-Fitr）での集団感染リスクが懸念され、公衆衛生への影響が深刻かつ国際的拡大の可能性がある。
triage.notes: 首都ジャカルタ周辺で麻疹検出、重症例で人工呼吸器・PICU管理が必要なケースあり。Eid al-Fitr（2026年）の大規模な人の移動・集会により感染拡大リスクが高い。保健省がワクチン供給と監視強化を実施中。風疹（Rubella）も疾患リストに含まれているが本文では麻疹が主体。ワクチン接種率の低さが重症化要因として指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Sau 3 tháng bị chó cắn, bé gái 6 tuổi tử vong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three months after a dog bite, a 6-year-old girl dies.
article.articleSummary: On 11 March 2026, Quảng Trị Province's CDC reported one death linked to a dog bite. The patient, C.G.H., a 6-year-old girl from Kim Phú commune, Quảng Trị, was bitten in December 2025 and did not receive rabies post-exposure vaccination. After three months with no symptoms, she developed acute neurological illness on 9 March 2026, presenting with vomiting, foaming at the mouth, and was diagnosed with meningitis with suspected rabies. She was admitted to Minh Hóa Regional General Hospital, then transferred to Việt Nam–C Cuba Friendship Hospital in Đồng Hới at 19:50. By 20:30 she showed copious airway secretions, disorientation, photophobia, hydrophobia, fever; mortality ensued with respiratory and cardiac arrest at 22:00, and she died en route home after resuscitation. CDC Quảng Trị urged veterinary authorities to survey dog/cat households and promote vaccination and timely post-exposure prophylaxis after bites.

triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病は風土病地域での散発例であり、予防接種未接種による典型的な経過。国際的拡大リスクなし、異常性も低く、社会的関心も限定的。
triage.notes: ベトナムは狂犬病風土病地域であり、単発死亡例は異常ではない。患者は曝露後予防接種を受けておらず、典型的な臨床経過（潜伏期3ヶ月、神経症状、恐水症）を示した。地域CDCが適切な公衆衛生対応（動物調査、予防接種啓発）を実施しており、管理可能。重症度のみWPRO基準該当だが、他の基準を満たさず、国際的懸念事項には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: रहीमाबाद में हेपेटाइटिस-बी जांच से राहत: तरौना-जालामऊ के 61 ग्रामीणों की रिपोर्ट नेगेटिव, लोहिया की रिपोर्ट पर सवाल... पहले 19 निकले थे पॉजिटिव
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Relief from Hepatitis B testing in Rahimabad: 61 villagers from Tarouna-Jalamau test negative, questions over Lohia's report... 19 had tested positive earlier.
article.articleSummary: Hepatitis B concerns arise in Rahimabad’s Tarouna and Jalamau villages. On 2026-03-11, a health camp tested 61 residents by rapid assay; all results were negative, with 50 tested in Tarouna and 11 in Jalamau, though some families refused testing. Earlier, 19 blood donors from Rahimabad’s 24 February blood-donation camp were confirmed Hepatitis B positive by Balrampur Hospital and the Lohia Institute, triggering contact tracing. A follow-up re-test at Kanpur’s King George’s Medical University (KGMU) microbiology department on 14 samples showed 13 negative and 1 positive, casting doubt on the Lohia Institute’s earlier all-positive results, since different testing methods were used. Field inspections also covered Munshikheda. Separately, Balrampur Hospital’s open-PPP dialysis unit (14 machines; 18 patients registered) raised infection concerns for Hepatitis B and C among dialyzed patients; three years ago more than 30 patients in the unit became HBV infected, suggesting possible in-dialysis transmission. Some relatives allege testing-related issues and procedural lapses.

triage.triage_reason: 医療機関での集団感染疑い（透析ユニットでの過去のHBV集団感染、血液ドナー19名陽性）があり、検査結果の不一致による公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念が存在。国際的拡大リスクは低いが、IHR基準2つ以上該当し、医療安全管理上の重大事案としてフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 【重要懸念点】①透析ユニットで3年前に30名以上のHBV感染（院内感染疑い）②血液ドナー19名が陽性（血液安全性の懸念）③検査機関間で結果の大幅な不一致（Lohia研究所19名全陽性→KGMU再検査で14名中13名陰性）④検査手法の違いによる偽陽性の可能性⑤一部住民の検査拒否。医療関連感染制御とラボ品質管理の両面で公衆衛生上の介入が必要。国境地域（バングラデシュ近接）での発生だが現時点で国際拡大の証拠なし。

article.articleHeadline: BuCor denies scabies outbreak at NBP, other prison and penal farms
article.articleSummary: On 2026-03-11, the Bureau of Corrections (BuCor) denied reports of a scabies outbreak at New Bilibid Prison (NBP) and other prisons nationwide. Political prisoner group Kapatid urged immediate medicine delivery and a treatment and sanitation campaign for persons deprived of liberty (PDLs), citing visits that suggested skin infections were spreading quickly at the NBP's Reception and Diagnostic Center amid severe overcrowding and water shortages. BuCor Acting Director for Health and Welfare Services Ma. Cecilia Villanueva said the last scabies outbreak occurred two years ago and noted an ICRC–BuCor collaboration that sponsored an alis galis activity. BuCor also stressed existing protocols for medicine delivery and assured the public and families it can respond effectively to health issues inside correction facilities. Kapatid has sent a letter to the Department of Justice requesting urgent humanitarian action.

triage.triage_reason: 疥癬の集団発生の可能性が政治囚グループから報告されているが、当局は否定。過密状況と水不足の中で皮膚感染症が急速拡大している可能性を示唆するが、確定情報が不足しており続報の監視が必要。
triage.notes: 疥癬は通常、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とはならないが、刑務所という閉鎖環境での過密状況と衛生問題による拡大懸念がある。当局による否定と支援団体による報告に齟齬があり、実態把握が必要。ICRC（国際赤十字）が既に関与していることから人道的懸念が存在。刑務所内の感染症管理状況を継続監視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Everest Spices Under Scanner After Lab Tests Flag Pesticides: What Is Enterobacteriaceae Bacteria
article.articleSummary: On 11 March 2026, a YouTube video by Trustified alleged Everest spice products failed independent laboratory tests purchased from a D-Mart store in India, raising questions about FSSAI safety compliance. The spices tested were Everest Garam Masala, Kitchen King Masala, Kashmiri Lal Chilli Powder, and Meat Masala. Reported findings claimed pesticide levels above safety limits in Garam Masala (Acetamiprid, Azoxystrobin) and Meat Masala (Ethion, Tebuconazole, Azoxystrobin, Fluopyram), with samples showing elevated Enterobacteriaceae. Kitchen King Masala also exceeded Enterobacteriaceae limits, while Kashmiri Lal Chilli Powder had no pesticides above limits but elevated Enterobacteriaceae. The claims suggest contamination during processing or handling and hygiene lapses. Health implications cited include stomach infections from Enterobacteriaceae (E. coli, Salmonella) causing diarrhoea, vomiting, and abdominal pain; pesticide residues may affect liver, intestines, and nervous system, with higher risk for children, elderly, and immunocompromised individuals. The findings remain unverified by official agencies at this time.

triage.triage_reason: 食品安全違反の疑いであり異常性は認められるが、独立検査機関の未検証情報であり、ヒト-ヒト感染性疾患ではないため国際拡大リスクは低い。公衆衛生当局の公式確認と続報が必要。
triage.notes: YouTube動画による未検証の民間検査結果。FSSAIなど公的機関の確認が必要。Enterobacteriaceae検出は腸管感染症（E. coli、Salmonella等）のリスクを示唆するが、実際の健康被害報告は記載なし。食品汚染事案として製品回収や渡航制限には至らないレベルだが、Everestは大手スパイスブランドのため消費者の関心は高い可能性あり。公式発表待ち。

article.articleHeadline: Nghe thầy lang đắp thuốc sau chấn thương, suýt mất chân vì nhiễm trùng nặng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Treatment by a traditional healer after an injury nearly cost him his leg due to a severe infection.
article.articleSummary: On 11 March 2026, in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, a 46-year-old man presented at An Binh Hospital with a complex ankle injury after an accident but delayed medical care, instead applying folk medicine poultices. Within two days he developed swelling, blisters, redness, and escalating pain, leading to hospitalization. Imaging revealed a complex three-malleolar ankle fracture, a fracture of the lower one-third of the tibia, ankle subluxation, and soft-tissue necrosis with infection linked to the herbal treatment. Surgeons adopted a two-stage approach: first controlling infection and stabilizing soft tissue, then performing definitive bone fixation using minimally invasive techniques under fluoroscopic guidance. Postoperatively, the patient stabilized and both the ankle and knee were mobilizing without pain, beginning rehabilitation. Clinicians warn that self-treatment with poultices or non-medical remedies can cause infection, tissue necrosis, delay care during the “golden period,” and raise the risk of amputation or long-term disability; prompt referral to orthopedic trauma care is advised.

triage.triage_reason: 個別の医療事例（1名の患者）であり、感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の集団発生を示す情報ではない。伝統医療による合併症の警告事例として医療界には有益だが、感染症サーベイランスの対象とはならない。
triage.notes: これは46歳男性1名の外傷後感染の臨床症例報告であり、集団発生ではない。「Unknown Illness」と分類されているが、実際には外傷後の二次感染（民間療法による遅延治療が原因）であり、感染症アウトブレイクではない。患者は適切な治療を受けて回復しており、公衆衛生上の懸念は認められない。EBSの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Waspada Campak, Dinkes DKI Minta Warga Tak Cium Bayi dan Balita Saat Lebaran
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Be on alert for measles, Jakarta Health Office asks residents not to kiss babies and toddlers during Eid al-Fitr.
article.articleSummary: Measles (campak) alert for Jakarta as of March 11, 2026. DKI Jakarta Health Office reports no laboratory-confirmed measles cases among Jakarta residents to date, but cases have been reported in surrounding areas, prompting heightened vigilance ahead of Eid al-Fitr. Infants and toddlers are the most vulnerable group. Public guidance urges avoiding touching or kissing babies and young children to reduce transmission risk. Surveillance is ongoing with several health facilities designated as surveillance sites to monitor potential infections. There is currently no confirmed outbreak in the capital, but authorities are maintaining enhanced monitoring to detect any imported or locally transmitted measles cases during Lebaran.

triage.triage_reason: ジャカルタ市内では実験室確定症例ゼロだが、周辺地域で麻疹報告あり。レバラン（帰省・大移動時期）を控えた予防的監視強化段階。現時点でアウトブレイク未発生だが、人口移動リスクと脆弱層（乳幼児）への懸念から経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: ジャカルタ首都特別州での実験室確定例は報告されていないが、周辺地域での症例を受けて予防的措置として公衆衛生指導（乳幼児への接触回避）と監視強化が実施されている。レバラン（イスラム断食月明け大祭）による大規模人口移動を控え、輸入例や地域内伝播の早期検出体制を構築中。麻疹の感染性の高さ（epidemic-prone）から1基準該当するが、現時点で深刻な公衆衛生影響や異常事態には至っていない。続報（特にレバラン期間中の症例動向）の注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ротавірус: що це за хвороба та кого найчастіше уражає
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rotavirus: What disease is it and who does it most often affect?
article.articleSummary: Rotavirus infection is an acute gastroenteritis caused by human rotavirus and remains the world's leading cause of diarrhea in children aged 6 months to 4–5 years, with peaks in the cold season (November–April). The illness commonly leads to dehydration from vomiting and diarrhea; if dehydration is not treated, organ damage and death can occur, especially in infants and kids with limited fluid intake or weakened immune systems. Incubation is typically about two days, up to five days. Transmission is fecal-oral, via close person-to-person contact or contaminated surfaces; the virus can persist on objects for weeks to months, and stool shedding can continue for up to 10 days after symptoms resolve, even when symptoms are absent. Most affected are children under five, with the youngest (under three) at greater risk for severe disease. As a reminder, India reports a Nipah virus outbreak—rare and without a vaccine or treatment.

triage.triage_reason: ロタウイルスに関する一般的な疾患情報の記事であり、特定の集団発生や異常事例の報告ではない。ニパウイルスへの言及は「念のための情報」程度で、具体的なイベント詳細が含まれていない。
triage.notes: 記事はウクライナ語で配信されているが、内容はロタウイルス感染症の一般的な疾患解説（症状、感染経路、リスク群など）であり、特定の集団発生イベントの報告ではない。インドでのニパウイルス発生への言及があるが、記事末尾の補足情報レベルで、詳細な疫学情報は含まれていない。現時点で緊急性のあるシグナルとは判断できない。

article.articleHeadline: 'Preocupante', diz infectologista sobre alta dos casos de Mpox no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 'Worrisome', says infectious disease specialist about the rise in Mpox cases in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (Monkeypox) in Brazil shows 140 confirmed, 539 suspected, and nine probable cases per the Ministry of Health. Transmission occurs via contact with infected individuals, contaminated materials, or wild animals; Western outbreaks have included sexual contact. Primary symptoms are skin lesions, fever, headache, and body aches. Infectious-disease specialist Antônio Carlos Bandeira warns 2026 infection levels are high and already resemble the 2024 surge, the largest on record. He emphasizes that many in the West may be unaware that sexual transmission occurred. Guidance: seek medical evaluation promptly if symptoms appear, and avoid close contact to prevent spread. If a skin lesion develops, obtain a diagnosis through medical exams and inform the physician if you think someone else may have Mpox to assist assessment. Article date: March 11, 2026 (interview published March 10, 2026).

triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでMpox症例が急増しており、2024年の最大流行と同規模の感染レベルに達している。感染症専門家が「懸念すべき」と警告し、140例の確定例・539例の疑い例が報告されており、公衆衛生上の影響が深刻。
triage.notes: 2026年3月時点で既に2024年の過去最大流行に匹敵する感染レベルに達している点が重要。ブラジル保健省が公式に症例数を発表しており、政府レベルでの監視体制が稼働。Mpox Clade I/IIの区別は記事内で不明だが、急増パターンは公衆衛生上の懸念事項。性的接触を含む複数の伝播経路があり、ヒト-ヒト感染が確立。フルRRAで国際的拡大リスクと症例の重症度を詳細評価すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Quảng Trị: Bệnh nhi 6 tuổi tử vong do bệnh dại sau 3 tháng bị chó cắn
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Quảng Trị Province: A 6-year-old child dies of rabies three months after being bitten by a dog
article.articleSummary: Rabies case in Quảng Trị Province, Vietnam: A 6-year-old boy from Hamlet 1, Kim Phú Commune, was bitten by a dog around December 2025 and received no wound care or rabies vaccination. On March 9, 2026, he developed vomiting, foaming at the mouth, and agitation, prompting admission to Minh Hóa Regional General Hospital with meningitis/possible rabies, then transfer to Vietnam-Cuba Friendship Hospital in Đồng Hới. By about 20:30 he displayed classic rabies symptoms—excessive saliva, delirium, photophobia, aerophobia, phonophobia, hydrophobia—with pupils 3 mm and poor light reflex; fever persisted. He died at 22:00 after resuscitation attempts, later taken home and died en route. CDC Quảng Trị reported no additional confirmed dog-bite cases linked to this dog. Authorities will survey households with pets and strengthen public awareness.

triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで狂犬病による小児死亡例1件が報告されているが、散発例であり国際的拡大リスクは限定的。ただし予防接種未実施での死亡例として公衆衛生上の教訓があり、続報（類似症例の有無、犬の追跡調査結果）を注視すべき。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は致死率ほぼ100%だが、ベトナムでは年間数十例報告されており異常事例ではない。本件は犬咬傷後の予防接種未実施による典型的な死亡例（咬傷から約3ヶ月後に発症）。CDC Quảng Trịが疫学調査を実施中で、当該犬による他の咬傷事例は現時点で確認されていない。地域での啓発強化が計画されている。単発例かつ既知の風土病範囲内のためPICKUPには至らないが、調査結果や追加症例の有無を監視する価値あり。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes DKI Sebut Belum Ada Kasus Campak di Jakarta, Warga Diminta Tetap Waspada Jelang Lebaran
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jakarta Health Office says there are no measles cases in Jakarta, residents urged to stay vigilant ahead of Eid al-Fitr.
article.articleSummary: Measles surveillance in Jakarta shows no confirmed measles cases in the capital as of March 11, 2026, though health authorities continue monitoring for early detection through surveillance of influenza-like illness (ILI) and severe acute respiratory infection (SARI) across select facilities. Any symptomatic individuals will undergo laboratory testing to confirm diagnosis; no Jakarta-domiciled cases yet, but neighboring districts have started to show measles activity. With Eid al-Fitr approaching, increased mobility and interaction heighten risk, particularly for children, the most vulnerable group, prompting officials to urge cautious contact with infants and toddlers. Simultaneously, the Indonesian Pediatric Association (IDAI) reports a national uptick in measles: Week 7 of 2026 saw 8,224 suspected cases, 572 confirmed, and 4 deaths, compared with 2025’s 63,769 suspected, 11,094 confirmed, and 69 deaths. Health authorities advocate accelerated immunization to protect children.

triage.triage_reason: ジャカルタでは現時点で麻疹確認例なしだが、周辺地域で麻疹活動あり、全国的には症例増加傾向。レバラン（イード）前の人口移動リスクと低ワクチン接種率の懸念があるが、現地点では深刻な影響は不明確。続報および全国動向の注視が必要。
triage.notes: ジャカルタ自体は現時点で確認例ゼロだが、全国レベルでは2026年第7週に572例確認・4名死亡と増加傾向。周辺地域での麻疹活動開始、レバラン前の人口移動による感染拡大リスク、小児の脆弱性を当局が警告している点で社会的・政府的関心あり。ただし重症度・国際拡大リスク・支援必要性については記事から判断不可。インフルエンザ様疾患（ILI）/重症急性呼吸器感染症（SARI）サーベイランスを通じた早期探知体制は稼働中。ワクチン接種加速が推奨されているが、現時点での接種率や対策の十分性は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Menkes: Gencarkan skrining-surveilans kusta guna eliminasi penyakit
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Minister: Ramp up leprosy screening and surveillance for disease elimination.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's Health Minister Budi Gunadi Sadikin urged accelerated leprosy (Mycobacterium leprae) screening and surveillance to support elimination, noting the country ranks third globally behind India and Brazil in leprosy burden. Indonesia historically reported around 16,000 cases. He stressed similarity to tuberculosis and the importance of proactive detection. Leprosy screening will be expanded within the Free Health Check (CKG) program, with rewards for districts that identify more cases to accelerate treatment with rifampicin, analogous to the TB regimen with dapsone for six months. To strengthen elimination, eastern Indonesia’s surveillance will incorporate genome sequencing due to varying susceptibility to dapsone hypersensitivity syndrome (DHS). Once detected, cases should be treated promptly, and contacts receive prophylaxis and preventive drugs. Stigma remains a major barrier, with patients facing discrimination.

triage.triage_reason: ハンセン病対策の強化に関する政策発表であり、新規アウトブレイクではない。インドネシアが世界第3位の負担国という既知の状況に対する公衆衛生対応の強化であるため、情報収集の継続は必要だが即座のRRAは不要。
triage.notes: インドネシア保健大臣による既存のハンセン病対策強化の政策発表。年間約16,000例という既知の疾病負担に対する対応であり、新規の異常事態ではない。ゲノムシーケンシングによるサーベイランス強化、無料健康診断プログラムへの統合など、国内での管理能力強化の取り組み。スティグマが依然として主要な障壁として言及されている。インド、ブラジルと並ぶ高負担国という位置づけは変わらず、新たな国際的リスクは示唆されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Menkes: Gencarkan skrining-surveilans kusta guna eliminasi penyakit - ANTARA News Ambon, Maluku
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Minister of Health: Step up leprosy screening and surveillance for disease elimination - ANTARA News Ambon, Maluku
article.articleSummary: Indonesia aims to accelerate leprosy screening and surveillance to eliminate the disease, ranking third globally in cases after India and Brazil. Health Minister Budi Gunadi Sadikin noted that Indonesia previously had about 16,000 leprosy cases and underscored screening and surveillance as the key. The Free Health Check (CKG) program will add leprosy testing. On World Leprosy Day in Jakarta, he offered incentives for districts that identify the most cases to expedite treatment with rifampicin-based regimens; multidrug therapy with dapsone typically lasts about six months. To strengthen surveillance, genome sequencing will be added for eastern Indonesia (including Ambon, Maluku) due to dapsone hypersensitivity risk in that population (DHS). Contacts receive prophylaxis. Prompt treatment is essential, but stigma remains a major barrier, with patients facing discrimination and ostracism.

triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおけるハンセン病対策強化の政策発表であり、新規アウトブレイクではない。世界第3位の症例数を有する国での強化サーベイランス開始は公衆衛生上重要だが、現時点で異常事態や国際拡大リスクは示されていない。継続的な症例数推移の監視が必要。
triage.notes: これは既存のハンセン病対策の強化施策（スクリーニング拡大・ゲノムシーケンシング導入・予防投薬）に関する保健大臣の政策発表。約16,000症例は既知の状況。東インドネシア（アンボン等）でのダプソン過敏症リスクへの対応としてゲノム解析導入は科学的アプローチ。スティグマが治療障壁となっている点は社会的課題。世界ハンセン病デーでの発表であり政府の優先課題だが、緊急性を要する新規事象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Lassa Fever Kills Two Healthcare Workers, Eight Others In Benue - The Ghanaian Chronicle
article.articleSummary: Ten people have died from Lassa fever in Benue State, Nigeria, with 52 laboratory-confirmed cases among 315 suspected; as of 11 March 2026. Commissioner Dr. Peter Ogwuche reported at Makurdi that 14 confirmed cases are health workers, including six medical doctors. Since the outbreak began, 10 deaths have occurred among confirmed cases. A surveillance team has been deployed across all 23 local government areas; active transmission is noted in Makurdi, Guma, Buruku and Okpokwu, which are closely monitored. The Nigeria Centre for Disease Control (NCDC) aims to reduce Lassa fever incidence to an appreciable level within 10 years, though vaccine development is time-consuming. The death rate remains high, with a vaccine development group collaborating with African and international partners.

triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）、WPRO基準4項目該当（異常性、重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）。医療従事者14名を含む52名の確定症例、10名の死亡、4つのLGAでの活発な伝播が確認されており、即座のフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 医療従事者の感染が14名（医師6名含む）と院内感染の可能性が高く、死亡率も高い（10/52=19.2%）。NCDCが10年計画でワクチン開発に言及しており国家レベルの対応が必要な状況。23のLGA全域にサーベイランスチームが展開されているが、4つのLGAで活発な伝播が継続中。国際的なパートナーシップによる支援体制も示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: Kematian Akibat Campak Harusnya Tak Terjadi, Ini Rekomendasi Pencegahan dari IDAI
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles Deaths Should Not Happen: Here Are IDAI's Prevention Recommendations.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia’s IDAI emphasizes that measles deaths should not occur and issues comprehensive prevention guidance. The recommendations promote vaccination and surveillance: ensure complete routine immunization against measles and rubella (MR/MMR) for children aged 9 months to 15 years, and verify full MR/MMR vaccination for healthcare workers. The government provides free vaccines and ready health facilities; parents are urged not to delay immunization and to seek care promptly if symptoms appear. Laboratories for measles and rubella diagnosis should be strengthened to support surveillance and case confirmation. Diagnosis is primarily clinical, with prodromal fever, conjunctivitis, coryza, and cough after a 10–12 day incubation; Koplik spots may precede the rash by 1–2 days. The maculopapular erythematous rash typically begins on the head and spreads to the body over 3–4 days, becoming confluent and fading after 3–4 days; laboratory confirmation, including viral genotyping in special cases, may be performed.

triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおける麻疹による死亡事例の発生を受け、国の小児科医会（IDAI）が予防勧告を発出している。麻疹は国際的な拡大リスクがあり、ワクチン接種率や医療体制の懸念が示唆されるため、フルRRAによる詳細評価が必要。
triage.notes: 麻疹による死亡は予防可能であるべきとの国の医師会見解が出されており、ワクチン接種の遅れや医療アクセスの課題が背景にある可能性。インドネシアは人口大国で国際移動も活発なため、麻疹の国際拡大リスクは高い。風疹との混合ワクチン（MR/MMR）接種推進と検査体制強化が勧告されているが、現状の接種率や流行規模の詳細は記事から不明。続報での症例数・地域分布・ワクチン接種率データの確認が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Waspada KLB Campak, IDAI: Kejar Imunisasi dan Tindakan Pencegahan Komprehensif
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Be Vigilant for a Measles Outbreak, IDAI: Pursue Immunization and Comprehensive Preventive Measures.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia faces a measles surge: 2025 saw 63,769 suspected cases, 11,094 confirmed, and 69 deaths; by week 7 of 2026, 8,224 suspected, 572 confirmed, and 4 deaths. Globally, Indonesia ranks second in measles burden (10,744 cases) behind Yemen and ahead of India, based on WHO data cited by CDC in February 2026. IDAI President Dr. Piprim Basarah Yanuarso urges extraordinary action and universal immunization as a child’s right. Six strategic steps target three pillars: 1) pursue measles–rubella immunization for children 9 months to <15 years who are unimmunized; 2) strengthen surveillance for measles and rubella; 3) bolster laboratory capacity for diagnosis. MR2 vaccination coverage was 82.3% in 2024, well below the 95% national target, leaving gaps in herd immunity; misinformation about vaccine safety is unfounded.

triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、異常事態）。WHO・CDCが言及する国際的な麻疹負担でインドネシアが第2位、複数国（イエメン、インド）への拡大懸念あり。死亡例発生、ワクチン接種率低下による集団免疫ギャップ拡大は重大な公衆衛生上の脅威。
triage.notes: 2025年に63,769疑い例・11,094確定例・69死亡、2026年第7週までに8,224疑い例・572確定例・4死亡と急増。MR2接種率82.3%（目標95%を大きく下回る）による集団免疫不足が背景。WHO/CDC公式データで国際的負担第2位。IDAI（インドネシア小児科学会）が緊急対応・包括的予防措置を要請。イエメン・インド含む地域的拡大パターンを示唆。ワクチン安全性に関する誤情報が接種率低下の一因。

article.articleHeadline: Đang khỏe mạnh bỗng nguy kịch sau 24 giờ vì sốt cao, có phải "sốt nhiễm khuẩn"?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In good health, suddenly critically ill after 24 hours due to a high fever—could this be 'bacterial fever'?
article.articleSummary: A healthy Vietnamese man, identified as D.A., suddenly fell critically ill with a high fever (39–40°C) and marked leukopenia after 24 hours, leading to emergency admission. After about 12 days of treatment at Vinmec hospital, he stabilized and was discharged. The event is described as a bacterial fever (sốt nhiễm khuẩn), a fever arising from bacterial infection that can progress to bacteremia or sepsis, especially when white blood cells and neutrophils are severely reduced. No specific infection source or blood disorder was identified; such fever with leukopenia is not uncommon and may lack clear signs. While tests for influenza A and COVID-19 were negative, many pathogens can cause fever. Public guidance emphasizes not self-mixing antibiotics; seek urgent care for persistent high fever (39–40°C) with chills, weakness, or dizziness. Onset Feb 26; published Mar 11, 2026; Vietnam.

triage.triage_reason: 単一の散発事例であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクの兆候なし。インフルエンザA・COVID-19検査陰性で細菌性発熱の一般的な臨床経過を示す教育的記事と判断される。
triage.notes: 1名の細菌性発熱事例で12日間の治療後に回復・退院。インフルA・COVID-19陰性。感染源・血液疾患特定されず。高熱時の受診啓発を目的とした一般向け健康情報記事であり、集団発生や異常な病原体の示唆なし。疫学的シグナルとしての要素を欠く。

article.articleHeadline: Puluhan Sapi di Kabupaten Cirebon Terpapar PMK Jelang Lebaran
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dozens of cows in Cirebon Regency infected with Foot-and-Mouth Disease ahead of Eid al-Fitr.
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-Mouth Disease (PMK) infections in cattle in Cirebon Regency, West Java, Indonesia involve at least 71 animals as of mid-March 2026; about half have recovered, with around 30 still recovering. Ahead of Eid al-Fitr and Ramadan, local authorities are accelerating vaccination, prioritizing female breeding cows, breeding stock owned by farmers or managed by the district, and bulls and cows born and raised on farms. Biosecurity measures include routine disinfectant spraying, avoiding shared equipment, restricting movements, and sourcing cattle only from health-certified suppliers. New stock should be isolated for 14 days before mixing; if no symptoms after 14 days, vaccinate for added protection. Farmers should monitor for mouth and hoof blisters, excessive saliva, fever, and reduced appetite, and report suspected cases to animal health workers or the nearest Puskeswan unit for prompt inspection.

triage.triage_reason: 動物のみの感染症で公衆衛生への直接的な影響は限定的だが、食品安全・経済的影響の可能性があり、宗教祝日（レバラン）前の発生という社会的文脈が存在するため経過観察が適切
triage.notes: 口蹄疫は人獣共通感染症ではなく、ヒトへの健康リスクは極めて低い。インドネシアでは散発的に発生する動物疾患であり異常事象ではない。感染数71頭（うち約半数回復）は限定的規模。地方当局がワクチン接種とバイオセキュリティ対策を実施中で管理体制は機能している。レバラン前の食肉需要増加期という経済的文脈はあるが、現時点で渡航・貿易制限や国際支援の必要性を示す情報はなし。続報で規模拡大や他地域への拡散があれば再評価が必要

article.articleHeadline: 32 Suspek Campak Ditemukan di Kabupaten Banjar, Hoaks Imunisasi Masih Jadi Kendala - Banjarmasinpost.co.id
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 32 Suspected Measles Cases Found in Banjar Regency, Immunization Hoaxes Still a Hindrance
article.articleSummary: Measles in Banjar Regency, Indonesia, with 32 suspected cases reported by early March 2026. Authorities emphasize immunization as the most effective measure to halt transmission, per the Banjar Regency Health Office’s (P2P) head Marzuki. Despite free vaccines and health-worker-led, door-to-door immunization campaigns, parental hesitancy persists due to misinformation about adverse effects, spreading faster than health education. Officials note refusals occur in both urban and rural areas, underscoring the need for sustained outreach. Health workers actively visit villages to deliver immunization services, aiming to raise uptake and contain the suspected measles cases, preventing a broader outbreak. The article highlights misinformation as a barrier to vaccination across urban and rural communities.

triage.triage_reason: 麻疹疑い例32件の報告だが、確定例数・重症度・国際拡大リスクの詳細が不明。ワクチン忌避による地域的アウトブレイクの可能性があり、続報による情報補完が必要。
triage.notes: 疑い例のみで確定診断数不明。麻疹はWPRO地域で依然として問題となる疾患だが、インドネシアでの麻疹報告自体は珍しくない。ワクチン忌避（反ワクチン情報拡散）が都市部・農村部双方で課題となっており、当局が戸別訪問による予防接種キャンペーンを実施中。重症例・死亡例の言及なし。国際的拡大の具体的リスク情報なし。続報で確定例数・患者転帰・疫学的リンク・周辺地域への拡大状況を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Anak Rentan Tertular Campak saat Libur Lebaran, Dokter Sarankan Vaksinasi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vulnerable Children Contract Measles During Eid al-Fitr Holiday, Doctor Recommends Vaccination
article.articleSummary: Measles risk rises among Indonesian children during Eid al-Fitr holiday as increased travel and gatherings raise exposure, according to a pediatrician from RS Pondok Indah - Bintaro Jaya. Measles is highly contagious via respiratory droplets and contaminated surfaces; infected individuals can transmit about four days before to four days after rash onset, and the virus can linger in the air for up to two hours in poorly ventilated spaces. Early symptoms resemble a common respiratory infection, with a facial/neck rash that spreads to the rest of the body. Complications include pneumonia with rapid breathing, encephalitis with altered consciousness or seizures, ADEM weeks after infection, diarrhea with dehydration, and secondary bacterial infections. There is no specific antiviral; care is supportive. IDAI-recommended MR vaccination in three doses (9 months, 15–18 months, 5–7 years) aims for herd immunity; vaccination protects unvaccinated infants; practice hygiene and masks during gatherings.

triage.triage_reason: 季節性の麻疹リスク増加に関する予防喚起記事。ワクチン接種推奨が主題であり、現時点でアウトブレイクや異常事態の報告はない。ただし「Unknown Encephalitis」が疾患リストに含まれている点は要注意。続報で実際の症例数や脳炎の詳細が判明すれば再評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は医師による予防的な注意喚起が中心で、具体的な症例数・発生動向・異常性に関する情報は含まれていない。麻疹は高度に感染性があり集団免疫が重要だが、本記事は季節的な渡航増加に伴う一般的なリスク啓発と判断される。ただし疾患リストに「Unknown Encephalitis」が含まれている理由が不明確であり、実際に原因不明の脳炎症例が背景にある可能性も否定できない。続報で症例の集積や異常なパターンが報告されればPICKUPへ格上げを検討すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Deputy minister urges regional govts to speed up TB control efforts
article.articleSummary: TB in Indonesia's West Java remains a priority, with Deputy Home Affairs Minister Akhmad Wiyagus urging regional governments to accelerate control efforts in areas where TB case numbers are high. He stressed TB is endemic and requires transparent reporting and strong planning and budgeting at the district-to-village level, warning against withholding real data that could hinder effective strategies. Village heads and community health cadres are pivotal for outreach, early detection, and treatment. Control efforts must address risk factors such as overcrowded housing, poor ventilation, poverty, and inadequate sanitation, necessitating cross-sector collaboration among health authorities, local governments, and community organizations. Integrated TB management programs are expected to reduce infection and improve public health. Indonesia targets TB elimination by 2030, per Presidential Regulation No. 67 of 2021.

triage.triage_reason: インドネシア西ジャワ州の結核対策に関する政府の定例的な取り組み強化の呼びかけであり、異常事態・予想外の事象ではない。新規アウトブレイクや重症度の増加、国際的拡大リスクを示唆する情報は含まれていない。
triage.notes: 本記事は副内務大臣による地方政府への結核対策強化の呼びかけであり、2030年の結核撲滅目標（大統領規則67/2021）に基づく政策的な取り組みの一環。具体的な症例数増加、新たなアウトブレイク、薬剤耐性株の出現などの疫学的異常は報告されていない。風土病としての継続的管理の文脈であり、緊急性のあるシグナルとは評価できない。

article.articleHeadline: Antisipasi Sebaran Campak dan Kecelakaan, 2.700 Pos Kesehatan Tersedia di Jalur Mudik
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anticipating the Spread of Measles and Accidents, 2,700 Health Posts Are Available Along the Mudik Route.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia is preparing about 2,700 health posts along the mudik route for Idulfitri 2026 to ensure safety and health access. Coordinating Minister Pratikno noted rising health-service demand during mass travel. Free health screenings for bus drivers are conducted two weeks before duty to reduce accident risk; 338 drivers have been screened at 18 pool terminals in Central Java and West Java. Screenings cover blood pressure, blood glucose, alcohol, and NAPZA; those fit may drive, others receive treatment until fit. Measles risk is being monitored: 2025 saw over 63,000 suspected cases with 11,000 laboratory-confirmed; 2026 suspected cases are rising. Authorities urge complete measles immunization for children via puskesmas, posyandu, or local health facilities, and to verify vaccination status.

triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで麻疹の疑い例が2026年に増加傾向にあり、2025年には63,000例以上の疑い例と11,000例の検査確定例が報告されている。ただし、2026年の具体的な症例数・重症度・国際拡大リスクに関する情報が不足しているため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 麻疹は高い感染力を持つワクチン予防可能疾患であり、2025年の検査確定例11,000例は公衆衛生上の懸念事項。インドネシア政府はムディク（帰省ラッシュ）期間中の大規模人口移動を見据え、2,700箇所の健康ポスト設置と予防接種の推奨を実施している。2026年の疑い例が増加傾向との記述があるが、具体的な症例数・地理的分布・ワクチン接種率・死亡例の有無などの詳細情報が不足している。大規模人口移動による国内・国際的拡大リスクの評価には続報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Waspada Saat Mudik, Jawa Barat Masuk 5 Besar KLB Campak Nasional
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Be vigilant during Mudik; West Java ranks among the top five in the national measles outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 February 2026, Indonesia reports 8,224 suspected measles cases and 4 deaths, with 21 outbreaks (KLB) in 17 districts/cities across 11 provinces; 13 KLBs in six provinces are laboratory-confirmed. The provinces with the most KLB are West Sumatra, South Sumatra, DI Yogyakarta, West Java, and Central Java, with West Java among the top five. Health officials attribute the resurgence in part to vaccine hesitancy, warning that measles is highly contagious and unvaccinated children risk serious complications such as encephalitis, blindness, pneumonia, and severe malnutrition. Authorities urge early prevention, self-isolation, masking, and seeking care at health facilities. West Java Dinas Kesehatan is intensifying outbreak management and conducting Outbreak Response Immunization (ORI) in affected areas, including Bogor Regency, Cirebon City, and Garut Regency, ahead of the Mudik travel season.
