article.articleHeadline: Variante da influenza conhecida como gripe K aumenta casos no mundo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza variant known as the K flu increases cases worldwide.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A (H3N2) variant called K flu (J.2.4.1) has driven a global rise in seasonal influenza since August 2025, with detections across Europe, Asia, North America, and Brazil by late 2025. It is a genetic evolution, not a new disease, carrying seven mutations that may help immune escape. The World Health Organization reports no evidence that K worsens disease severity or raises pandemic risk. The 2026 vaccine, defined in September 2025, did not include K because its surge occurred after formulation. Brazil’s Butantan-produced flu vaccine for the National Immunization Program contains an H3N2 component from which K originated, plus H1N1 and B strains. Vaccination remains essential, with data suggesting vaccinated people infected with K have protection against severe symptoms. Since April 2025, influenza vaccination is in Brazil’s National Schedule for certain groups; the 2026 campaign starts in March 2026.

triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザA(H3N2)の新変異株（K株/J.2.4.1）による世界的な症例増加が報告されているが、WHOは重症化や pandemic リスクの増加を認めていない。ワクチン対応や疫学的動向を継続監視すべき状況。
triage.notes: 2025年8月以降、K株（J.2.4.1）が欧州・アジア・北米・ブラジルで検出され世界的に季節性インフルエンザが増加。7つの変異による免疫逃避の可能性があるが、WHOは重症度やパンデミックリスクの上昇は確認していない。2026年ワクチンはK株急増前に製造されたためK株を含まないが、元となったH3N2成分は含有。ワクチン接種者はK株感染時も重症化予防効果がある可能性。ブラジルでは2026年3月からワクチンキャンペーン開始予定。情報源がブラジル地方紙のため、WHO・ECDC等の公式情報との照合が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Cidade de São Paulo confirma 1° caso de sarampo de 2026 em uma bebê de seis meses com histórico de viagem à Bolívia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: City of São Paulo confirms the first measles case of 2026 in a six-month-old infant with travel history to Bolivia.
article.articleSummary: Measles diagnosed in São Paulo, Brazil, marking the first 2026 case in the municipality. A six‑month‑old female infant, unvaccinated, developed fever and exanthem on 8 February after travel between 25 December 2025 and 25 January 2026 to Bolivia. Laboratory confirmation occurred on 4 March following genomic sequencing by the reference laboratory. The case triggered local and state epidemiological response, including surveillance, vaccination campaigns, and contact tracing with 30 days of monitoring. Bolivia has an ongoing measles outbreak, prompting regional concern at the Brazilian border with Mato Grosso do Sul; in 2025 Brazil reported at least 22 imported measles cases, predominantly in Tocantins among Bolivian residents. Health authorities reiterate vaccination as the main preventive measure, with the trivalent vaccine and age‑based schedules; healthcare workers are advised to maintain full immunization.

triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（国際的拡大リスク、異常性、渡航制限可能性）。ボリビアでの継続的流行と国境を越えた輸入症例であり、未接種乳児の感染はWPRO基準の重症度・流行しやすさにも該当。国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念あり。
triage.notes: ボリビアで継続中の麻疹流行からの輸入症例。2025年にブラジルで22例の輸入症例（主にトカンティンス州のボリビア住民）が報告されており、国境地域での継続的リスクあり。生後6ヶ月の未接種乳児という脆弱集団での発症。接触者追跡30日間実施中。ゲノム解析による確定診断済み。地域・州レベルでの疫学対応および予防接種キャンペーン実施中。国際的な麻疹排除目標への影響が懸念される事例。

article.articleHeadline: MLA Rajesh Reddy Launches FMD Vaccination Program
article.articleSummary: Free Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD) vaccination program launched on 11 March 2026 in Mantati and Tudukurthi villages of Nagarkurnool district by MLA Kuchukulla Rajesh Reddy. During the event, 216 buffaloes and 156 cattle were vaccinated. Sarpanch Lakshmi Karunakar Reddy, Vice-Sarpanch Venkataiah, former MPP Narasimha Reddy, and veterinary staff Madhya, Srisailam, Vinay, Satish, Kurumurthy, Pullayya, Parvathalu, Lingaswamy and Praveen participated. Mandal Veterinary Officer Dr. Kalpana advised farmers to ensure livestock vaccinations and to register animals on the Bharat Pashudhan App; ear tags were affixed for identification and details updated in the app. Farmers were urged to utilize this vaccination program to protect livestock.

triage.triage_reason: 定期的な家畜予防接種プログラムの実施報告であり、異常な疾病発生やアウトブレイクを示す情報は含まれていない。公衆衛生への直接的影響もなく、通常の獣医衛生活動の範囲内。
triage.notes: 本情報は口蹄疫の新規発生ではなく、予防的な無料ワクチン接種プログラムの開始を報じるもの。2026年3月11日にNagarkurnool地区で実施され、水牛216頭と牛156頭にワクチン接種が行われた。獣医当局は家畜登録アプリの利用と個体識別タグの装着を推奨。疾病発生の報告はなく、通常の予防衛生措置である。

article.articleHeadline: L'épidémie de choléra déclarée dans la zone de santé de Mwenga, 5
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cholera outbreak declared in Mwenga Health Zone, 5.
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak declared in Mwenga Health Zone, Mwenga Territory, South Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo. 28 cases and 5 deaths to date, including 3 community deaths and 2 in healthcare facilities. Declared in the 9th epidemiological week after biological confirmation of 5 positive samples from 8 collected. Three health areas are affected: Biganda, Tuseswa, and Kalole. The South Kivu Provincial Health Division provided initial support with 150 liters of Ringer's lactate, infusion kits, and chlorine for disinfection. The authorities note the absence of a dedicated cholera treatment center and highlight insufficient access to potable water as key drivers of transmission. Health officials urge adherence to hygiene measures, regular hand washing, drinking-water treatment, and prompt medical consultation at health facilities if symptoms appear.

triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、異常性）、WHOスクリーニング基準4項目該当。コレラ流行で致死率約18%と高く、専用治療施設欠如・飲料水不足により管理困難。国境地域（ブルンジ隣接）での発生で国際的拡大リスクあり。
triage.notes: 南キブ州Mwenga保健区域でコレラ流行宣言（28例・5死亡、致死率17.9%）。第9疫学週に8検体中5検体陽性で生物学的確認。3保健地区（Biganda、Tuseswa、Kalole）が影響。専用コレラ治療センター不在、飲料水アクセス不足が伝播要因。州保健局が初期支援（輸液150L等）実施も外部支援必要性高い。ブルンジ・カルジ州も発生地域リストに含まれ越境リスクあり。DRC東部の不安定な治安・人道状況下での流行拡大懸念。

article.articleHeadline: Sorocaba confirma quarto e quinto casos de raiva em morcegos em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sorocaba Confirms Fourth and Fifth Rabies Cases in Bats in 2026.
article.articleSummary: As of 11 March 2026, Sorocaba, Brazil, confirms two new rabies cases in bats, bringing the 2026 count to four and five in the municipality. A bat found in Jardim Itanguá II on 18 February and another in Jardim Iporanga I on 23 February tested positive for rabies after laboratory confirmation released on 9 March. Zoonoses teams have initiated containment actions in both neighborhoods, conducting door-to-door outreach within a 500-meter radius of the discovery sites. Officials educate residents on bat behavior, rabies risks, and proper responses to abnormal animals; distribute informational materials; and inspect potential bat roosts in homes. Active surveillance is ongoing to identify possible contact between bats and dogs, cats, or people. If domestic animals may have contacted bats, vaccination is reinforced; if human exposure is suspected, residents are referred for medical evaluation and possible post-exposure treatment. No immediate risk to the public.

triage.triage_reason: 動物における狂犬病検出であり、人への直接的影響は現時点で報告されていない。ただし、狂犬病は致死率が極めて高く、地域での継続的なサーベイランスと予防措置が必要なため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 2026年に入り同市で4-5例目のコウモリ狂犬病確認。当局は500m範囲での戸別訪問、住民教育、予防接種強化等の封じ込め措置を実施中。人への曝露疑い例は医療評価へ紹介。現時点で一般市民への即座のリスクはないとされるが、コウモリ-ペット-人への感染連鎖リスクがあるため継続監視が必要。ブラジルでのコウモリ狂犬病は珍しくないため「異常」には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Health Minister calls for accelerated leprosy screening, surveillance
article.articleSummary: Indonesia ranks third globally in leprosy cases, with about 16,000 cases reported in recent years; Health Minister Budi Gunadi Sadikin urges accelerated screening and surveillance to eliminate the disease. He announced integration of leprosy screening into the Free Health Check (CKG) program during World Leprosy Day in Jakarta. Despite progress, many remain ashamed to be screened due to stigma and myths that leprosy is a curse. The ministry will reward regions that identify the most cases to boost active case finding. Treatment uses rifampicin, with dapsone-based regimens, aiming for about six months. To bolster eastern Indonesia surveillance, genome sequencing will be added, due to some people there being sensitive to dapsone. Upon diagnosis, patients require immediate, complete treatment, and close contacts receive prophylaxis and preventive medications, following TB-like protocols. Addressing stigma remains the major challenge, including marginalized patients historically shamed or shackled.

triage.triage_reason: インドネシアのハンセン病対策強化に関する政策発表であり、世界第3位の症例数を持つが、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態ではなく、既存の風土病対策の強化施策。国際的拡大リスクは低いが、症例数規模と対策動向は継続監視が望ましい。
triage.notes: 世界ハンセン病デーに合わせた政策発表で、年間約16,000例の既知の風土病状況。治療プロトコルは確立済み（リファンピシン+ダプソン、約6ヶ月）。主な課題はスティグマによる受診控えと東部地域でのダプソン感受性問題。ゲノムシーケンス導入など対策強化中だが、緊急性の高い新規事態ではない。結核様の接触者予防投薬プロトコルを採用。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Padang Konfirmasi 7 Kasus Campak, Orangtua Diimbau Waspada!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Padang Health Office Confirms 7 Measles Cases, Parents Urged to Be Vigilant!
article.articleSummary: On 11 March 2026, Padang City Health Office confirmed seven locally acquired measles cases, signaling active viral circulation in the community. Official dr. Srikurnia Yati warned that measles is highly contagious and current cases indicate rising risk, especially for children with incomplete immunization. Early symptoms include high fever, cough, runny nose, red eyes, and rash; complications such as diarrhea, pneumonia, and encephalitis can be fatal. Parents are urged to verify their children’s vaccination status at Puskesmas, posyandu, or hospitals, and to bring children aged 9-59 months for immunization if needed. Do not ignore initial measles signs and seek prompt medical care.

triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の市中感染が確認され、ワクチン未接種児への拡大リスクと脳炎等の重篤合併症の可能性があり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が懸念される。IHR基準2つ以上該当し、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 麻疹は高い感染力を持ち、不完全なワクチン接種状況下では急速に拡大する可能性がある。脳炎を含む重篤合併症のリスクがあり、保健当局が公式に警告を発している点で社会的関心が高い。症例数7例は小規模だが市中感染が確認されており、続報による疫学的詳細（年齢分布、ワクチン接種歴、地理的分布、遺伝子型）の確認が重要。インドネシアにおける麻疹の背景発生率との比較も必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue cases in Johor drops 21.2% in Epi Week 09/2026
article.articleSummary: Johor dengue cases in Epi Week 09/2026 total 928, down 21.2% from 1,178 in Epi Week 09/2025. Locality cases 311 (33.5%), non-locality/imported 617 (66.5%). One death occurred in Epi Week 09/2026, compared with two in the prior year period. Johor Baru district leads with 53 cases (71.6%), Kulai 7 (9.5%), and Kluang and Pontian 3 each (4.1%). Batu Pahat, Kota Tinggi, Muar and Segamat each have 2 cases (2.7%), while Mersing and Tangkak report none. Kluang hotspots: Kahang, Kluang, Layang-Layang, Machap, Nyior, Paloh, Renggam, Ulu Benut. Pontian hotspots: Air Masin, Api-Api, Ayer Baloi, Benut, Jeram Batu/Parit Raja, Pontian, Rimba Terjun, Serkat, Sungai Karang, Sungai Pinggan. Data are as of Epi Week 09/2026 (reported 11 March 2026), reflecting ongoing vector-control needs in Johor.

triage.triage_reason: マレーシア・ジョホール州のデング熱発生は前年同期比で21.2%減少しており、異常・予想外の事象ではない。ただし非局所性/輸入症例が66.5%を占め、継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 2026年第9週のジョホール州デング熱症例は928例で前年同期（1,178例）から21.2%減少。死亡は1例（前年2例）。輸入/非局所性症例が全体の66.5%（617例）を占める点は注視が必要だが、現時点で異常な増加や重症化の兆候はない。ベクターコントロール継続中。インドネシア・アチェ州も発生地域に含まれているが詳細不明。

article.articleHeadline: Ciri-ciri Campak yang Perlu Diketahui, dari Gejala Awal hingga Masa Pemulihan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Signs of measles you need to know, from early symptoms to the recovery period
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-03-11, measles cases are rising in several countries, including Indonesia. Measles (rubeola) is a highly contagious viral infection that mainly affects children and presents with high fever and a characteristic rash. It is vaccine-preventable, but remains a leading cause of child mortality where immunization coverage is low. Early phases can resemble flu, dengue, or COVID-19, making awareness of the disease course essential for early diagnosis and care. Measles can weaken the immune system and lead to serious complications such as pneumonia, encephalitis, severe diarrhea, and even blindness. The virus transmits via the air, with the prodromal phase before rash often the most contagious, necessitating early isolation to prevent spread. Information cited from Rumah Sakit Pusat Pertamina.

triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の症例増加が報告されているが、症例数・地理的範囲・重症度などの具体的データが不足しており、公衆衛生上の影響度を判定できない。ワクチン予防可能疾患であり免疫率低下地域でのリスクは既知であるため、続報で詳細情報を確認する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は麻疹の一般的な症状・感染経路・合併症に関する啓発情報が中心で、具体的な症例数・発生地域・時系列データが記載されていない。インドネシアを含む複数国で症例増加とあるが規模不明。麻疹は高度伝染性でヒト-ヒト感染するため epidemic_prone=Yes と評価。ワクチン接種率・アウトブレイクの地理的広がり・国際的拡大の可能性について続報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Evolution and spillover dynamics of yellow fever at the forest-urban interface in Brazil - Nature Microbiology
article.articleSummary: Yellow fever virus (YFV) outbreaks at the forest-urban interface in Brazil arise from interactions among vector ecology, host susceptibility and environmental drivers. In PEAL, a northern São Paulo Atlantic Forest fragment within the UNESCO São Paulo Green Belt Biosphere Reserve, YFV confirmation prompted targeted entomological surveillance (Dec 2017–Oct 2018) near non-human primate carcasses across 39 points over 40 weeks. Haemagogus mosquitoes, especially Hg. leucocelaenus, rose in tandem with sentinel NHP deaths, signaling a brief window for intervention before transmission intensifies across successive host–mosquito generations. Mosquito captures spanned forest edges, peridomestic zones and canopy; specimens were identified and pooled for analysis. Meteorological data from ERA5-Land and population grids were used to model monthly Haemagogus counts with negative-binomial GLMs, reporting rate ratios per °C and per unit rainfall. The work underscores rapid detection-to-action and multisource surveillance aligned with WHO elimination strategies to protect humans and wildlife.

triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロでの黄熱ウイルスの森林-都市境界域における流行動態を報告。媒介蚊と非ヒト霊長類の死亡が連動し、ヒトへの伝播拡大前の介入機会が短期間であることを示唆。都市近郊での黄熱伝播リスクが国際的関心事項であり、WHO elimination strategiesとも整合するため、フルRRAの対象とすべき。
triage.notes: 森林-都市境界域での黄熱伝播は都市型流行への移行リスクを伴う。媒介蚊Haemagogus leucocelaenusの動態と非ヒト霊長類の死亡が同期し、ヒトへの感染拡大前の介入期間が限定的。UNESCO生物圏保護区内での発生であり、生態学的・疫学的に重要。Nature Microbiologyでの発表は科学的関心の高さを示す。ワクチン未接種者への曝露リスク、都市型媒介蚊Aedes aegyptiへの伝播可能性、サンパウロ大都市圏への波及懸念から、継続的な疫学的・昆虫学的サーベイランスとリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: अब ऊंट बचाएगा डेंगू से! भारतीय वैज्ञानिकों की रिसर्च में चौंकाने वाला खुलासा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Now camels will save us from dengue! Shocking revelation in Indian scientists' research.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever research in India shows camelid nanobodies offering a potential new therapeutic path. Indian Institute of Science Education and Research (IISER) Mohali scientists, led by Dr. Sharvan Seharavat, report that nanobodies derived from camels effectively neutralize dengue virus and can target all four major dengue serotypes. As dengue is transmitted by Aedes aegypti, and can progress to dengue hemorrhagic fever or dengue shock syndrome, there is no specific cure today; WHO estimates about 390 million infections annually worldwide, with roughly 100 million symptomatic cases, and management remains supportive. The study suggests that these mini antibodies bind to viral proteins and block entry into human cells, offering promise for future antivirals or vaccines. The work is in early stages and will require extensive clinical testing before any use in patients, in India or globally. Prior work also noted nanobodies against SARS-CoV-2.

triage.triage_reason: 研究段階の科学的知見の報道であり、新規アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態ではない。デング熱に対するラクダ由来ナノ抗体の研究成果の紹介であり、実際の疾患発生イベントではないため、シグナルトリアージの対象外と判断。
triage.notes: 本記事はIISER Mohaliの研究チームによるデング熱治療薬開発に関する基礎研究の報道。実際の感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生イベントではなく、将来的な治療法の可能性を示す科学研究の段階。臨床試験前の段階であり、即時の公衆衛生対応を要する事象ではない。EBSシステムが拾うべき「感染症イベント」には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: First study on drug-resistant malaria in Bangladesh
article.articleSummary: icddr,b, in collaboration with the National Malaria Elimination Programme and BRAC, will launch Bangladesh's first surveillance study to identify drug-resistant malaria strains in Rohingya refugee camps in Cox's Bazar, near the Bangladesh–Myanmar border. Funded by Global Affairs Canada, researchers will enrol malaria patients from selected camps and nearby facilities, collect blood samples, and analyze parasite genetics to detect resistance, with a focus on artemisinin-based combination therapy (ACT) and parasite clearance rates. The study responds to concerns about resistant malaria spreading from Myanmar and the risk of crossing into Bangladesh, which could threaten the national goal of malaria elimination by 2030. More than 1.18 million Rohingya live in 33 camps; 2021 malaria cases reached 291, predominantly Plasmodium falciparum linked to travel to endemic areas or cross-border movement. Enrollment begins in April; a March 10 coordination meeting preceded the March 11 press release.

triage.triage_reason: 薬剤耐性マラリアの国際的拡大リスクがあり、IHR基準2つ以上該当。ミャンマーからバングラデシュへの耐性株伝播の可能性があり、2030年マラリア排除目標への脅威となる重要なシグナル。
triage.notes: ロヒンギャ難民キャンプ（118万人超）における薬剤耐性マラリア監視研究の開始。ミャンマーから耐性株（特にアルテミシニン耐性）が国境を越えて伝播するリスクがあり、バングラデシュの2030年マラリア排除目標に影響。国際機関（icddr,b、Global Affairs Canada）の支援下で実施される公衆衛生上重要な監視活動。Plasmodium falciparum症例の多くが越境移動・流行地渡航歴と関連しており、国際的な感染拡大の監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 香港疑出現男男性接觸者甲肝感染群組　　19:10
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hong Kong suspects a hepatitis A infection cluster among men who have sex with men, 19:10.
article.articleSummary: Hepatitis A outbreak cluster detected in Hong Kong among men who have sex with men (MSM). On March 11, 2026, the Centre for Health Protection announced a molecularly confirmed cluster, identifying 24 hepatitis A cases in the past six months with identical HAV genome sequences, involving 22 men and 2 women. Ages range 18–55; 14 cases are MSM, accounting for over 60%. Epidemiology shows no overlapping residential or dining locations among cases, but the centre does not rule out MSM-related transmission links. Hong Kong previously experienced an MSM-associated HAV transmission chain from 2015–2017, curtailed by targeted vaccination. International data show outbreaks beyond food transmission within MSM groups. To curb the chain, starting March 12, 2026, CHP will offer free two-dose HAV vaccination by appointment to MSM; public health notes chains may persist for months to up to a year.

triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事象、国際拡大リスク）。さらにWPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当し、特定集団における分子疫学的に確認されたクラスター感染として緊急対応（無料ワクチン接種プログラム）が開始されている。過去の類似事例（2015-2017年）の経験から、国際的に注目される事象であり、フルRRAによる詳細評価が必要。
triage.notes: 24例が分子疫学的に同一のHAVゲノム配列を持つクラスターとして確認され、MSM集団での感染連鎖が強く示唆される。過去2015-2017年の同様事例では標的ワクチン接種で封じ込めに成功した経緯があり、今回も2026年3月12日から無料2回接種プログラムを開始。国際的にもMSM集団におけるHAV伝播は食品由来以外の経路として認識されており、他国への波及可能性を含めた評価が必要。感染連鎖は数ヶ月から最長1年継続する可能性が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox: ES confirma segundo caso da doença em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox: Espírito Santo confirms second mpox case in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Mpox has a second confirmed case in Espírito Santo, Brazil, in 2026. The patient is a man aged 20–49 from Serra (Greater Vitória); the first case was in Colatina. In 2026, Espírito Santo recorded 44 suspected mpox notices: 2 confirmed, 30 discarded, 6 as loss of segment, and 6 still under investigation. Mpox is caused by MPXV (Orthopoxvirus) and mainly spreads between people via direct skin contact with lesions, body fluids, close respiratory contact, or contaminated objects. Symptoms typically appear 3–16 days after exposure (up to 21), and include skin lesions, fever, lymphadenopathy, headache, myalgia, chills, and fatigue; lesions progress from macules to vesicles to crusts. Diagnosis relies on lab testing of lesion material; treatment is supportive; no widely available specific antiviral. Vaccination is for high-risk groups: immunosuppressed people with HIV/AIDS, laboratory workers handling Orthopoxviruses, and exposed individuals after risk assessment.

triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・エスピリトサント州における2026年の2例目のmpox確定例であり、散発的な発生パターンで国際的拡大のリスクは限定的。疾患の特性や対応体制も既知の範囲内であり、異常性・予想外の要素は認められない。
triage.notes: 2026年に州内で44件の疑い例中2件のみが確定、30件は除外されており、感染拡大は限定的。mpoxの臨床像・伝播様式・対策は既知であり、ハイリスク群へのワクチン接種体制も整備されている。単一州内の散発例報告であり、フルRRAの対象とはならない。

article.articleHeadline: 哈密瓜是唯一自带李斯特菌的水果，孕妇绝对不能吃？
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hami melon is the only fruit that carries Listeria monocytogenes; pregnant women must not eat it?
article.articleSummary: Cantaloupe (Hami melon) does not inherently carry Listeria monocytogenes; Listeria is a widespread environmental bacterium that can contaminate many foods, including fruits like strawberries, blueberries, peaches, and watermelon, via soil, water, or processing—contamination, not an intrinsic property of the fruit. Historical cantaloupe-linked listeriosis outbreaks include 23 outbreaks from 1984–2002 with 1,434 illnesses and 42 hospitalizations; the 2011 Colorado outbreak caused 33 deaths; and the 2018 New South Wales outbreak infected at least 19 people with multiple fatalities and one pregnancy loss. Cantaloupe is particularly prone to contamination due to growing close to the ground, its rough netted rind, and post-harvest handling; cutting can transfer surface bacteria into the flesh. High-risk groups (pregnant women, newborns, elderly, immunocompromised) are especially vulnerable to severe outcomes if infected. Practical guidance for pregnant women: wash the rind before cutting, use clean knives and boards, eat promptly, and prefer fresh, at-home cut fruit over pre-cut packages.

triage.triage_reason: 本記事は哈密瓜（ハミウリ）とリステリア菌に関する一般的な衛生情報・教育記事であり、新規発生や異常事態の報告ではない。過去のアウトブレイク事例（1984-2002年、2011年コロラド、2018年ニューサウスウェールズ）への言及はあるが、現在進行中のイベントは確認できず、公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は妊婦向けの食品安全啓発コンテンツであり、新規のリステリア症アウトブレイクの報告ではない。過去の事例に触れているが、現在のイベントとしての公衆衛生上の意義は認められない。教育・予防啓発目的の一般情報記事と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Жителям Ленобласти сообщили о всевозможных рисках заболевания жёлтой лихорадкой
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Residents of Leningrad Oblast were informed about the various risks of contracting yellow fever.
article.articleSummary: Yellow fever is an acute viral disease transmitted by Aedes and Haemagogus mosquitoes, highlighted by regional authorities in Leningrad Oblast. Endemic zones include tropical Africa and South America, with Nigeria, the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, Brazil, and Peru cited. Transmission occurs via forest (sylvatic) cycles (wild monkeys to mosquitoes), an intermediate cycle common in Africa, and urban transmission from person to person through mosquitoes. Incubation lasts 4–6 days. About 15% of infections progress to a severe form with high fever, jaundice, renal and hepatic failure, and bleeding; mortality for this form can reach 20–50%. Vaccination is mandatory and the sole reliable protection, required for entry into most countries. The vaccine is available to adults and children aged 9 months and older; immunity develops in about 10 days and lasts lifelong. An International Certificate of Vaccination is issued; without it, entry may be denied or quarantine imposed for up to six days, so vaccination should be completed before travel.

triage.triage_reason: 黄熱に関する一般的な啓発情報であり、新規発生や異常事態の報告ではない。ロシア・レニングラード州住民への渡航前予防接種に関する公衆衛生情報提供と判断される。
triage.notes: 本記事は黄熱の疾患概要、流行地域（アフリカ・南米）、感染経路、症状、予防接種の重要性を説明する教育的内容。具体的な症例数、発生日時、患者情報の記載なし。ロシア国内での黄熱発生ではなく、流行地域への渡航者向けの予防啓発と考えられる。新規イベントではないためDISMISS判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil registra aumento de casos de Mpox e total confirmado chega a 140 em 2026 - Portal Comunica News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil records an increase in Mpox cases and the total confirmed reaches 140 in 2026 - Portal Comunica News
article.articleSummary: Mpox cases in Brazil reach 140 confirmed in 2026, with no deaths thus far this year, according to the Ministry of Health dashboard. Brazilian authorities report 539 suspected cases and 9 probable cases under investigation. São Paulo leads in case counts, followed by Rio de Janeiro and Rondônia, with most diagnoses concentrated between January and February and additional confirmations in early March 2026. The surveillance system emphasizes ongoing monitoring, early detection, contact tracing, and public guidance to limit transmission. Mpox is a viral disease in the same family as smallpox; the incubation period ranges from 3 to 16 days. Health officials advise individuals with compatible symptoms to seek medical care and avoid close contact, particularly while skin lesions are present. Since national monitoring began in 2022, Brazil has reported over 14,000 mpox diagnoses and some deaths, underscoring persistent public health vigilance.

triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで2026年に140例のMpox確認例が報告され、São Paulo州が最多。2022年以降累計14,000例超の診断歴があるが、2026年は死亡例なし。国内監視体制は機能しているものの、疑い例539例・調査中9例があり続報による重症度・国際拡大リスクの評価が必要。
triage.notes: 2026年1-3月初旬に140例確認、死亡例なし。2022年以降の累計14,000例超・死亡例ありの実績から、ブラジル国内では既知の疾患として監視体制が確立。現時点では異常・予想外の事態ではなく、重症度も限定的。ただし疑い例539例が調査中であり、クレード情報・ヒト-ヒト感染様式・国際的拡大の詳細が不明なため、続報での重症化動向・周辺国への波及の有無を注視する必要あり。

locations.name: San Fernando del Valle de Catamarca

article.articleHeadline: Preocupación: Catamarca confirmó el primer caso de chikungunya - Diario Panorama
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Concern: Catamarca confirms the first chikungunya case - Diario Panorama.
article.articleSummary: As of March 11, 2026, Catamarca, Argentina confirms its first chikungunya case: a 40-year-old female resident of the eastern sector of the Capital with no travel history and no prior dengue, currently clinically stable. A cohabiting minor with compatible symptoms is under evaluation; other household members are asymptomatic. Epidemic surveillance is activated, with planned focal vector control and a sanitary barrier in the area when weather allows. Nationally, 2,217 suspected chikungunya cases have been reported this season, with 47 confirmed or probable. In CABA, Buenos Aires, Córdoba, Chaco and Entre Ríos, most cases have travel history to Bolivia, Brazil, Paraguay or Cuba and are classified as imported. Salta has 51 cases, predominantly without travel history, indicating local transmission; Yerba Buena, Tucumán reports 2 confirmed without travel. Travelers are advised to use mosquito protection and seek care for sudden fever with body pains or headache, reporting travel history.

triage.triage_reason: アルゼンチンでチクングニア熱の地域内感染が複数州で確認されており、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への影響が懸念される。IHR基準3つ該当、WPRO基準4つ該当でシグナルとして識別。
triage.notes: カタマルカ州で初の症例（渡航歴なし）、サルタ州では51例の大半が地域内感染、トゥクマン州でも渡航歴なし2例確認。全国で2,217疑い例・47確定/可能性例。ベクター対策と衛生バリア設置が計画されている。周辺国（ボリビア、ブラジル、パラグアイ、キューバ）からの輸入例も多数あり、地域的な流行拡大の様相を呈している。

article.articleHeadline: Everest spices under scrutiny: What is Enterobacteriaceae and why can it be harmful?
article.articleSummary: Everest Spices faces safety concerns after lab tests found pesticide residues and Enterobacteriaceae contamination in popular spice blends sold in India. Tests reportedly detected acetamiprid and azoxystrobin in Everest Garam Masala and similar pesticides in Everest Kitchen King Masala, with bacterial contamination exceeding limits set by the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India. The Enterobacteriaceae family—including Escherichia coli and Salmonella enterica—can cause gastrointestinal infections with symptoms such as diarrhoea, vomiting, stomach cramps, and food poisoning, posing higher risk for children, older adults, and immunocompromised individuals. Contamination can occur during processing due to improper handling, drying of raw ingredients, and unsanitary storage or packaging. The findings follow earlier questions about other brands like Amul, Mother Dairy, Country Delight over coliform bacteria. Consumers are urged to demand stricter quality controls, lab transparency, and FSSAI enforcement to safeguard packaged spices in India.

triage.triage_reason: 食品安全上の細菌汚染事例であり、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性がなく、限定的な製品汚染による散発的なリスクと判断。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当要素が少なく、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 特定ブランドのスパイス製品における腸内細菌科細菌と農薬残留の検出事例。消費者保護・食品安全規制の問題であり、感染症アウトブレイクではない。同様の事例が他ブランドでも報告されているが、疾病発生の規模・重症度に関する情報はなく、食品リコール・品質管理強化で対応可能な範囲と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Gia Lai đẩy mạnh tái đàn heo, chú trọng an toàn dịch bệnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gia Lai steps up pig herd restocking, prioritizing disease safety.
article.articleSummary: After Tet, pig farmers in Gia Lai province, Vietnam, are restocking with a strong emphasis on biosecurity to prevent diseases, notably African swine fever (ASF). Đỗ Đình Tuấn of An Khê ward restocks to about 500 pigs (200 initially, 300 planned) after building a 1,000 m² facility in Kông Bờ La, with routine cleaning, disinfection, and vaccination. In Pleiku, Hoàng Văn Thành restocks about 120 pigs, prioritizing clearly sourced breeding stock, biosecurity, hygiene, and vaccination. Large firms like Nam Sài Gòn Livestock Co. in Ia Hiao maintain around 16,000 market pigs and restock in phased batches; Q2 plans to add 15–20% to pre-Tết levels as demand stabilizes from March. Authorities caution restocking amid ASF risk, urging sanitation and disease-control measures, especially for smallholders.

triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱（ASF）の再発事例ではなく、ベトナム・Gia Lai省における養豚農家の豚群再構築（restocking）活動と予防対策の実施状況に関する通常の報道。ヒト健康への直接的影響はなく、動物疾病管理の一環として既知のASFリスク地域での予防的取り組みを紹介しているに過ぎない。

sociopolitical_concern.notes: 地方当局がASFリスクを警告しているが、新規発生報告ではなく予防措置の推奨

triage.notes: ASFは家畜疾病であり公衆衛生上の緊急事態には該当しない。記事は新規アウトブレイクではなく、既知のリスク地域における養豚業の通常の再構築活動（テト明け後の季節的restocking）とバイオセキュリティ対策の実施状況を報じるものである。症例数・死亡数の記載なし、異常な疾病動向の示唆なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ministerio de Salud confirmó muertes por la fiebre amarilla en Venezuela, evitan dar cifras
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health confirms deaths from yellow fever in Venezuela, figures withheld.
article.articleSummary: Venezuela reports yellow fever deaths last year but with no disclosed figure, while seven confirmed yellow fever cases have been recorded in 2026 so far. Health authorities declare an epidemiological alert and aim for 95% national vaccination coverage; about 49,000 people were recently immunized, adding to roughly 3 million vaccinated in the prior decade. Since June 2025 through February 2026, a clear increase has yielded 36 total cases, with 75% of patients aged 10–49. Vaccination efforts prioritized 22 parishes across Aragua, Lara, Portuguesa, and Barinas, where most cases occurred. Beginning March 2, travelers to these four regions must be vaccinated at least 10 days before travel, particularly for Holy Week, and should wear long sleeves and use repellent in wooded areas. Venezuela has received yellow fever vaccines via donations from India, South Korea, Russia, Brazil, and others; officials note the Expanded Immunization Program fell short of targets in 2024. The government is exploring vaccination points at international airports if tourist traffic rises.

triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常な増加、国際的拡大リスク）。2025年6月以降36例に増加し死亡例も発生。ワクチン接種率95%目標未達成で国際支援受入れ中。渡航者への義務的ワクチン接種要請あり。
triage.notes: 2025年6月-2026年2月で36例（75%が10-49歳）。死亡数非公表。4州22教区で集中発生。過去10年で約300万人接種も2024年目標未達。インド・韓国・ロシア・ブラジル等から国際的ワクチン支援受入れ中。3月2日以降当該4州への渡航者に接種義務化（10日前まで）。空港での接種ポイント設置検討中。森林地帯での感染リスク継続。

article.articleHeadline: Malaria and dengue cases on rise in the state
article.articleSummary: From January 1 to March 7, 2026, malaria, dengue, and chikungunya cases totalled 2,392 nationwide, with Mumbai contributing 918 malaria and 182 dengue cases in the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) area. No deaths from these diseases were reported in this period. Data from the National Vector Borne Disease Control Programme (NVBDCP) and state health authorities show that mosquito-borne outbreaks can occur outside the monsoon, including winter and summer. Mumbai has borne the highest impact among districts during this interval. The article highlights ongoing transmission during the summer peak and underscores the need for vector-control and public health measures to curb spread.

triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2項目該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性）。インド・ムンバイで2026年1-3月に蚊媒介感染症2,392例（マラリア918例、デング182例含む）が報告され、通常モンスーン期以外の冬季・夏季発生という異常性がある。死亡例なしだが症例数が多く、継続的な曝露リスクと国際的拡大の可能性を考慮しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ムンバイは国際的な交通ハブであり、蚊媒介感染症の国際拡大リスクは潜在的に存在。NVBDCP（国家ベクター媒介疾患制御プログラム）がモニタリング中であり、政府の関心は高い。死亡例ゼロは重症度評価でポジティブ要素だが、症例数の多さとモンスーン期外の異常発生パターンが懸念材料。ベクターコントロール対策の有効性と今後の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Alta de casos de Mpox coincide com Carnaval, mas não há risco de pandemia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in Mpox cases coincides with Carnival, but there is no risk of a pandemic.
article.articleSummary: Brazil logged 140 confirmed mpox cases, 9 probable, and 539 suspected in 2026, with no deaths so far this year (2025 saw 1,079 cases and two deaths). Most of the 149 confirmed/probable cases are in Sao Paulo (93) and Rio de Janeiro (18), with Minas Gerais (11) and Rondônia (11) also affected. The rise follows Carnival celebrations (Feb 14–17, 2026), with epidemiological weeks 7 and 9 recording 15 and 27 cases respectively—a 80% increase from week 7 to week 9. Incubation can be up to 21 days, and transmission occurs via direct skin-lesion contact, bodily fluids, respiratory secretions in close, prolonged contact, or contaminated objects. Common symptoms include skin eruptions/lesions, fever, lymphadenopathy, headache, myalgias, chills, and fatigue. There is no widely available mpox-specific treatment; care is supportive. Vaccination targets higher-risk groups. Officials say current trends do not indicate a pandemic risk, despite a new variant noted by WHO.

triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでカーニバル後にMpox症例が急増（80%増）しているが、パンデミックリスクはないと当局が評価。WHO新変異株への言及があり続報が必要。
triage.notes: 2026年累計149症例（確定・疑い含む）、死亡なし。カーニバル後の増加は季節的集団イベントに関連しており予想の範囲内。WHOが言及する新変異株の詳細が不明であり、この変異株の特性（伝播力、重症度、ワクチン効果）についての追加情報が必要。当局がパンデミックリスクなしと評価している点は重要だが、国際的な拡大リスクについては情報不足。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: 丹麥爆高致病性H5N1　港暫停進口禽類產品
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Denmark reports highly pathogenic H5N1 outbreak; Hong Kong suspends imports of poultry products.
article.articleSummary: Denmark reports a regional outbreak of highly pathogenic avian influenza H5N1 in Ikast-Brande municipality. Hong Kong's Food Safety Centre immediately suspended imports of poultry meat and poultry products, including eggs, from the affected area to safeguard public health. HK authorities have contacted Danish authorities and will monitor developments and official notices from the World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH), adjusting actions as the situation evolves. Last year Hong Kong imported about 450 tonnes of chilled poultry meat and about 210,000 eggs from Denmark. No human cases are reported in the article; the outbreak concerns avian health with authorities responding to prevent cross-border spread.

triage.triage_reason: デンマークでの高病原性鳥インフルエンザH5N1の家禽における発生事例。ヒト感染例の報告はなく、動物衛生上の事象として香港が予防的に家禽製品の輸入を停止した標準的な対応。ヒトの公衆衛生への直接的影響は現時点で認められない。
triage.notes: 疾患名は「Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1」だが、記事内容は家禽（動物）での発生のみ報告。ヒト感染例は明記されていない（No human cases are reported）。影響カテゴリも「animals」のみ。香港による輸入停止はWOAH通知に基づく標準的な動物検疫措置であり、ヒトの健康への深刻な脅威を示すものではない。通常の家禽インフルエンザサーベイランスの範囲内と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Pandemiyanın altı ili tamam oldu - Koronavirus dünyada və Azərbaycanda hansı izləri qoydu?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Six years of the pandemic have passed — What traces has the coronavirus left in the world and in Azerbaijan?
article.articleSummary: Six years after COVID-19 was declared a pandemic by the WHO on March 11, 2020, the global burden remains with 114 countries reporting 118,000+ cases and 4,291 deaths at the outset, as infections outside China rose 13-fold in two weeks. Azerbaijan’s first case was on February 28, 2020, a Russian citizen who arrived from Iran; the first death occurred March 12, 2020. Early responses included border closures and a quarantine regime; later efforts emphasized mass vaccination, modular hospitals, and regulated social life. Thirteen modular hospitals plus one permanent facility were built, with COVID-19 beds exceeding 10,000. By March 1, 2024, Azerbaijan recorded 835,144 cases, 824,602 recoveries, 10,428 deaths from 7,762,507 tests. Globally, by December 24, 2024, 776.8 million+ cases and over 7 million deaths; in 2026 (Jan 26–Feb 22) 48,729 new cases in 64 countries and 1,540 new deaths in 38 countries. The WHO notes underreporting due to reduced testing; the emergency ended May 5, 2023, but the virus remains a global health risk. Six years on, COVID-19 continues to influence health, economy, and daily life.

triage.triage_reason: COVID-19パンデミック6周年の回顧記事であり、新規の公衆衛生上の脅威ではない。2026年初頭の症例数は低水準であり、WHOも既に緊急事態を終了（2023年5月5日）している。
triage.notes: パンデミック開始から6年の記念的な振り返り記事。2026年1月26日〜2月22日に64か国で48,729例、38か国で1,540死亡という数値は、全世界規模で見れば低水準。アゼルバイジャンの累積データ（2024年3月1日時点：835,144例、10,428死亡）も過去の統計であり、現在進行中の異常事態を示すものではない。検査数減少による過小報告の指摘はあるが、WHOが既に公衆衛生上の緊急事態を終了させており、新規シグナルとしての優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Chicken Pox | পক্সের আতঙ্ক হঠাতে 'ম্যাজিক' দেখাবে উচ্ছে-গাজর! জেনে নিন বসন্তের সেরা ৭ পথ্য
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chicken Pox | 'Magic' to dispel the fear of pox will be shown by Uchhe-Gajor! Learn the 7 best foods of spring.
article.articleSummary: Chickenpox, caused by Varicella Zoster virus, is spreading as winter ends and spring arrives in the North Bengal region. The disease is highly contagious and airborne, presenting with painful rashes and fever. While vaccines exist for children, adults face a higher risk, making early precautions essential. The article urges boosting immunity through diet and hygiene, not relying solely on vaccination. It highlights readily available leafy vegetables and seasonal greens as effective in supporting resistance. Additional measures include keeping the home clean and maintaining personal cleanliness, with dietary changes starting from the spring season. No specific case counts or outbreaks are provided. The guidance emphasizes that preventive actions and dietary habits can help reduce infection risk during this transitional period.

triage.triage_reason: 記事は水痘（Varicella）の一般的な予防と食事に関する健康啓発情報であり、具体的なアウトブレイクや症例数の報告はない。季節的な感染症の注意喚起と予防策の紹介が主内容で、異常な公衆衛生事象を示す情報は含まれていない。
triage.notes: 水痘は既知の季節性感染症であり、記事は冬から春への季節変化に伴う一般的な健康啓発記事。具体的な症例数、アウトブレイク規模、重症例、死亡例などの疫学情報が一切記載されていないため、公衆衛生上の緊急事象としてのシグナルには該当しない。予防接種と食事による免疫力向上を推奨する教育的内容。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo registra primeiro caso de sarampo em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo records first measles case in 2026.
article.articleSummary: São Paulo State reports its first measles case in 2026: a six-month-old girl who had not been vaccinated and had traveled to Bolivia in January. The case was registered in February and confirmed by laboratory testing. It follows two imported measles cases in 2025. Health authorities emphasize vaccination as the principal preventive measure. Measles vaccine is part of Brazil's National Immunization Schedule, with the first dose at 12 months and the second at 15 months. For individuals aged 5–29 years, two doses are recommended (minimum 30 days apart); those aged 30–59 years should receive one additional dose. The exposure linked to international travel underlines the ongoing risk of measles importation and the importance of maintaining high vaccination coverage to prevent outbreaks.

triage.triage_reason: 輸入症例による麻疹の単発例であり、現時点では国内での二次感染や集団発生の報告はない。ただし、未接種の乳児が国際渡航先で感染しており、今後の接触者調査や追加症例の有無を監視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 2026年のサンパウロ州初の麻疹症例（6ヶ月齢の未接種女児、ボリビア渡航歴あり）。2025年にも2例の輸入症例があり、輸入リスクは継続。麻疹は感染力が極めて高いため（epidemic_prone=Yes）、接触者調査と追加症例の有無が重要。現時点では単発輸入例であり公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は限定的だが、ワクチン接種率の低下や二次感染の発生があればPICKUPへ格上げを検討。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura de Cuiabá orienta população sobre prevenção ao caramujo africano | Gazeta Digital
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cuiabá City Hall advises the public on preventing the African giant snail | Gazeta Digital
article.articleSummary: Amid March rains in Cuiabá, Brazil, the City Hall's Health Secretariat warns of rising African giant snail (Lissachatina fulica) populations. High humidity promotes reproduction; while Brazil's overall disease risk is low, snails can harbor Angiostrongylus cantonensis (eosinophilic meningitis) and Angiostrongylus costaricensis (abdominal angiostrongyliasis). Transmission occurs via ingesting snail mucus on poorly washed produce or handling the mollusk. Do not touch or eat the snail. For control, manually collect snails with disposable gloves or bags during early morning or dusk, place them in a closed container with water-salt (5 tablespoons per liter) for about 3 hours, then crush shells before disposal. Do not use salt on soil. Wash produce by soaking 15-30 minutes in a chlorine bleach solution (1 tablespoon per liter; 2-2.5% active chlorine) per Anvisa, then rinse. Keep yards clean, report abandoned properties to SORP, and contact the CCZ at (65) 3318-6059 or ccz.saude@cuiaba.mt.gov.br.

triage.triage_reason: 通常の公衆衛生指導・予防啓発活動であり、疾患発生や異常事態の報告ではない。アフリカマイマイの個体数増加に対する季節的な注意喚起のみで、実際の感染症例の報告はなく、国際的なリスクも認められない。
triage.notes: これは雨季におけるアフリカマイマイの個体数増加に対する定期的な予防啓発活動である。実際の広東住血線虫症（好酸球性髄膜炎）やコスタリカ住血線虫症（腹部血管円線虫症）の症例報告は記事に含まれていない。ブラジル全体の疾患リスクは低いと明記されており、市保健局による標準的な公衆衛生指導の範疇である。

article.articleHeadline: Khẩn cấp đưa thuốc giải Botulinum từ Thụy Sĩ về cứu 3 bệnh nhi đang nguy kịch
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Urgently transporting botulinum antitoxin from Switzerland to save three critically ill children.
article.articleSummary: Botulism suspected in Da Nang and nearby Quang Nam, Vietnam, after eating fermented fish. Three children aged 7, 11, and 15 from Phuoc Năng commune are critically ill with botulinum toxin poisoning; one case laboratory-confirmed positive for Clostridium botulinum. Symptoms include abdominal pain, vomiting, weakness, drooping eyelids, and respiratory distress; the 15-year-old is comatose with severe respiratory failure. The other two show similar signs and are under care at Da Nang’s Pediatric Hospital and Quang Nam’s Northern Mountains regional hospital. Botulism Antitoxin Heptavalent (BAT) is scarce in the Central region. WHO provided 5 vials from international stock, transported from Switzerland to Hanoi on 11 March 2026, then by air to Da Nang for distribution to Da Nang General Hospital and the Quang Nam facility. BAT costs about $8,000 per vial. Objective: save the three lives.

triage.triage_reason: 重症ボツリヌス中毒の小児3例が危機的状態で、WHOからの国際的な抗毒素緊急供給が必要な状況。IHR基準3つ該当、WPRO基準4つ該当、国際支援が実施されており、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 発酵魚摂取後の食品媒介ボツリヌス症。7歳、11歳、15歳の小児3名が重篤（1名昏睡・重度呼吸不全）。Clostridium botulinum検査陽性確認済。中部地域で抗毒素不足のためWHOが国際備蓄から5バイアル緊急供給（スイス→ハノイ→ダナン）。1バイアル約8,000ドル。国際支援が既に実施されている点で管理可能性に懸念あり。食品安全上の問題として地域的な公衆衛生対応が必要。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo tem primeiro caso de sarampo em 2026 | Gazeta Digital
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo records its first measles case in 2026 | Gazeta Digital.
article.articleSummary: São Paulo records its first measles case in 2026: a six-month-old girl, unvaccinated, contracted measles after traveling to Bolivia in January 2026. The case was registered in February 2026 and confirmed by laboratory tests. In 2025 the state reported two imported measles cases. Health authorities emphasize vaccination as the best protection. Measles vaccine is part of Brazil’s National Immunization Schedule: first dose at 12 months and second at 15 months. For catch-up vaccination, people aged 5–29 years should receive two doses at least 30 days apart; adults aged 30–59 years should obtain a new dose. The report highlights travel-associated risk and the ongoing need to maintain vaccination coverage to prevent outbreaks.

triage.triage_reason: 輸入症例1件のみで現時点では国際的拡大リスクは限定的だが、麻疹の高い感染力と乳児の未接種という脆弱性、ボリビアからの輸入という国際移動要素を考慮し、続報監視が必要。
triage.notes: 2026年サンパウロ州の初症例。6ヶ月齢未接種乳児がボリビア旅行後に感染。2025年も輸入症例2件のみ。現時点では散発輸入例の範囲内で、地域内伝播や集団発生の記載なし。ただし麻疹は感染力が極めて高く（R0=12-18）、ワクチン接種率低下地域では急速拡大のリスクあり。ボリビアの麻疹流行状況と当該州のワクチン接種率が不明なため、続報で二次感染や追加症例の有無を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Gripe aviária: Argentina suspende exportações após 3º caso da doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian influenza: Argentina suspends exports after the 3rd case of the disease.
article.articleSummary: Argentina reports three avian influenza cases in commercial poultry farms in Córdoba, prompting immediate export suspensions of poultry products after a new focus identified by SENASA. Domestic consumption of chicken meat and eggs remains deemed safe, while stringent sanitary measures are applied to control the outbreak and restore Argentina's status as an avian influenza-free country, with aim to resume exports to China and the European Union. Authorities are isolating affected farms to safeguard domestic supply and future negotiations. The report does not specify laboratory confirmation details or infection sources. The shift toward chicken reflects economic pressures and changing consumer habits, underscoring the priority of maintaining supply until exports can be re-opened.

triage.triage_reason: 商業養鶏場での鳥インフルエンザ発生により輸出停止措置が取られており、IHR基準の渡航・貿易制限リスクに該当。また国際的拡大リスク（中国・EUへの輸出再開を目指す状況）も懸念され、WPRO基準の管理可能性（sanitary措置の必要性）にも該当するため、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ヒト感染例の記載なし（動物のみ）。実験室確認の詳細や感染源は不明。国内消費は安全とされているが、輸出再開に向けた清浄国ステータス回復が政府の優先事項。中国・EUとの貿易への影響が大きいため経済的インパクトあり。続報で疫学的詳細（株型、ヒト感染リスク等）の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: SÃ£o Raimundo Nonato intensifica combate ao Aedes aegypti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Raimundo Nonato intensifies the fight against Aedes aegypti.
article.articleSummary: As of 11 March 2026, São Raimundo Nonato's Municipal Health Department, in partnership with the Regional Health Department, is intensifying prevention and control of Aedes aegypti across the municipality. A team from the Programa Saúde na Escola (PSE) is delivering informational lectures in public and private schools to educate students, teachers, and the school community on preventing and contributing to the fight against dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. The program also communicates the importance of dengue vaccination for children and adolescents aged 10–14, available at Basic Health Units (UBSs). The contingency plan includes deploying a fumigation (fumacê) truck to strategic areas. Lectures advise recognizing signs and symptoms of mosquito-borne diseases. The Municipal Health Secretariat stresses that community participation is essential for the success of Aedes aegypti control.

triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのデング・ジカ・チクングニヤに対する自治体の予防強化活動の報告。具体的な症例数や異常事態の記載がなく、定型的な公衆衛生対策の告知と判断されるため、現時点では経過観察とするが、背景に流行状況がある可能性も考慮し続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事は自治体による予防啓発活動（学校での講義、ワクチン接種促進、燻蒸活動）の実施報告であり、具体的な症例数・重症度・異常発生に関する情報は含まれていない。ブラジルではデング等の蚊媒介感染症は風土病的であり、定期的な対策強化は通常業務の範囲と考えられる。ただし、このような対策強化の背景に実際の症例増加がある可能性も排除できないため、同地域からの疫学データを含む続報に注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Médico fala sobre vírus Nipah e reforça cuidados para prevenir raiva humana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctor talks about Nipah virus and reinforces precautions to prevent human rabies.
article.articleSummary: Nipah virus outbreak in India is noted, with the World Health Organization deeming pandemic risk as low because transmission occurs mainly via herbivorous bats and remains regionally confined; no suspected Nipah cases reported in Brazil. Dr. João Paulo Ribeiro Machado, an infectious diseases physician at Hospital Universitário Alcides Carneiro, discussed the situation on Saúde em Dia. The report also covers human rabies, a severe disease transmitted by infected animals, highlighting symptoms such as fever, body aches, headache, weakness, and potential neurological complications. Emphasized are prevention measures and the importance of seeking medical care promptly after bites or contact with suspected animals, ideally within 72 hours for evaluation and possible administration of the rabies serum.

triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルス感染症のインドでの発生に関するブラジルメディアの解説記事。WHOがパンデミックリスクを低いと評価し、ブラジル国内での疑い例報告なし。主に啓発・教育目的の一般的な情報提供であり、新規の異常事態や国際的拡大リスクは示唆されていない。
triage.notes: この記事は既知のインドでのニパウイルス発生に関する医師による解説と、狂犬病予防の一般的啓発を含む内容。WHOが既にパンデミックリスクを低評価しており、ブラジル国内での症例報告もないため、新たな公衆衛生上の脅威を示すシグナルとは判断されない。定期的な疾患啓発活動の一環と考えられる。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H3N2

article.articleHeadline: Advierten por la nueva cepa K de la gripe H3N2: sugieren ampliar la vacunación
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Experts warn about the new K strain of H3N2 flu: they recommend expanding vaccination.
article.articleSummary: A new H3N2 influenza A variant, the K subclade, mutated during last winter in the United States, Europe, and Japan and is now circulating in the Northern Hemisphere with higher transmissibility and potential for increased hospitalization in some areas. Argentina has advanced its flu vaccination campaign in response, noting Europe’s season started four to six weeks earlier; protection begins about 10–14 days after vaccination. The infectious disease specialist suggests expanding vaccination beyond traditional risk groups, including pediatrics. Argentina currently vaccinates children 6 months–24 months, while Uruguay, Paraguay, Brazil, and Chile vaccinate up to 6–8 years. Repeated annual vaccination may provide cross-protection against severe disease. Medical consultation is advised for those considering vaccination outside prioritized groups; individuals who wish to vaccinate may do so. Published date: 2026-03-11.

triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（異常・予想外、国際的拡大、深刻な影響の可能性）。新規H3N2変異株（K亜系統）が複数国で同時流行し、伝播性増強・入院増加の可能性あり。各国が早期ワクチンキャンペーン開始など対応を強化しており、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 新規H3N2-K亜系統が北半球冬季に米国・欧州・日本で変異後、南半球（アルゼンチン・ブラジル等）に拡散。伝播性増強と入院増加の報告あり。欧州では季節性流行が4-6週早期化。アルゼンチンが予防接種対象拡大を検討中。季節性インフルエンザの範囲内だが、新変異株の疫学的影響評価と各国対応状況の継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Estado de São Paulo registra primeiro caso de sarampo em 2026 - Jovem Pan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: State of São Paulo records first measles case in 2026 - Jovem Pan
article.articleSummary: First measles case in São Paulo state for 2026 was confirmed in the capital city: a 6‑month‑old female with no vaccination history who had traveled to Bolivia in January. The case was notified in February and laboratory-confirmed in March 2026; an epidemiological surveillance alert was issued on March 9, 2026. The state had two measles cases in 2025. Vaccination is emphasized as the primary preventive measure. Measles vaccination is part of Brazil’s National Immunization Program: for children, first dose at 12 months (MMR) and second at 15 months (MMR + varicella); ages 5–29 should have two doses at least 30 days apart; ages 30–59 require one dose; healthcare workers should have two doses depending on vaccination status. The Vaccination 100 Dúvidas portal (vacina100duvidas.sp.gov.br) provides guidance on vaccines and risks of non-vaccination.

triage.triage_reason: 既知の疾患（麻疹）の散発例1件のみで、ワクチン未接種児の輸入症例。現時点で二次感染の報告なし。ボリビアからの輸入事例として経過観察が必要だが、即座のフルRRAは不要。
triage.notes: 6ヶ月齢ワクチン未接種児がボリビア渡航後に発症した輸入症例。2026年サンパウロ州初症例だが、2025年も2例のみ。2月通知・3月確定で疫学調査実施済み。ブラジルは定期接種実施国であり対応能力あり。二次感染や集団発生の報告がないため現時点ではDISMISSに近いが、輸入例としての監視継続が推奨されるためWATCHと判定。epidemic_proneは麻疹の特性上Yesだが、本事例では接触者追跡等の対策が実施されているため制御可能と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Cianjur melakukan berbagai cara tekan penularan cacar air anak - ANTARA News Jawa Barat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cianjur Health Office Undertakes Various Measures to Curb Chickenpox Transmission Among Children - ANTARA News West Java
article.articleSummary: Cianjur Regency, West Java, Indonesia, is intensifying measures to curb varicella (chickenpox) transmission among children. As of March 11, 2026, the Cianjur Health Office reports a rise in chickenpox cases across several subdistricts, though not a major surge. Key actions include a catch-up immunization program to vaccinate children who have not completed the full schedule, and expanded outreach and education to parents on immunization benefits. Ongoing parental hesitancy persists, prompting continued efforts to inform communities about vaccination importance. Health authorities urge families to seek prompt care if a febrile child develops vesicular rashes, promote healthy living and regular health checks at local facilities, and follow healthcare workers’ guidance to limit transmission.

triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・チアンジュール県における水痘（水ぼうそう）の増加事例。ワクチン接種キャンペーンで対応可能な一般的な小児感染症であり、異常性・重症性・国際拡大リスクいずれも認められない。
triage.notes: 水痘は一般的な小児感染症であり、ワクチンで予防可能。記事では「大規模な急増（major surge）ではない」と明記されており、地域レベルでのキャッチアップ接種プログラムで対応中。ワクチン接種率向上のための保護者への啓発活動が主な対策。重症例や死亡例の報告なし。国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念事項には該当しない通常の疾病管理活動。

article.articleHeadline: Consumo de ovos, mercado de grãos e influenza aviária marcam o primeiro dia do Congresso APA 2026 | Agrimidia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Egg consumption, grain market and avian influenza mark the first day of the APA 2026 Congress | Agrimidia.
article.articleSummary: On March 11, 2026, the XXIII APA Congress on Egg Production and Marketing opened in Limeira, São Paulo, Brazil, drawing 800–1,000 industry participants to debate market trends, production costs, exports, and poultry health. APA president Érico Pozzer underscored knowledge sharing across the supply chain and the egg’s role in nutrition and food security. The grain market dominated cost discussions: economist Alexandre Mendonça de Barros forecast relatively stable corn prices in the short term due to a strong Brazilian harvest, but noted high interest rates and credit tightening may push grain sales up, increasing supply. Yet rising global demand and fertilizer/production risks could lift corn and soybean meal prices in coming years, impacting layer rations. Brazil now produces about 66 billion eggs annually, with exports at a record 1.4% of production and over 80 markets open. Avian influenza biosafety was highlighted as essential, requiring public–private cooperation.

triage.triage_reason: 鳥インフルエンザに関する業界会議での言及であり、ヒト感染や動物での実際のアウトブレイクの報告ではない。バイオセキュリティの重要性が議論されているが、具体的な疫学情報が不足しているため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: この記事は2026年3月11日のブラジル・サンパウロ州リメイラでの養鶏業界会議（APA Congress）の報告。鳥インフルエンザは「バイオセキュリティが不可欠」として議題に挙げられているが、実際の症例発生・アウトブレイク・ヒト感染の報告は含まれていない。記事の主眼は卵消費・穀物市場・輸出動向であり、鳥インフルエンザは予防的な文脈での言及。具体的な疫学データ（症例数・死亡・検査確定例）がないため、現時点では実際の公衆衛生イベントとしての評価は困難。今後、ブラジルで鳥インフルエンザの実際の発生が報告された場合は再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Yellow Fever Evolution at Brazil's Forest-Urban Interface
article.articleSummary: Yellow fever virus (YFV) in Brazil shows evolving spillover at the forest-urban interface, with evidence from phylogenetic analysis, genomic sequencing, and ecological modeling across Brazilian biomes. The study tracks YFV lineages as they adapt from sylvatic forest cycles involving non-human primates and sylvatic vectors to urban cycles largely driven by Aedes aegypti, raising risk of sustained urban epidemics in Brazil's dense cities. Mutations in viral envelope proteins linked to increased transmissibility in urban vectors were identified, signaling potential for higher urban transmission. The research maps human and non-human primate movement through ecological corridors and describes the impact of fragmented forests and peri-urban expansion on cross-species spillover. It projects future outbreak trajectories under climate change and urbanization. It critiques surveillance focused on humans alone and calls for integrated genomic and ecological monitoring for real-time risk assessment.

article.articleHeadline: Ubá confirma uma morte por leptospirose após enchentes; 41 casos seguem em investigação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ubá confirms one death from leptospirosis after floods; 41 cases are under investigation.
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis in Ubá, Minas Gerais, Brazil following floods: one death confirmed and 41 suspected cases under epidemiological investigation. The deceased is a woman aged 30–35. Samples from all 41 suspected patients have been sent to Fundação Ezequiel Dias (Funed) in Belo Horizonte for laboratory testing; results are pending. Leptospirosis is transmitted via water or mud contaminated with rat urine, a risk heightened after floods. Core symptoms include fever, headache, severe muscle pain (notably in the calves), nausea and vomiting. Health authorities urge individuals with symptoms to seek medical evaluation, with hospital care recommended if the condition worsens. Local health teams continue surveillance and reinforce prevention measures; updates will follow as investigations and laboratory analyses progress. Information current to March 10–11, 2026.

triage.triage_reason: 洪水後のレプトスピラ症アウトブレイクで1名死亡、41例調査中。地域的な事象だが重症度あり。検査結果待ちで情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 洪水後のレプトスピラ症は予測可能な事象。症例数42例（確定1+疑い41）は地域アウトブレイクとして中規模。1名死亡は重症度の指標だが、レプトスピラ症の致死率範囲内。地域保健当局が対応中で検査結果待ち。国際的拡大リスクは低い。検査結果判明後に再評価が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: 126 Kasus Campak di Kaltim Awal 2026, Kenali Gejala dan Pentingnya Imunisasi Anak - Tribunkaltim.co
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 126 Measles Cases in East Kalimantan in Early 2026, Know the Symptoms and the Importance of Childhood Immunization - Tribunkaltim.co
article.articleSummary: Measles case burden in East Kalimantan (Benua Etam) reached 126 cases across 10 regencies and municipalities in early 2026, with data as of March 10, reported by the East Kalimantan Health Office (Dinkes Kaltim). Most patients received medical care and were discharged as recovered; however, data are still undergoing verification to map district-level counts. The rise mirrors a national trend, with higher numbers in mobile urban centers, notably Samarinda and Balikpapan, influenced by population density and urban activity. Authorities have implemented preventive measures, including circulating alert notices, strengthening community education via health cadres, and boosting health promotion from primary health clinics (puskesmas) to hospitals to curb transmission. The article underscores the importance of childhood immunization in preventing measles outbreaks.

triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2項目（公衆衛生への影響、国際的拡大リスク）とWPROスクリーニング基準3項目（重症度、流行しやすさ、長期曝露）に該当。2026年初頭の短期間で126症例は公衆衛生上の懸念であり、都市部での人口密集による拡大リスクがある。
triage.notes: 東カリマンタン州10自治体で126症例（2026年3月10日時点）。サマリンダとバリクパパンの都市部で多発。当局は予防措置（警報発令、保健教育強化、ワクチン接種推進）を実施中。ほとんどの患者は回復退院しているが、自治体レベルの詳細データは検証中。麻疹は高感染性であり、ワクチン接種率低下地域での集団発生リスクが高い。インドネシアは人口大国で国際移動も活発なため、国際的拡大の可能性を考慮すべき。続報で死亡例・合併症・ワクチン接種率データを注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: CVO intensifies rabies IECs in schools
article.articleSummary: Davao City's Veterinarian Office (CVO) intensified Information Education Campaigns (IEC) on rabies in schools to prompt children to report bites or scratches from cats or dogs to parents immediately and seek medical care. IECs educate on rabies basics, transmission via saliva, fatal yet preventable nature with vaccines, and washing wounds with soap and running water for 10–15 minutes. The CVO notes animals are not born with rabies. The city offers free anti-rabies vaccination for animals and the Animal Bite Treatment Center provides free Post-Exposure Prophylaxis (PEP) to bite/scratch victims. A citywide anti-rabies vaccination drive is ongoing, with schedules posted on the CVO Facebook page and district offices. Free castration for cats and dogs is planned in multiple barangays for World Rabies Awareness observance: Calinan Proper (Mar 23), Calinan District (Mar 24), Tambobong (Mar 25), and Samantha Homes, Matina Pangi (Mar 27).

triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病予防キャンペーンと定期的な公衆衛生対策の実施に関する報告。アウトブレイクや異常事例ではなく、通常の予防活動の告知である。
triage.notes: フィリピン・ダバオ市における狂犬病予防啓発キャンペーンの実施報告。学校でのIEC活動、無料ワクチン接種、咬傷治療センターの提供など、通常の公衆衛生プログラムの一環。具体的な症例数、アウトブレイク、異常な発生パターンの報告はなし。予防的対策の強化であり、緊急性のある疫学イベントではない。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo tem primeiro caso de sarampo em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo reports its first measles case in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Measles in the state of São Paulo, Brazil: the first case of 2026 was registered in February and laboratory-confirmed. In 2025, the state reported two imported measles cases. Public health authorities stress vaccination as the best protection. Measles vaccine is in the National Vaccination Schedule: first dose at 12 months and second dose at 15 months. For catch-up vaccination, individuals aged 5–29 years should receive two doses at least 30 days apart; those aged 30–59 years should obtain a new dose. The report focuses on prevention through immunization; no additional symptoms or outbreak details are provided beyond the confirmed case and imported cases from 2025. Location: São Paulo state, Brazil; surveillance and vaccination guidance emphasize reducing import-related risk and transmission.

triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ州で2026年初の麻疹症例が確認されたが、単発例であり、2025年にも輸入症例2例のみ。現時点では異常な拡大や重症化の報告はなく、当局は予防接種強化で対応中。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 2026年初の症例だが、前年も輸入例2例のみで散発的。アウトブレイクの兆候なし。症例詳細（年齢、渡航歴、接触者調査結果等）が不明のため、続報で感染連鎖の有無を確認する必要がある。麻疹は高い感染力を持つため、ワクチン接種率低下地域での流行リスクには注意が必要だが、現時点では定期報告レベル。

article.articleHeadline: Mariela Gallinger: "Entre Ríos trabaja y se capacita para que el virus no llegue a la provincia"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mariela Gallinger: "Entre Ríos works and trains to prevent the virus from reaching the province."
article.articleSummary: Argentina reports four positive cases of avian influenza in recent days, with the latest detected in Bolívar, Buenos Aires province. Earlier detections occurred at facilities in Lobos and Ranchos (Buenos Aires) and at a laying-hen farm in Alejo Ledesma, Córdoba. SENASA clarifies that the detections do not affect domestic production or consumption, and that avian influenza is not transmitted to people via chicken or egg consumption. The outbreak complications hit exports and delay restoration of Argentina’s status as an avian-influenza–free country, following Ranchos’ first detection which led to suspensions to several destinations. The main export impact is fresh poultry meat, restricted in around 40 markets including China, though shipments continue to more than 35 countries/blocks recognizing regionalization. In 2025, poultry exports reached 169,000 tonnes valued at $218 million.

triage.triage_reason: 動物における鳥インフルエンザ発生で、ヒト感染例の報告はなし。輸出への経済的影響は確認されるが、公衆衛生上の直接的リスクは現時点で不明確。続報による監視が必要。
triage.notes: アルゼンチンで家禽における鳥インフルエンザ（H5N1と推定）の複数検出事例。ヒト感染症例の記載なし。SENASA（国家農牧衛生品質機構）は食品安全性を強調し、ヒトへの感染リスクは否定。主な懸念は貿易制限（中国含む約40市場で生鮮鶏肉輸出停止）。疾患名に「Human Infection with Avian Influenza」が含まれるが、記事内容は動物のみの発生を示唆。ヒト症例の有無について続報確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 丹麥一地區爆發H5N1禽流感　本港暫停從當地進口禽肉禽類產品
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: H5N1 avian influenza outbreak in a region of Denmark; Hong Kong halts imports of poultry meat and poultry products from the area.
article.articleSummary: H5N1 high-pathogenic avian influenza outbreak in Ikast-Brande, Denmark, prompts Hong Kong’s Center for Food Safety to suspend imports of poultry meat and poultry products from the affected area, including eggs, to protect public health. The action follows a World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH) notification. Hong Kong imported about 450 metric tons of chilled poultry meat and roughly 210,000 eggs from Denmark last year. The center has notified Danish authorities and will continue to monitor WOAH updates and local outbreak developments, adjusting measures as the situation evolves. No human cases are described in the report. The measure targets imported goods from the affected Danish region, with ongoing supplier monitoring and potential revisions in response to the evolving outbreak.

triage.triage_reason: 動物間でのH5N1高病原性鳥インフルエンザの発生であり、ヒト症例の報告はなし。香港が予防的措置として輸入停止を実施しているが、現時点では公衆衛生への直接的な深刻な影響は確認されていない。続報でヒト感染の有無や流行規模を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: デンマークのIkast-Brande地域での動物におけるH5N1発生。WOAH通知に基づき香港が予防的輸入停止措置を実施（2025年に約450トンの冷蔵鶏肉と約21万個の卵を輸入）。ヒト感染症例の記載なし。H5N1は人獣共通感染症として公衆衛生上重要だが、現時点では動物のみの発生であり情報不足のためWATCH判定。ヒト感染の報告や流行拡大の兆候があればPICKUPへ変更を検討。

article.articleHeadline: Operação Fronteira: ações de combate ao mosquito da dengue acontecem em Fortaleza e Região Metropolitana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Operation Frontier: dengue-carrying mosquito control actions take place in Fortaleza and the Metropolitan Region.
article.articleSummary: Operation Frontier 2026 launches in Fortaleza's Metropolitan Region to curb Aedes aegypti, the vector for dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. The inter-municipal effort targets border areas with Caucaia, Eusébio, and Itaitinga, aiming to visit about 16,000 properties and benefit around 25,000 residents. Fortaleza deploys 215 arbovirus control agents performing larval source elimination, larviciding, residual spraying, and community education, plus public-area cleaning and brigades. The 18th edition underscores cross-municipal collaboration, with transport authorities also involved; actions run through March 16, 2026. In Caucaia, operations focus on Jurema (Marechal Rondon, Guadalajara, Parque Albano, Velho São Miguel) with a ~60-person task force. Eusébio contributes a 20-member team to border areas, aiming for 400–500 residences. The effort emphasizes community engagement to eliminate breeding sites and strengthen vector control across municipal boundaries.

triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・フォルタレザ都市圏での蚊媒介感染症（デング、ジカ、チクングニア）対策キャンペーンの報告。16,000件の訪問、約25,000人の住民に対する予防介入であり、重症例・死亡の報告はなく、通常の公衆衛生対策の範囲内。ただし、3疾患同時流行の可能性を示唆しており続報注視が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は感染症発生報告ではなく、定期的なベクター対策キャンペーン（Operation Frontier 2026、第18版）の実施報告。実際の症例数、重症度、疫学的動向に関する情報は含まれていない。デング・ジカ・チクングニアはブラジル北東部で風土病であり、予防的介入は通常の公衆衛生活動。症例増加の兆候があるかは不明のため、疫学データを含む続報があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Peringati TB Day, RSPAW Salatiga Luncurkan Inovasi ''SIAP TB'' Tingkatkan Kesembuhan Pasien Tuberkulosis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: To Mark TB Day, RSPAW Salatiga Launches the 'SIAP TB' Innovation to Improve the Cure Rate of Tuberculosis Patients.
article.articleSummary: As of March 11, 2026, Salatiga's Rumah Sakit Paru dr Ario Wirawan (RSPAW Salatiga) launched SIAP TB, a WhatsApp-based adherence program to boost cure rates among tuberculosis (TB) patients. The initiative targets patients already undergoing TB treatment, sending reminders to take medications and to attend hospital visits to prevent treatment interruption. Dr Ign Widiyawati SpP(K) FISR, who designed SIAP TB, described the app as easy to use; Dr Deni Noviantoro SpP, chair of the TB Day event committee, emphasized improving adherence amid Indonesia’s high TB burden. Indonesia ranks second globally in TB incidence, after India, and higher than the Philippines and China. The TB Day Expo (March 10–11) featured health talks, nutritious cooking demos for TB patients, bazaars, karaoke, and theatrical performances, underscoring the need for multi-sector collaboration with the city government, health centers, and hospitals to curb TB.

triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・サラティガ市の病院における結核治療アドヒアランス向上のためのWhatsAppベース革新プログラム（SIAP TB）の発表イベント。既知の高TB負荷国における通常の疾病管理活動であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態ではない。
triage.notes: これは世界結核デー（TB Day）に合わせた啓発イベント及び医療イノベーション（治療アドヒアランス向上アプリ）の発表記事。インドネシアがインド、フィリピン、中国に次ぐTB高負荷国であることは既知情報。新規感染症イベント、アウトブレイク、予期せぬ公衆衛生事象ではなく、通常の疾病管理・予防活動の範疇。国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念を示唆する要素はない。

article.articleHeadline: Justiça arquiva processo por tráfico após morte de acusada vítima de tuberculose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Court Dismisses Drug-Trafficking Case After Death of the Accused, a Tuberculosis Victim
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis caused the death of D.B., a 46-year-old woman arrested 12 January 2026 by the Federal Highway Police in Sidrolândia, Brazil, during a routine check on a Cruzeiro do Sul bus from Dourados to Campo Grande. Police seized over 10 kg of drugs: 5.3 kg marijuana (50 blocks) and 5.5 kg hashish (53 blocks) in a bag linked to D.B. She said she was contacted in Angra dos Reis (RJ) to transport the bag to a Rio de Janeiro municipality for about R$5,000, claiming not to know its contents. Symptoms appeared 22 February (fever and abdominal pain); she was hospitalized in Campo Grande on 23 February and died soon after. A medical report cited tuberculosis, an infectious lung disease. With her death, the criminal case was archived, though the seized drugs remain in the records for potential further investigations. Evidence includes three baggage receipts and a Samsung phone.

triage.triage_reason: 結核による個別死亡例であり、アウトブレイクや異常な疫学的パターンの報告はない。公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められず、通常の結核症例の範疇と判断される。
triage.notes: 本イベントは麻薬密輸事件の被疑者が拘留中に結核で死亡した個別症例の報道である。複数の症例や集団発生の記述はなく、結核自体はブラジルで流行している既知の疾患であり、異常性・予想外の要素は認められない。公衆衛生上の介入や国際的対応を要する状況ではないため、シグナルトリアージの対象外と判定する。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde de MG confirma morte por leptospirose após chuvas extremas em Ubá; saiba quem era a vítima
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Minas Gerais Health Department confirms death from leptospirosis after extreme rains in Ubá; find out who the victim was.
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis death confirmed in Ubá, Zona da Mata, Minas Gerais, Brazil after extreme rains. A 33-year-old woman died, likely from exposure to floodwater or mud contaminated by rat urine. Public health teams confirmed infection via laboratory tests. Forty-one suspected cases are under laboratory analysis at Fundação Ezequiel Dias (Funed) in Belo Horizonte. All identified cases have occurred in Ubá since 24 February, when one of the region’s major storms produced floods. Symptoms include fever, body aches, headache, nausea, and malaise; authorities urge protective cleanup measures (gloves, boots) for those exposed to floodwaters and to seek care promptly. Severe cases with persistent high fever, vomiting, or breathing difficulty require immediate hospital care. Government funding of about R$ 8.3 million is allocated to Ubá to strengthen health services, including new cold storage for medicines and vaccines, plus an epidemiological alert and reinforced surveillance.

triage.triage_reason: 単一の死亡例と41件の疑い例が報告されているが、洪水後のレプトスピラ症としては予想される範囲内。地域的な対応は適切に実施されているが、続報で症例数の増加や重症例の拡大を監視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 洪水後のレプトスピラ症発生は疫学的に予想される事象。1名の死亡と41件の疑い例は地域的な規模であり、ブラジル保健当局は適切な監視体制・資金投入（R$830万）・予防啓発を実施中。現時点では国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念には該当しないが、症例数の急増や他地域への拡大があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 學校放假回越南！交換生妹子激戰男友　返台確診梅毒「診間大崩潰」 | 健康 | 三立新聞網  SETN.COM
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: School breaks, back to Vietnam! Exchange student girl goes wild with her boyfriend, diagnosed with syphilis upon returning to Taiwan — "clinic meltdown"
article.articleSummary: An exchange student from Vietnam studying in Taiwan was diagnosed with syphilis after returning from a holiday in Vietnam; three weeks after returning, she tested positive and is undergoing treatment with follow-up. Syphilis, caused by Treponema pallidum, can affect multiple organs; if untreated, it may involve the nervous system, heart, and blood vessels. Early signs include painless hard chancre; secondary stage may include a widespread rash. In 2025 Taiwan reported 9,935 new syphilis cases (up 2% from 2024), with 15–24 year-olds adding 1,892 cases (up 8% from 2024). HIV infections fell to 879 and gonorrhea to 6,417; mpox total 521 since 2023, with 7 domestically in 2026. Prevention includes condom use and stable partners; for unsafe sex, seek care within 72 hours for HIV post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) and consider doxycycline PEP for syphilis exposure, under medical guidance.

triage.triage_reason: 台湾における梅毒の散発例（留学生1名）であり、異常な発生パターンではない。2025年の台湾での梅毒報告数は前年比2%増（9,935例）と微増にとどまり、国際的拡大や深刻な公衆衛生への影響は認められない。
triage.notes: 台湾の梅毒症例数は2025年に9,935例（前年比+2%）、15-24歳層で1,892例（前年比+8%）と若年層でやや増加しているが、通常のサーベイランスの範囲内。HIV感染879例（減少）、淋病6,417例（減少）、mpox累計521例（2023年以降）と他のSTIは減少傾向。個別症例の報道であり、アウトブレイクや異常事象の兆候なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ubá registra primeira morte por leptospirose e tem 41 casos em investigação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ubá records first death due to leptospirosis and has 41 cases under investigation
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis in Ubá, Minas Gerais, Brazil, marked its first death from the infection, confirmed March 10, 2026, after severe floods in late February. The deceased is a 33-year-old woman; RT-qPCR detected Leptospira. Ubá reports 41 suspected leptospirosis cases under epidemiological investigation, with samples sent to Fundação Ezequiel Dias (Funed) in Belo Horizonte and results pending. Floods caused seven deaths and left one person missing. SES-MG maintains ongoing case monitoring, lab analyses, and epidemiological investigations; about 8.3 million reais were allocated to Ubá to strengthen health services and improve storage of medicines and vaccines. Leptospirosis is transmitted via water, mud, or soil contaminated with urine from infected animals, especially rats; incubation 1–30 days (commonly 7–14). Symptoms include fever and potentially respiratory or renal complications; antibiotics are started on suspicion, with hospitalization if severe. Missing person Luciano Franklin Fernandes being sought by 33 soldiers, drones, dogs, and excavators along the Ubá River.

triage.triage_reason: 洪水後のレプトスピラ症集団発生で死亡例1名、疑い例41名が調査中。IHR基準3つ該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常規模、国際拡大リスク）、WPRO基準4つ該当（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）。災害関連感染症として国際的関心も想定されフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 2026年2月末の大規模洪水（死者7名・行方不明1名）後のレプトスピラ症アウトブレイク。RT-qPCRで確定診断済み。州政府が830万レアルの予算措置を講じるなど対応中。汚染水への曝露が継続している可能性あり。災害関連感染症として国際的なベストプラクティス共有の観点からも注目に値する。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox avança em Rondônia: veja quem são os 16 pacientes confirmados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox Advances in Rondônia: See Who the 16 Confirmed Patients Are
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) in Rondônia, Brazil: Agevisa reports 16 confirmed mpox cases, all residents of Porto Velho. Two cases were notified in December 2025 but laboratory-confirmed in January 2026; the remaining 14 were confirmed in 2026. Nine patients have recovered; there have been no hospitalizations or deaths to date. Data come from the e-SUS Sinan system as of March 10, 2026, 09:11. Agevisa states active surveillance continues to monitor the outbreak and guide preventive measures. Information confirmed by Agevisa's director-general, Colonel Gilvander Gregório de Lima. Health authorities urge individuals with suspected mpox symptoms to seek care at health units for evaluation and guidance.

triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ロンドニア州で16例のMpox確認例があるが、入院・死亡なし、9例は回復済み。情報が限定的でクレード分類や国際的拡大リスクの評価が困難。続報による追加情報を待つべき段階。
triage.notes: Porto Velho市に限定された16例（2025年12月2例、2026年14例）。クレードI/IIの情報なし。入院・死亡ゼロ、9例回復済みで重症度は低い。地方当局による積極的サーベイランス実施中。クレード情報や感染経路、ヒト-ヒト感染の詳細が判明すれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 學校放假回越南！交換生妹子激戰男友　返台確診梅毒「診間大崩潰」 | 祝你健康 | 三立新聞網 HEALTH.SETN.COM
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: School on break, returns to Vietnam! Exchange student girl has a steamy session with her boyfriend; back in Taiwan diagnosed with syphilis—"clinic-room meltdown" | Wishing You Health | Sanli News Network HEALTH.SETN.COM
article.articleSummary: Syphilis cases in Taiwan rose slightly in 2025, with 9,935 new infections (up 2% from 2024); the 15–24 age group accounted for 1,892 new cases, up 8%. HIV infections declined to 879 (−12%), and gonorrhea fell to 6,417 (−16%). Since 2023, monkeypox has been tracked, with 521 cumulative cases; 2026 adds seven local infections. A notable case involves a Vietnamese exchange student in Taiwan who, while visiting home during a holiday, had sex with her boyfriend; three weeks after returning, she was diagnosed with syphilis and became emotional in the clinic. Syphilis, caused by Treponema pallidum, can affect multiple organs if untreated; early infection is treated with penicillin injections or oral antibiotics. Preventive measures include condom use, stable partners, and post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) for HIV within 72 hours, with doxycycline as potential doxy-PEP for syphilis under medical guidance.

triage.triage_reason: 台湾における定例サーベイランスデータの報告であり、異常な増加や重症化の兆候は認められない。梅毒は2%増、HIV・淋病は減少傾向。mpox症例も累積521例と管理下にあり、国際的拡大リスクや深刻な公衆衛生影響は示されていない。
triage.notes: 台湾の2025年定例統計報告。梅毒微増（+2%）も疫学的に有意な変化ではなく、HIV・淋病は減少。mpoxも2023年以降の累積データで新規急増なし。個別症例（交換生）の言及は臨床教育目的であり、アウトブレイクを示唆するものではない。通常のサーベイランス範囲内と判断。

article.articleHeadline: icddr,b to launch study to track drug-resistant malaria in Rohingya
article.articleSummary: Bangladesh's icddr,b launches the country's first surveillance study to detect drug-resistant malaria among Rohingya refugees in Cox's Bazar camps. Working with DGHS and BRAC, the project will monitor malaria patients in selected camps and nearby health facilities to identify early signs of resistance to artemisinin-based combination therapies (ACTs) for Plasmodium falciparum. The initiative was discussed at a 10 March meeting in Cox's Bazar with government, research institutions and humanitarian partners. The camps host more than 1.18 million Rohingya across 33 settlements near the Bangladesh-Myanmar border, where strengthened surveillance is aimed at preventing spread of resistance to treatments. BRAC data show confirmed malaria cases in camps rose from 7 in 2021 to 291 in 2025, underscoring ongoing risk. Funded by Global Affairs Canada, the study is expected to begin enrolling participants in April.

triage.triage_reason: 薬剤耐性マラリアの監視研究開始は異常・予想外な事象であり、国際的拡大リスクと重症度の観点から懸念がある。ミャンマー国境付近の難民キャンプという特殊環境での発生増加（2021年7例→2025年291例）は公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を持つ可能性が高い。
triage.notes: 薬剤耐性Plasmodium falciparumの監視研究という点で国際的に重要。118万人以上のロヒンギャ難民が居住する33の居住地という脆弱な人口集団への影響が懸念される。カナダ政府資金による国際支援が既に開始されており、バングラデシュ政府・研究機関・人道支援パートナーが関与する多機関協力体制が構築されている。アルテミシニン併用療法（ACT）への耐性出現はグローバルなマラリア対策上の重大な脅威となりうる。

article.articleHeadline: Ministra de Salud confirma muertes por fiebre amarilla
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Minister Confirms Deaths from Yellow Fever.
article.articleSummary: Venezuela confirms seven yellow fever cases in 2026 to date as part of an epidemiological alert. Health Minister Nuramy Gutierrez also confirmed some yellow fever deaths in 2025 but declined to release figures to avoid panic. Since the start of 2026, seven positive cases have been reported. Authorities aim to vaccinate 95% of the population; about 49,000 people have been immunized recently, joining roughly three million vaccinated in the prior decade. Since mid-2025, cases rose, with 75% of patients aged 10–49. The campaign prioritizes 22 parishes in Aragua, Lara, Portuguesa, and Barinas. On March 2, travelers to these regions must be vaccinated at least ten days before visiting during Semana Santa, and should wear long sleeves and use repellent in forests. Venezuela has received vaccine donations from India, South Korea, Russia, Brazil, and others. Caracas Metro hosts 23 free vaccination points offering yellow fever and other vaccines.

triage.triage_reason: ベネズエラにおける黄熱の死亡例確認と症例増加。2025年中頃から症例が増加し、2026年に7例が確認されているが、死亡者数が非公開とされている点で透明性に懸念。国際的なワクチン支援が必要とされ、周辺国への拡大リスクがある。
triage.notes: 2025年中頃からの症例増加傾向、死亡者数の非公開、患者の75%が10-49歳という年齢分布の偏り、95%接種目標に対し最近4.9万人のみの接種という不十分な対応状況、聖週間前の渡航制限措置、複数国からのワクチン支援受入れなど、公衆衛生上の重大な懸念が複数存在。フルRRAによる詳細評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: SP confirma caso de sarampo em bebê de 6 meses - 11/03/2026 - Equilíbrio e Saúde - Folha
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo confirms a measles case in a six-month-old baby - March 11, 2026 - Balance and Health - Folha
article.articleSummary: Measles case confirmed in São Paulo, Brazil: the first measles case of 2026 involves a six‑month‑old unvaccinated infant who contracted the disease during a January trip to Bolivia; case notified in February and lab-confirmed by March 11, 2026. Measles is highly contagious (high R0) and can cause pneumonia, encephalitis, and immune amnesia. Brazil, certified measles‑free in November 2024, last had autochthonous cases in Amapá, June 2022; imported cases trigger rapid public health actions but do not by themselves end certification. OPAS reports a 32‑fold rise in Americas measles cases from 2024 to 2025 (14,891 cases, 29 deaths in 2025; 22 Indigenous deaths). In Brazil, 38 cases across six states and the Federal District in 2025, with 10 acquired abroad: Tocantins 25, Mato Grosso 6, Rio de Janeiro 2, São Paulo 2, Rio Grande do Sul 1, Maranhão 1, DF 1. Vaccination: first dose at 12 months (MMR); second at 15 months (MMRV, includes varicella); adults’ guidance varies. Public health measures emphasize vaccination and case containment.

triage.triage_reason: ブラジルは2024年11月に麻疹排除認証を取得したにもかかわらず、2026年に輸入症例が発生。南北アメリカ地域で麻疹患者が2024年から2025年にかけて32倍増加し、国際的拡大リスクが高い。WHOによる排除認証国での輸入症例は国際的な公衆衛生上の関心事項であり、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ブラジルは2024年11月に麻疹排除認証を取得後、初の2026年症例。患児は6ヶ月（未接種年齢）でボリビア渡航中に感染した輸入例。南北アメリカ地域では2025年に14,891例・29死亡（先住民22名含む）と前年比32倍増。麻疹のR0は高く、肺炎・脳炎・免疫記憶喪失のリスクあり。ブラジル国内では2025年に6州とDFで38例（うち10例が国外感染）。排除認証国での輸入症例は迅速な封じ込め対策が必要であり、地域的な伝播拡大の監視が重要。
