article.articleHeadline: Leptospirose após enchentes: veja sintomas, riscos e como se proteger; Ubá confirma morte pela doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Leptospirosis after floods: symptoms, risks and how to protect yourself; Ubá confirms death from the disease.
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis outbreak in Ubá, Minas Gerais, Brazil, linked to recent floods that left seven deaths. Ubá reports 41 suspected cases (initially 37). The first flood-related death from leptospirosis was confirmed: a 33-year-old woman; death date not disclosed. Samples are being analyzed by Fundação Ezequiel Dias (Funed) in Belo Horizonte. Leptospirosis is caused by bacteria in rat urine that can contaminate floodwater and mud. Symptoms include fever, headache, severe body pain (calves), nausea, and malaise. If fever persists, vomiting worsens, or breathing difficulties occur, seek hospital care. Mild cases: Unidade Básica de Saúde; severe: emergency units or municipal hospitals. During cleanup, wear boots and rubber gloves; if unavailable, double plastic bags; disinfect contact surfaces with bleach (1 cup per 20 liters). SES-MG will monitor cases with ongoing lab analyses and epidemiological investigations, with health teams trained with SUS support.

triage.triage_reason: 洪水後のレプトスピラ症アウトブレイクで死亡例1名を含む41名の疑い例が報告されているが、国際的拡大リスクや詳細な疫学情報が不明であり、続報による情報補完が必要。
triage.notes: 洪水後のレプトスピラ症は予測可能なイベントであり異常性は低いが、死亡例を含む疫学的状況と検査結果の続報に注意が必要。ブラジル国内での対応能力は十分と判断されるが、症例数の増加傾向や重症化率については追加情報待ち。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de dengue tem 60% de queda no Distrito Federal; medidas de combate continuam
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue cases fall 60% in the Federal District; control measures continue.
article.articleSummary: Dengue in the Federal District of Brazil fell 60% to 1,719 notifications, down from 4,579 in the same period last year. In 2024, the district logged 122,896 dengue cases. A key control measure is the release of Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes to suppress transmission. Public health teams conducted over 1.8 million home visits, with drones and indoor residual spraying with fumacê (fogging) employed to identify and eliminate mosquito breeding sites. Vaccination campaigns are underway for youths aged 10–14. The report emphasizes ongoing vector-control efforts to curb dengue spread, with substantial year-over-year reductions.

triage.triage_reason: デング症例数が前年比60%減少という良好な傾向を示しており、現時点で深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念はない。ただし2024年に12万件超の症例があった地域での継続的なサーベイランスとして経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: ブラジル連邦区でのデング症例数は前年同期比60%減（4,579件→1,719件）。Wolbachia感染蚊の放出、180万件超の家庭訪問、ドローン活用、10-14歳へのワクチン接種など包括的な対策が実施中。2024年には12万件超の症例があったものの、現在は改善傾向。異常な増加や重症化の報告はなく、国内対応で管理可能な状況。継続的なベクターコントロールの成果を示す好事例として経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Estudo identifica nova linhagem de vírus amazônico no Rio de Janeiro e em Minas Gerais
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Study Identifies New Lineage of Amazonian Virus in Rio de Janeiro and Minas Gerais
article.articleSummary: New lineage of Oropouche virus identified circulating in Southeast Brazil (Rio de Janeiro and Minas Gerais), marking first genetic evidence of spread outside the Amazon. A January 2026 study in Open Forum Infectious Diseases followed 55 patients infected between December 2024 and May 2025 in Rio de Janeiro and Minas Gerais. Genomic analysis shows cases derive from a novel lineage formed by rearrangement of the virus genome, suggesting adaptation to the Southeast and potential establishment with fluctuating incidence. Clinically, patients predominantly report headache, malaise, fever, and myalgias; about 45% exhibit skin rash. Roughly one-third experience a second acute phase with symptom return about a week after initial improvement. Transmission occurs via the small insect maruim, not Aedes aegypti. Diagnosis may be supported by detecting viral RNA in urine for over three weeks, aiding confirmation and surveillance. Authors call for expanded surveillance and health-network awareness to monitor geographic spread.

triage.triage_reason: オロポウチウイルスの新系統がアマゾン域外（ブラジル南東部）で初めて遺伝学的に確認され、ゲノム再編成による適応の可能性が示唆される。地理的拡大と定着リスク、症状の特異性（二相性経過、尿からの長期ウイルス検出）から、国際的な公衆衛生上の関心が高く、WHOへの通知相当と判断される。
triage.notes: アマゾン固有とされてきたオロポウチウイルスが南東部で新系統として定着し始めた可能性があり、ゲノム再編成は病原性・伝播性の変化を示唆する。55症例の前向き研究で二相性経過や尿中長期排出（3週間以上）など診断・サーベイランス上重要な知見が得られている。媒介昆虫がAedes属でなくマルイム（ヌカカ類）である点も対策上の注意を要する。2024年12月～2025年5月の症例であり、継続的な地理的拡大の監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Cianjur lakukan berbagai langkah tekan penularan cacar air anak - ANTARA News Megapolitan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cianjur Health Office takes various steps to curb the spread of chickenpox among children - ANTARA News Megapolitan
article.articleSummary: Cianjur, West Java, Indonesia – The Cianjur District Health Office (Dinkes) reports rising chickenpox (varicella) transmission among children in several subdistricts over the past week, though cases remain under control with no significant surge. Authorities are strengthening prevention via complete immunization campaigns, including catch-up vaccinations for children not yet fully immunized, and expanded parent education. Hesitancy persists, with many parents declining full immunization for various reasons; health workers are intensifying outreach. If a child exhibits fever with vesicular rash, seek care promptly. Emphasize healthy living and regular health checks at local health centers, and follow health staff guidance to curb spread.

triage.triage_reason: 水痘（水ぼうそう）の地域での散発的増加だが、当局による「制御下にあり顕著な急増なし」との評価。通常の予防接種強化と保護者教育で対応可能な範囲であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当せず、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念は低い。
triage.notes: 水痘は小児によく見られるワクチン予防可能疾患であり、今回のインドネシア西ジャワ州チアンジュール県での事例は地域保健当局が通常の公衆衛生対応（予防接種キャンペーン、保護者教育）で管理している。死亡例や重症化の報告なし、国際的拡大リスクなし、WHOへの通知要件を満たさない日常的な地域感染症事例と判断。

article.articleHeadline: WHO hỗ trợ khẩn thuốc giải độc botulinum từ Thụy Sĩ đến Đà Nẵng cứu 3 trẻ ngộ độc cá ủ chua
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO urgently provides botulinum antitoxin from Switzerland to Da Nang to save three children poisoned by fermented fish.
article.articleSummary: WHO urgently provided five vials of Botulism Antitoxin Heptavalent (BAT) from the global stock in Geneva to Da Nang, Vietnam, on the night of 11 March, to treat three children in critical condition suspected of botulism after consuming fermented fish. Five patients were admitted on 9 March for food poisoning after pickled fish, with one confirmed positive for Clostridium botulinum. The three severely ill patients are H.N.T. (15), H.Q.B. (11), and H.Q.N. (7). BAT is scarce, and rapid administration can halt toxin activity and improve outcomes. WHO coordinated across national, regional, and headquarters levels to source the drug and arrange transport, working with the Ministry of Health, local authorities, airport partners, and logistics teams. KDCA was thanked for ongoing regional support. This case highlights rapid international collaboration to counter botulism and foodborne toxins.

triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WHOが緊急に国際備蓄からの抗毒素提供を調整した稀少疾患アウトブレイクであり、既に国際的な対応が開始されている。
triage.notes: WHOが緊急に国際備蓄（ジュネーブ）から稀少な抗毒素を提供し、国・地域・本部レベルで調整を行った事例。3名の重症小児患者（15歳、11歳、7歳）が発酵魚摂取後にボツリヌス中毒疑いで重篤状態。1名はClostridium botulinum陽性確認済み。食品由来の国際的公衆衛生上の懸念事例であり、同様の発酵魚製品の流通・輸出入に関する渡航・貿易への影響可能性がある。既に国際支援が実施されており、フルRRAによる詳細評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ubá registra primeira morte por leptospirose após enchentes no município
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ubá Records First Death from Leptospirosis After Floods in the Municipality.
article.articleSummary: Ubá, Brazil, reported its first leptospirosis death on March 11, 2026, after floods raised the river ~8 meters and caused severe inundation. Forty-one suspected cases were notified following the February floods. The death was confirmed by RT-qPCR with a result released on March 10, 2026; samples were sent to Fundação Ezequiel Dias (FUNED) in Belo Horizonte, with results for others pending. Health authorities are intensifying surveillance and guidance in affected areas. Leptospirosis is caused by Leptospira bacteria shed in rat urine and can contaminate floodwater and mud. Precautions: wear waterproof gloves and rubber boots, cover wounds, avoid touching the face, eyes, or mouth. Symptoms appear 2–14 days after exposure and include fever, muscle pain (calves), severe headache, red eyes, and nausea; seek care promptly.

triage.triage_reason: 洪水後のレプトスピラ症死亡例として通常の範囲内と考えられるが、疑い例41件の確定診断結果待ちであり、規模や重症度の全容が不明なため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 洪水後のレプトスピラ症は予測可能な事象。死亡1例、疑い例41件（2026年2月洪水後）。41件の検査結果が判明すれば規模・重症度の評価が可能になるため続報を注視すべき。現時点では地域的な公衆衛生対応で管理可能と推定される。

article.articleHeadline: Se cumplen 6 años desde el primer caso de Covid-19
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Six years since the first case of COVID-19.
article.articleSummary: Six years after the first COVID-19 case in Morelos, health authorities report ongoing epidemiologic surveillance, with current cases low thanks to vaccination and preventive measures. The first case in the state was registered in March 2020 after SARS-CoV-2 emerged in 2019 in China. Official data show that from 2020 through April 2023 Morelos confirmed about 102,000 COVID-19 cases and around 5,400 deaths. Although the public health emergency ended in May 2023, monitoring continues through Respiratory Disease Monitoring Health Units. In 2025, 2,057 suspected cases were studied; 102 tested positive and 9 deaths were recorded. The specialist notes that Omicron subvariants predominate now and the virus presents lower severity due to immunity from vaccination and prior infections; older adults and people with chronic diseases remain at higher risk. Authorities reiterate preventive measures: vaccination, frequent handwashing, and wearing a mask if respiratory symptoms occur.

triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の定常的なサーベイランス報告であり、異常性・予想外の事象はなく、現在の感染状況は低レベルで管理されている。6周年という記念的な報道であり、新たな公衆衛生上の懸念を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: メキシコ・モレロス州におけるCOVID-19の6周年記念報道。2025年の症例数は102例、死亡9例と低レベル。ワクチン接種と予防措置により重症度は低下しており、通常のサーベイランス活動の範囲内。オミクロン亜系統が優勢だが特異的な変異株の報告なし。定期的な状況更新であり、緊急性のあるシグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: Hospital de SP fecha UTI após 7 pacientes infectados por superbactéria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo hospital shuts down its ICU after 7 patients were infected with a superbug.
article.articleSummary: Seven patients at Hospital Mário Gatti diagnosed with KPC (Klebsiella pneumoniae carbapenemase), a carbapenemase-producing superbacteria, prompted the temporary shutdown of the adult ICU to halt the outbreak. The seven infected patients will be isolated in a dedicated ICU wing with a separate care team, while other inpatients in the area are moved to equivalent beds within the municipal network. New ICU admissions will be redirected to Hospital Ouro Verde or other units via the municipal regulation center; the central and SAMU have instructions accordingly. The contingency plan includes enhanced cleaning, terminal bed cleaning, intensified hand hygiene, and staff training, and is under review by the Department of Public Health Surveillance. KPC infections are monitored in high-complexity hospital settings, with the hospital reaffirming commitment to patient safety, care quality, and transparency.

triage.triage_reason: KPC産生菌による院内感染アウトブレイクでICU閉鎖という深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、薬剤耐性菌の拡大リスクと医療システムへの影響が懸念される。IHR基準2つ以上、WPROスクリーニング基準複数に該当。
triage.notes: KPC（カルバペネム耐性肺炎桿菌）は薬剤耐性菌として国際的に重要な病原体。ICU閉鎖という医療システムへの影響、7名の感染確認、院内感染制御の必要性から重症度・管理可能性の観点で懸念。ブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州の地域的アウトブレイクだが、耐性菌の特性上、医療機関間での拡大監視が必要。保健当局が介入し対策実施中だが、外部支援の必要性は記事からは不明。疾患名が「Unknown Illness」と分類されているが、実際はKPC感染症として特定されている。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo registra o primeiro caso de sarampo em 2026; paciente é uma bebê
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo records the first case of measles in 2026; the patient is a baby.
article.articleSummary: As of March 11, 2026, São Paulo state records its first measles case of 2026, a baby, following two imported measles cases in 2025. Vaccination remains the best protection; the measles vaccine is part of the National Immunization Schedule, with the first dose at 12 months and the second at 15 months. A catch-up vaccination is advised for individuals aged 5–29 years, two doses at least 30 days apart; those aged 30–59 years should receive a new dose. The World Health Organization issued a February alert, noting a 32-fold increase in measles infections in the Americas during 2024–2025.

triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ州で2026年初の麻疹症例（乳児1例）が報告されたが、詳細情報（感染源、重症度、ワクチン接種歴等）が不足しており、現時点では経過観察が適切。ただしWHOが2024-2025年に南北アメリカで麻疹感染が32倍増加したと警告しており、地域的な流行拡大の可能性に注意が必要。
triage.notes: 2025年に2例の輸入症例があり、2026年初例は予想範囲内。患者は乳児でワクチン未接種の可能性が高い。WHOの南北アメリカ地域における麻疹急増警告（32倍増）を考慮すると、今後の症例増加や地域内伝播の可能性を注視する必要がある。カナリア諸島への言及もあるが詳細不明。続報で感染源特定、二次感染の有無、ワクチン接種率等の情報収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Pemerintah soroti potensi peningkatan campak saat mudik lebaran
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Government Highlights the Potential Rise in Measles During Eid al-Fitr Homecoming
article.articleSummary: As of 11 March 2026, Indonesia’s government warns of a potential rise in measles during Eid al-Fitr homecoming (mudik) as mass travel increases transmission risk. Health authorities are paying special attention to measles spread and urge the public to remain vigilant about health during mudik. The report does not provide current case counts, laboratory-confirmed details, or identified infection sources. It emphasizes proactive surveillance and public health awareness during the Lebaran period to mitigate possible transmission, without reporting an active outbreak. No information on imported or exported cases is mentioned; the message underscores preparedness rather than a declared outbreak. Authorities emphasize surveillance, risk communication, and health precautions during travel to reduce transmission risk.

triage.triage_reason: レバラン帰省期における麻疹伝播リスクの警告であるが、現時点で実際の症例増加や異常発生は報告されていない。予防的サーベイランス強化の段階であり、具体的な疫学データが不足しているため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: これは実際のアウトブレイク報告ではなく、レバラン（イード・アル・フィトル）期の大規模人口移動に伴う麻疹伝播リスクに関する予防的警告。症例数、検査確認例、感染源等の疫学情報は記載なし。政府は予防的サーベイランスと啓発を強化中。実際の症例増加が確認された場合は再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 30岁男子回老家喝了碗"好东西"，半年后深夜抽搐口吐白沫倒地！医生看完CT倒吸凉气，寄生虫在头部安家......
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 30-year-old man returns to his hometown, drinks a bowl of 'good stuff'; six months later, in the middle of the night he convulses, foams at the mouth, and collapses! Doctors gasp after the CT scan—parasites have taken up residence in his brain...
article.articleSummary: As of March 11, 2026, a man in his 30s from Shanwei, Guangdong, developed neurocysticercosis after six months of eating raw pig blood. In July 2025 he presented with a seizure and unconsciousness; MRI showed an intracranial lesion in the right frontal lobe, initially raising tumor concerns. After transfer to Hangzhou’s Shulan Hospital, Dr. Gao Haina’s team excluded tumors and diagnosed brain cysticercosis, with Taenia solium cysticerci entering the CNS via the bloodstream following exposure to undercooked pig blood. About six months of targeted therapy led to shrinking edema and lesion reduction; a March 2026 follow-up confirmed ongoing improvement. The report emphasizes that neurocysticercosis accounts for 60–80% of cysticercosis cases in China, with roughly 3 million people infected nationwide. Preventive guidance: do not consume raw pig blood, ensure pork blood and meat are cooked to 100°C, avoid folk remedies, and disclose dietary history to clinicians.

triage.triage_reason: 単発の散発症例であり、集団発生や異常な疫学的パターンは認められない。神経嚢虫症は中国で既知の風土病であり、生の豚血摂取という明確な曝露歴がある個別症例。公衆衛生上の緊急対応を要する国際的なシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 中国では神経嚢虫症が年間約300万人の感染者を抱える既知の風土病。本件は2025年7月発症の単一症例で、2026年3月時点で治療経過良好。生の豚血摂取という明確なリスク行動に起因し、疫学的に予想される範囲内。集団発生・アウトブレイク・新規病原体の示唆なし。教育啓発目的のメディア報道と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo confirma primeiro caso de sarampo em 2026 - Jornal de Brasília
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo confirms first measles case in 2026 - Jornal de Brasília.
article.articleSummary: {"description":"São Paulo reports the first measles case: a six-month-old unvaccinated infant infected during a trip to Bolivia; notification in February and lab-confirmed. Measles is highly contagious, causing pneumonia, encephalitis, and immune amnesia increasing susceptibility to other infections. Brazil was certified measles-free in November 2024; the last autochthonous case was in Amapá in June 2022. Imported cases trigger vaccination, contact tracing, testing, and isolation to maintain elimination. In the Americas, measles cases rose 32-fold from 2024–2025, totaling 14,891 cases and 29 deaths, 73% of deaths among Indigenous people. In Brazil, 38 cases across six states and Federal District; 10 acquired abroad: Tocantins 25; Mato Grosso 6; Rio de Janeiro 2; São Paulo 2; Rio Grande do Sul 1; Maranhão 1; DF 1. Vaccination: first dose at 12 months; second at 15 months; ages 5–29 should have two doses; 30–59 one dose; health workers two doses. Vaccination remains the main prevention."}

triage.triage_reason: ブラジルが2024年11月に麻疹排除認定を受けた直後の輸入症例であり、南北アメリカ大陸での麻疹症例が2024-2025年に32倍増加している中での発生。国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の深刻性が認められ、WHOへの通知相当事案と判断される。
triage.notes: 麻疹排除認定国での輸入症例は国際的に重要な監視対象。南北アメリカ大陸全体で2024-2025年に症例が急増（14,891例、29死亡）しており、ブラジルでも6州で38例報告。未接種乳児への感染であり、接触者追跡・ワクチン接種強化が実施中。先住民族での死亡率が高い（73%）点も懸念材料。排除認定維持のための迅速な対応が取られているが、地域的流行拡大の可能性を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Aos 86 anos, Fulvio Stefanini contrai infecção e cancela apresentações de 'O Pai' no Rio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: At 86, Fulvio Stefanini contracts an infection and cancels performances of 'The Father' in Rio de Janeiro.
article.articleSummary: 86-year-old actor Fulvio Stefanini contracted a bacterial infection, was hospitalized for examinations and treatment, and has canceled the weekend performances (March 13–15) of the play The Father at Teatro TotalEnergies in Rio de Janeiro’s Glória district. The cancellation affects shows scheduled for March 13, 14 and 15 and was confirmed on March 11 by the production’s communications team. Stefanini is expected to be discharged next week and to return to the stage thereafter. Tickets purchased can be revalidated for another session, subject to availability, according to the production. The information was provided to Quem on Wednesday, March 11.

triage.triage_reason: 個人（俳優）の細菌感染症による入院事例であり、集団発生や公衆衛生上の脅威を示す情報はない。演劇公演の中止は個人の健康問題によるものであり、感染症アウトブレイクを示唆するものではない。
triage.notes: 86歳の俳優個人の細菌感染症による入院事例。集団感染、アウトブレイク、または公衆衛生上のリスクを示す情報は含まれていない。疾患名も'Unknown Illness'と分類されているが、記事では細菌感染症と特定されており、治療・退院予定も明確。公衆衛生監視の対象とはならない個別症例。

article.articleHeadline: Segundo caso de Mpox no ES é confirmado em morador da Serra
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Second Mpox case in Espírito Santo confirmed in a Serra resident.
article.articleSummary: Second Mpox case in Espírito Santo confirmed in a Serra resident. In 2025, Brazil reported 1,079 Mpox cases and two deaths; Espírito Santo had 39 diagnoses. Mpox is caused by the Monkeypox virus and spreads via close contact with lesions and body fluids, skin-to-skin contact, respiratory droplets or aerosols, and contaminated objects. The most common symptom is a skin eruption with blisters or sores lasting 2–4 weeks; fever, headache, muscle and back pain, fatigue, and swollen lymph nodes may accompany. Incubation ranges from 3 to 16 days, up to 21. Treatment is symptomatic; no specific antiviral is approved. Most cases are mild to moderate, but newborns, children, and immunocompromised individuals are at higher risk for severe disease, including extensive lesions and secondary infections; severe cases may require hospitalization or ICU.

triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・エスピリト・サント州での2例目のMpox確認例。2025年通年で国内1,079例・2死亡、同州39例の流行状況下での散発例であり、異常性・予想外の事象なし。国際的拡大リスクや社会的関心の高まりを示唆する情報もない。
triage.notes: 2025年の年間統計（1,079例、2死亡）の文脈では、州内2例目は既知の流行パターン内の散発例。新規変異株・アウトブレイク・重症化率上昇等の言及なし。通常サーベイランスの範囲内と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Bộ Y tế Việt Nam và Pháp cùng hợp tác nghiên cứu bệnh truyền nhiễm mới nổi 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vietnam's Ministry of Health and France to jointly study emerging infectious diseases in 2026.
article.articleSummary: On 11 March 2026, at the Vietnam Ministry of Health, Deputy Minister Nguyen Thi Liên Hương met French ANRS MIE Director Yazdan Yazdanpanah to discuss expanding ANRS MIE's research partnership on infectious diseases in Vietnam, including emerging infections. Participants included leaders from relevant departments, Hanoi Medical University, and Hai Phong University of Medicine and Pharmacy; representatives from ANRS MIE and the French Embassy attended. The talks reviewed past collaboration in HIV/AIDS, viral hepatitis, tuberculosis, and other diseases, and outlined plans to broaden joint research and strengthen training, laboratories, and treatment facilities. Proposed focus areas include HIV, hepatitis B and C, sexually transmitted infections, TB, and other emerging pathogens, with emphasis on policy guidance and workforce development; Hai Phong could be expanded nationally. Separately, the ANRS MIE Partners in Vietnam 2026 conference over 150 experts promotes clinical research and evidence-based health policy for outbreak prevention under the Prevention Law; Thái Bình was noted.

triage.triage_reason: これは研究協力・会議の開催に関する予定・計画の発表であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態ではない。既存疾患（HIV、B型肝炎、結核等）の研究強化が主題であり、新規の異常事象は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 2026年3月11日にベトナム保健省とフランスANRS MIEが感染症研究の協力拡大について会談し、150名以上の専門家が参加する会議が開催される予定という内容。実際の疾患発生イベントではなく、研究・政策協力の強化に関する行政的な発表である。HIV、B型・C型肝炎、結核、性感染症等の既知疾患が対象であり、具体的な症例数・死亡者・アウトブレイクの報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: سحب منتجات محار من الأسواق الأمريكية لتلوث محتمل بفيروس شديد العدوى
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Oyster products recalled from American markets due to potential contamination with a highly contagious virus.
article.articleSummary: FDA recalls Manila oysters harvested from Drayton Harbor, Washington, over potential Norovirus contamination. Nine states—Arizona, California, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Nevada, New York, Oregon, and Washington—were asked to stop selling these oysters. Washington consumers who bought raw oysters from Drayton Harbor Oyster Company are advised not to eat them and to discard immediately. Harvest dates ranged Feb 23–Mar 3, 2026, with shells harvested from Drayton Harbor, Washington. Norovirus spreads via contaminated food or contact with infected surfaces; symptoms appear 12–48 hours after exposure and include nausea, diarrhea, vomiting, with dehydration risk, especially for older adults and those with underlying conditions. Nationwide, Norovirus infects about 20 million Americans annually, drives ~2 million doctor visits, and causes around 2,500 outbreaks per year.

triage.triage_reason: 米国における牡蠣のノロウイルス汚染による通常のリコール事案。季節性の一般的な食品媒介感染症であり、異常性・重症度・国際的拡大リスクのいずれも認められない。
triage.notes: ノロウイルスは米国で年間2000万人が感染し、約2500件のアウトブレイクが発生する一般的な疾患。今回はワシントン州Drayton Harbor産牡蠣の予防的リコール（2026年2月23日～3月3日収穫分）で、9州に流通。FDAによる通常の食品安全対応であり、症例数・重症度・国際的影響のいずれも言及なし。フィリピン・マニラが発生地域に含まれているが記事内容との関連は不明。定型的な食品安全管理事案と判断。

article.articleHeadline: MG confirma morte por leptospirose após chuvas que atingiram a Zona da Mata
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Minas Gerais confirms death from leptospirosis after rains that hit the Zona da Mata.
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis outbreak linked to February floods in Minas Gerais, Brazil, with Ubá reporting a March 10 death (a 33-year-old woman) and Minas Gerais totaling 55 confirmed cases and 7 deaths. Ubá also has 41 cases under investigation, plus approximately 396 displaced and 25 homeless residents. Juiz de Fora remains the state’s hardest-hit city, with at least 65 deaths and thousands displaced (about 3,500 evacuees and 700 homeless). Leptospirosis is caused by Leptospira bacteria shed in rat urine; human exposure occurs via contact with floodwater and mud. Symptoms include fever, body aches, headache, nausea, and malaise. A late February epidemiological alert urged intensified surveillance, vector control, and community mobilization. Ubá’s actions include ongoing monitoring, cleaning, debris removal, and recovery of flood-affected areas to limit transmission.

triage.triage_reason: 洪水後のレプトスピラ症アウトブレイクで死亡7例を含む55確定例が報告されており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と異常事態に該当。継続的な洪水曝露と大規模な避難民（数千人）により疫学的拡大リスクも認められる。
triage.notes: 2月の洪水に関連した典型的な災害後レプトスピラ症アウトブレイク。Juiz de Fora市で特に被害が大きく死亡65例・避難民3500人超。疫学警報発出済みで監視強化・ベクター対策・地域動員が実施中。調査中症例41例もあり規模拡大の可能性。洪水水・泥との接触による感染拡大が継続するリスクあり。

article.articleHeadline: Ba trẻ ngộ độc thực phẩm sau khi ăn cá ủ chua tại Đà Nẵng , WHO hỗ trợ thuốc giải độc
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three children poisoned after eating fermented fish in Da Nang; WHO provides antidotes.
article.articleSummary: Three Da Nang students (ages 15, 11, and 7) are suspected of botulism after eating fermented fish on 7 March, with a cluster of related family cases. The eldest developed coma, respiratory failure, dyspnea, dilated pupils and required intubation and mechanical ventilation; the other two showed abdominal pain, nausea, weakness, ptosis, and dyspnea, with one also ventilated. Initial care occurred at Phuoc Son Regional Medical Center, then transfer to Quang Nam’s Northern Mountains Regional Hospital for severe treatment; subsequently, two patients were moved to Da Nang’s Center for Obstetrics and Pediatrics for continued care. Laboratory confirmation is pending, but botulinum toxin is suspected, and plasmapheresis has been used. WHO has provided five vials of Botulinum Antitoxin Heptavalent (BAT); transported from Switzerland to Hanoi and scheduled to fly to Da Nang by 20:00 on 11 March for rapid administration at Da Nang Hospital for Women and Children and at Quang Nam hospital.

triage.triage_reason: ボツリヌス中毒の集団発生で重症例（昏睡、呼吸不全、人工呼吸管理）あり。WHOが国際支援（抗毒素提供）を実施しており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当。フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 発酵魚（cá ủ chua）摂取後の家族内集団発生。15歳児が昏睡・呼吸不全で挿管、他2名も神経症状あり。WHO抗毒素がスイスからハノイ経由でダナンへ緊急輸送中。検査室診断は保留中だが臨床的にボツリヌス中毒疑い。重症度高く国際支援が必要なケースとして要注目。

article.articleHeadline: Ubá confirma primeira morte por leptospirose após enchentes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ubá confirms first death from leptospirosis after floods.
article.articleSummary: Ubá, Minas Gerais, Brazil, reports its first death from leptospirosis following February floods. The victim is a woman aged 30-35. The death was confirmed by RT-qPCR laboratory testing. The municipality currently records 41 suspected leptospirosis cases under investigation; collected samples have been sent for analysis, with patients awaiting results. Leptospirosis is caused by Leptospira bacteria and typically transmitted through contact with water or mud contaminated by animal urine, especially rats. Symptoms usually appear 2-14 days after exposure and range from fever, headache, and muscle pain to more severe illness. The outbreak is linked to flooding from February; no details on imported/exported cases were provided. Public health authorities emphasize monitoring and laboratory confirmation to guide response.

triage.triage_reason: 洪水後のレプトスピラ症で死亡例1件と疑い例41件が報告されているが、異常性・国際拡大リスクの評価には情報不足。洪水関連の典型的な感染症パターンであり、続報による疫学的詳細の確認が必要。
triage.notes: 洪水後のレプトスピラ症は予測可能な事象だが、死亡例1件・疑い例41件の規模がブラジル・ミナスジェライス州Ubá市において異常かどうかは過去データとの比較が必要。RT-qPCR確認済みで検査体制は機能しており、現時点で国際支援は不要と判断。疑い例の検査結果と追加症例の発生動向を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: BuCor denies scabies outbreak at New Bilibid Prison
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-03-11, the Bureau of Corrections (BuCor) denies any scabies outbreak at New Bilibid Prison in Muntinlupa or at other penal farms. Chief Supt. Ma. Cecilia Villanueva, acting director for Health and Welfare Services, said there is no health emergency currently affecting the national penitentiary system. The bureau notes the last scabies outbreak occurred two years ago, during which a mass treatment campaign for inmates was conducted in partnership with the International Committee of the Red Cross. No new cases or active transmission have been reported since, according to BuCor. The statement follows circulating reports of an outbreak, with authorities citing ongoing surveillance and the prior large-scale treatment as context.

triage.triage_reason: 当局が疥癬のアウトブレイクを公式に否定しており、現在の健康危機は存在しないと明言。最後のアウトブレイクは2年前で、以降新規症例や活発な伝播は報告されていない。
triage.notes: フィリピン矯正局（BuCor）が疥癬アウトブレイクの報道を公式否定。現在の健康危機なし、最後のアウトブレイクは2年前（2024年）で赤十字と協力した集団治療を実施済み。継続的なサーベイランスが行われており、新規症例や活発な伝播は報告されていない。疥癬は一般的に国際的拡大リスクが低く、刑務所内の限定的な環境での管理可能な疾患である。当局の否定声明のみで実際のアウトブレイクを示す証拠がないため、シグナルとして取り上げる必要性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Over two dozen jaundice cases reported in Himachal town; locals allege supply contamination, delayed response
article.articleSummary: Jaundice outbreak reported in Baru and adjacent Swahal areas of Hamirpur district, Himachal Pradesh, affecting over two dozen people, including 13 students of Swahal Government High School, with cases active since March 4. Water samples are being collected as authorities investigate a suspected link to the Jamli drinking water scheme, amid allegations that contaminated supply could be fueling transmission. Sewage leakage from nearby industrial units is also being examined as a contributory factor. Patients are being treated at a medical college; health and Jal Shakti departments have been alerted, and precautionary measures are advised. Chief Minister Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu will visit and has directed district authorities to provide adequate medicines and fast-track the investigation. The Jamli water supply services Swahal, Bhati, and Majhot; the outbreak cause remains under investigation.

triage.triage_reason: 学校を含む集団発生で公衆衛生上の深刻な影響があり、汚染水源による継続的曝露リスクと地域拡大の可能性がある。州首相の指示による対応が必要とされており、政府の関心も高い。
triage.notes: 3月4日以降活発な黄疸症例が24名超（学校生徒13名含む）発生。Jamli飲料水供給システムの汚染と工業排水漏洩が疑われ、複数地域（Swahal、Bhati、Majhot）に給水。州首相が現地訪問を予定し迅速な原因究明を指示。継続的な水源汚染による更なる拡大懸念あり。病原体特定と感染経路確認のための続報監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Após enchentes, Ubá confirma primeira morte por leptospirose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After floods, Ubá confirms first death from leptospirosis.
article.articleSummary: Ubá, Minas Gerais, Brazil, reports the first death from leptospirosis after February floods. A woman aged 30-35 died; 41 suspected leptospirosis cases are under epidemiological investigation in the municipality. Samples have been sent to Fundação Ezequiel Dias in Belo Horizonte for laboratory analysis. Leptospirosis can be transmitted via water or mud contaminated with rat urine, a risk highlighted after the floods. Health authorities urge residents to seek care at a health unit if symptoms appear and to obtain hospital care immediately if conditions worsen. In the broader Minas Gerais floods, Zona da Mata fatalities reached 72 by late February, including 65 in Juiz de Fora and seven in Ubá, with thousands displaced. All updates as of 11 March 2026.

triage.triage_reason: 洪水後のレプトスピラ症アウトブレイクで初の死亡例が確認され、41例の疑い例が調査中。災害関連の感染症として公衆衛生上の深刻な影響があり、WPROスクリーニング基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: 2月の洪水により数千人が避難し、Zona da Mata地域全体で72名の死者が出ている大規模災害に関連。洪水後のレプトスピラ症発生は予測可能だが、死亡例と多数の疑い例は公衆衛生上の重要なシグナル。汚染された水・泥への長期曝露リスクが継続し、ヒト-環境感染経路による流行拡大の可能性あり。保健当局が積極的な監視と住民への注意喚起を実施中。

article.articleHeadline: BuCor denies scabies outbreak in PH prisons
article.articleSummary: BuCor denies scabies outbreak in Philippine prisons, including New Bilibid Prison (NBP) and other facilities; as of 11 March 2026, no outbreak has been monitored. The last scabies outbreak was recorded two years earlier (around March 2024) during an ICRC-coordinated 'Alis Galis' activity. NGO Kapatid raised concerns about overcrowding and water shortages and claimed coordination difficulties with BuCor and NBP. BuCor says it has strict medicine-entry protocols to protect health and prevent contraband: medicines brought by relatives must be deposited with the Directorate for Health and Welfare Services; an itemized list and labeled containers are required; a pharmacist must issue a receipt; a valid prescription is required; medical officers or pharmacists verify disposition. BuCor emphasizes continued capability to address health issues in correctional facilities and assures the public that measures are in place.

triage.triage_reason: 当局がアウトブレイクを否定しており、現時点で異常事例は確認されていない。最後の疥癬アウトブレイクは2年前（2024年3月頃）であり、現在は通常の管理体制下にある。
triage.notes: フィリピン刑務所局（BuCor）が疥癬アウトブレイクを公式に否定。NGOが過密と水不足を懸念しているが、当局は医薬品管理プロトコルを含む健康管理体制が整っていると強調。疥癬は接触感染する皮膚疾患だが国際的拡大リスクは低く、刑務所内の限定的な問題。現時点で症例数の報告もなく、公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Jaundice Outbreak Sparks Concerns in Himachal Pradesh's Hamirpur | Health
article.articleSummary: Jaundice outbreak in the Hamirpur region of Himachal Pradesh, India, has affected more than two dozen people, including 13 schoolchildren. As of 11 March 2026, cases have risen since 4 March, with authorities attributing the cluster to contaminated drinking water. Concerns have been raised that sewage from nearby industrial areas may be contributing to contamination. Jal Shakti and health departments have launched investigations and are collecting water samples to determine the cause and curb spread. Chief Minister Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu is monitoring the situation and has requested a comprehensive inquiry to ensure adequate medical support and preventive measures, particularly for affected schoolchildren.

triage.triage_reason: 学校での集団発生を含む2ダース以上の黄疸症例が報告され、汚染飲料水が原因とされている。環境汚染による曝露継続のリスクがあり、IHR基準2つ（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性）およびWPRO基準3つ以上に該当。州首相が監視し包括的調査を指示しており政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 疾患名が「Unknown Illness」だが記事内容から黄疸(Jaundice)と特定されている。工業地域からの下水による飲料水汚染が疑われ、継続的曝露リスクが高い。学童13名を含む24名以上が罹患し3月4日以降増加傾向。水質調査と医療支援が実施中だが、原因病原体の特定情報が不足しており、続報での病原体確認（A型肝炎ウイルス等）が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Sergipe registra caso de meningite meningocócica em paciente de 50 anos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sergipe reports a case of meningococcal meningitis in a 50-year-old patient.
article.articleSummary: Sergipe state (Aracaju) reports a meningococcal meningitis case in a 50-year-old man admitted to Hospital de Urgência de Sergipe (HUSE) in Aracaju. The SES confirmed the patient is evolving favorably and receiving standard clinical care; close contacts have been notified and appropriate precautions implemented. Vaccination remains the main preventive measure and is offered free at municipal Basic Health Units, with ongoing epidemiological monitoring. Meningococcal meningitis is caused by Neisseria meningitidis and affects the membranes around the brain and spinal cord. In Brazil, the principal circulating serogroups are B, C, W, and Y. The report highlights surveillance and vaccination as key public health measures during the ongoing situation.

triage.triage_reason: 単一の散発例で、患者は良好に回復中。接触者への対策も実施済み。ワクチン接種可能な既知の疾患であり、ブラジルでは既知の血清型が流行中。異常性・重症度・国際拡大リスクは低い。
triage.notes: 50歳男性1例のみの報告。患者は良好に回復中で標準的治療を受けている。接触者への通知と予防措置は既に実施済み。ブラジルでは血清型B、C、W、Yが主要な流行株として既知であり、無料ワクチン接種が基礎保健施設で実施されている。通常のサーベイランス対象疾患として適切に管理されており、集団発生や異常な疫学的パターンは認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Morte por leptospirose é confirmada em Ubá; outros 41 casos estão em investigação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death from leptospirosis confirmed in Ubá; 41 additional cases are under investigation.
article.articleSummary: Death from leptospirosis confirmed in Ubá, Minas Gerais, as floods prompt health actions. A 33-year-old woman has died; 41 additional suspected cases are under epidemiological investigation. Suspected-case samples are being analyzed by Fundação Ezequiel Dias (FUNED) in Belo Horizonte, with results pending. Municipal health surveillance reports ongoing monitoring and intensified prevention measures, with further updates as laboratory analyses conclude. Leptospirosis is an acute febrile infection transmitted via contact with water or soil contaminated with urine from infected animals, especially rats. In Minas Gerais, during the 2025/2026 rainy period, 55 confirmed cases and 7 deaths have been recorded. The state government is allocating about R$ 8.3 million to Ubá to strengthen health services and stock medicines/vaccines, including new cold storage. Citizens with fever, body aches, headache, nausea, or malaise should seek immediate medical care.

triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事象、国際拡大リスク）。洪水関連レプトスピラ症アウトブレイクで死亡例1名、疑い例41件調査中。ミナスジェライス州全体で雨季に55確定例・7死亡と深刻な状況。
triage.notes: 洪水後のレプトスピラ症アウトブレイク。州全体で2025/2026雨季に55確定例・7死亡は過去データとの比較が必要だが、Ubá市単独で42件（1確定+41疑い）は局所的集積を示唆。州政府が830万レアル（約150万USD相当）の緊急予算配分し医薬品・ワクチン備蓄強化中。環境要因（洪水による汚染水への曝露継続）により更なる症例増加リスクあり。FUNED検査結果待ちで疫学像が変化する可能性。気候変動関連健康影響の観点からも注目すべき事象。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes DKI Jakarta: Belum Ada Kasus Campak Ditemukan di Ibu Kota
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DKI Jakarta Health Office: No Measles Cases Found in the Capital Yet.
article.articleSummary: Measles update: As of 11 March 2026, the DKI Jakarta Health Office reports no confirmed measles cases in Jakarta. In response to social media discussions, Kepala Dinas Kesehatan Ani Ruspitawati says Jakarta has not identified any positive measles cases, though surveillance at multiple healthcare facilities continues for influenza-like illness (ILI) and severe acute respiratory infection (SARI). If patients exhibit measles-like symptoms, samples will be sent to laboratories for testing; Jakarta has not shown cases, while neighboring areas around Jakarta have begun to report cases. The most vulnerable are infants and young children. With Lebaran (Eid al-Fitr) holiday crowds expected, authorities urge vigilance and caution. Parents are advised not to touch or kiss infants and toddlers; suspected cases should seek laboratory confirmation.

triage.triage_reason: 現時点でジャカルタでは麻疹確定例なしだが、周辺地域で症例報告開始。大規模宗教行事（レバラン）を控え、サーベイランス強化中。続報により状況が変化する可能性あり。
triage.notes: ジャカルタ首都圏では確定例ゼロだが、周辺地域で症例が出始めている点に注意。レバラン（イスラム教の断食明け大祭）による大規模人口移動を控え、当局がサーベイランス強化・注意喚起を実施中。乳幼児が最脆弱層。SNS上で議論が活発化しており社会的関心は高い。現段階では情報不足のためWATCH判定とし、周辺地域の症例数・ジャカルタでの検出状況の続報を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo registra caso importado de sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo records an imported case of measles
article.articleSummary: São Paulo, Brazil, reports the first measles case of 2026: a 6-month-old girl in the capital. The infection is imported from Bolivia, where she traveled in January. Brazil has had no autochthonous measles transmission since June 2022; all subsequent cases have been imported. Globally, PAHO/OPAS shows 14,891 confirmed cases in the Americas in 2025 with 29 deaths, up 32-fold from 2024. Leading countries were Mexico (6,428), Canada (5,436) and the United States (2,242). Vaccination is emphasized; the routine two-dose schedule begins at 12 months, then at 15 months, using the MMR vaccine provided free in the public system. Measles is highly transmissible; initial symptoms resemble influenza—fever, cough, runny nose, conjunctivitis, malaise—followed by a red rash. Complications include pneumonia, otitis, encephalitis; death is possible in children. Vaccination is key to preventing importation and maintaining epidemiologic control.

triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロで2026年初の麻疹輸入症例（6ヶ月児、ボリビアから）を報告。ブラジル国内では2022年6月以降自国内感染なし。2025年米州全体で症例数が前年比32倍増加（14,891例、29死亡）しており地域的な流行拡大傾向を示すが、当該症例自体は単発の輸入例であり即座のフルRRA対象とするには情報不足。地域動向の経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 本症例は単発の輸入例だが、2025年米州全体での麻疹症例急増（前年比32倍）という背景がある。メキシコ6,428例、カナダ5,436例、米国2,242例など主要国で多数報告。ブラジルは国内感染ゼロを維持しているものの、周辺国での流行拡大により輸入リスクが高まっている。6ヶ月児は定期接種前（12ヶ月開始）であり脆弱集団。麻疹の高い伝播性と合併症リスク（肺炎、脳炎、死亡）を考慮すると、米州地域全体の流行動向とブラジルへの輸入症例増加パターンを注視する必要がある。現時点では単発例のためPICKUPには至らないがWATCHが適切。

article.articleHeadline: SP confirma primeiro caso de sarampo em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo confirms first measles case in 2026
article.articleSummary: As of March 11, 2026, São Paulo confirms its first measles case of 2026, following a global alert by virologists about a measles resurgence amid the USA’s worst outbreak in 30 years. The state health department notes two imported measles cases in 2025 and reiterates that vaccination is the primary prevention strategy. Updated vaccination guidance specifies who should be vaccinated: Children receive the measles vaccine as part of the National Vaccination Schedule, with the first dose at 12 months (MMR) and the second at 15 months (tetra-viral: measles, mumps, rubella, and varicella). People aged 5–29 should receive two doses of the MMR vaccine at least 30 days apart; two documented doses count as vaccinated. People aged 30–59 should receive a single MMR dose, with one dose considered vaccinated. Surveillance and immunization remain ongoing.

triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ州での麻疹1例目の確認。米国での30年ぶりの大規模流行を背景とした輸入例の可能性が示唆されるが、現時点では症例数・重症度・感染連鎖の詳細が不明。ワクチン接種が推奨されており管理可能と思われるが、国際的拡大リスクを評価するため続報の注視が必要。
triage.notes: 2025年に2例の輸入症例があり、2026年初例が確認された。米国での30年ぶりの大規模流行を背景に、ウイルス学者が世界的警告を発している文脈がある。麻疹は高い感染力を持つため epidemic_prone=Yes。国はワクチンプログラムを有しており外部支援は不要と判断されるため manageability=No。ただし症例の感染源・接触者追跡・二次感染の有無など詳細情報が不足しており、IHR基準の公衆衛生への深刻な影響は現時点で評価困難。続報で感染拡大の兆候や重症例が確認されればPICKUPへ格上げを検討。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo Confirma Primeiro Caso de Sarampo em 2026 e Reforça Alerta de Vacinação - São Bento em Foco
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo Confirms First Measles Case in 2026 and Reinforces Vaccination Alert - São Bento in Focus
article.articleSummary: Measles confirmed in São Paulo State, Brazil: a six-month-old unvaccinated infant who traveled to Bolivia in January tested positive, case notified in February and laboratory-confirmed, marking the first measles case in 2026. Two imported measles cases were recorded in 2025, underscoring continued travel-related vulnerability. In response, the state reinforces vaccination with widespread campaigns and a 'Dia D' vaccination day. Measles vaccine is part of the National Immunization Schedule: first dose at 12 months, second at 15 months; individuals aged 5–29 require two doses (min. 30 days apart); ages 30–59 need one dose. The WHO warned in February of a 32-fold rise in measles cases across the Americas, contributing to the region losing its 2016 elimination certification in 2023. Emphasis on vaccination as the key to preventing transmission and protecting herd immunity.

triage.triage_reason: 単一の輸入症例（ボリビアからの旅行関連）であり、国内伝播の証拠はないが、WHOが米州での麻疹32倍増加を警告し、2023年に排除認証を失った背景があり、ワクチン接種状況と続報の監視が必要。
triage.notes: 2026年サンパウロ州での初症例（6ヶ月齢未接種児、1月ボリビア渡航歴、2月届出・検査確定）。2025年も輸入症例2件あり。WHOは2月に米州での麻疹32倍増加を警告、2023年に排除認証喪失。州は大規模接種キャンペーン実施中。現時点では単一輸入症例だが、米州全体の麻疹再興の文脈で注視が必要。国内二次感染の有無、接種率動向、周辺国の状況を継続監視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo registra primeiro caso de sarampo no Brasil em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo records the first measles case in Brazil in 2026
article.articleSummary: As of 11 March 2026, São Paulo state reports Brazil's first measles case in 2026: a 6-month-old, unvaccinated female infant who traveled to Bolivia in January. The case was recorded in February and laboratory-confirmed. In 2025, São Paulo had two imported measles cases, while Brazil total was 38. Measles is a highly contagious viral infection spread via respiratory droplets, with transmission possible to up to 90% of susceptible contacts. The contagious period spans six days before to four days after rash onset. Symptoms include high fever (>38.5°C), generalized red rash, dry cough, conjunctivitis, and a runny nose; rash often appears on the face and behind the ears within 3–5 days and then spreads. Vaccination via SUS is free; routine coverage targets 12 months through 59 years, with catch-up for unvaccinated adolescents/adults. Available vaccines: dual (measles/rubella), triple (measles/mumps/rubella), and quadruple (measles/mumps/rubella/varicella); triple vaccine contraindicated in pregnancy; vaccinate postpartum.

triage.triage_reason: 2026年ブラジル初の麻疹症例報告。輸入例1例のみで現時点では国際的拡大リスクは限定的だが、麻疹の高い感染力と予防接種未接種者の存在を考慮すると継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 2026年ブラジル初症例だが輸入例1例のみ。ボリビア渡航歴のある6ヶ月齢未接種乳児。麻疹は感受性者への感染率90%と高い流行性を持つが、現時点で二次感染の報告なし。2025年のブラジル全体で38例、サンパウロ州で2例の輸入例があった背景から、散発的な輸入例として想定の範囲内。無料ワクチンプログラムが機能しており管理体制は整っている。続報で二次感染やクラスター発生の有無を確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo tem primeiro caso de sarampo em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo Records First Measles Case in 2026
article.articleSummary: São Paulo reports its first measles case of 2026: a six-month-old unvaccinated girl who traveled to Bolivia in January. The case, laboratory-confirmed in February, is characterized by a red rash and intense itching, and is Brazil's first measles case this year. In 2025, São Paulo had two imported cases. In 2024 Brazil reported 38 cases, Tocantins 25 and São Paulo 2. Measles is highly contagious; the MMR vaccine is in the National Immunization Schedule, with a first dose at 12 months and a second at 15 months. For 5–29-year-olds without childhood vaccination records, two doses are recommended at least 30 days apart; 30–59-year-olds require one dose. Transmission is airborne, and an infected person can transmit to up to 90% of susceptible contacts within six days before to four days after rash onset. The WHO warned the Americas in February about rising cases, noting a 32-fold increase from 2024 to 2025.

triage.triage_reason: WHOが米州地域での麻疹増加を警告している状況下で、ブラジル2026年初の麻疹症例が確認された。2024-2025年の32倍増加という国際的な流行傾向があり、未接種乳児の国際移動に伴う輸入例であることから、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の影響が認められる。
triage.notes: WHOが2025年2月に米州での症例32倍増加を警告。麻疹は感染力が極めて高く（感受性者への伝播率90%）、未接種者への曝露リスクが継続。ボリビアからの輸入例であり国際的な監視が必要。ただし単発症例であり現時点で重症例や死亡の報告はなく、ブラジルの対応能力は十分と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Caixas d'água, lixos, pneus eram berçários do aedes em aldeia de MS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Water tanks, trash, and tires were breeding grounds for Aedes mosquitoes in a village in Mato Grosso do Sul.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya outbreak in the Indigenous Reserve of Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, with 99 confirmed cases and 183 investigations. A two-day mutirão inspected 1,513 homes in Jaguapiru and Bororó, engaging 75 endemic agents and 20 Indigenous health workers, with state and municipal support. Interventions included 27 motorized backpack chemical foggings and use of cold aerosol Lecos; 648 homes received chemical treatment. A total of 382 Aedes aegypti larval foci were identified, 90% located in water tanks, trash, and tires. Day 1: 664 residences surveyed; 171 foci detected; 288 treated; 13 sprayings. Day 2: 849 residences surveyed; 211 foci; 360 treated. Most foci correlate with rainwater storage due to limited potable water supply. Larvicides/bioinsecticides applied; authorities also screened public buildings as part of expanded vector control to curb transmission.

triage.triage_reason: ブラジル先住民居住区でのチクングニア熱アウトブレイク（確定99例、調査中183例）。大規模な媒介蚊対策が実施されているが、死亡例や重症度、国際拡大リスクに関する情報が不足しており、現時点ではWATCHとして続報を注視すべき。
triage.notes: ブラジルではチクングニア熱は流行地域であり異常事態ではない。先住民居住区という脆弱な集団での発生であり、安全な飲料水供給不足が媒介蚊繁殖の主因。州・市・先住民保健当局が75名の媒介蚊対策要員を動員し大規模介入を実施中（1,513戸訪問、382カ所の幼虫発生源特定、648戸に化学処理）。国内対応は機能しており国際支援は不要と判断されるが、症例数の推移、重症例・死亡例の有無、他地域への拡大状況について続報確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo registra caso importado de sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo reports an imported case of measles.
article.articleSummary: São Paulo State reports its first measles case of 2026: an imported infection in the capital, a 6‑month‑old girl who had been in Bolivia in January. Detection was notified in February and laboratory confirmation occurred in March. In 2025, the state recorded two imported cases and Brazil 38; no autochthonous transmission since June 2022. PAHO notes rising measles in the Americas, with 14,891 confirmed cases and 29 deaths in 2025, up 32‑fold from 2024; Mexico leads with 6,428 cases, followed by Canada (5,436) and the United States (2,242). Vaccination remains the main prevention: two‑dose schedule—12 months (measles-mumps-rubella) and 15 months (measles-mumps-rubella-varicella). Those 5–29 years should have two doses, 30–59 years one dose, and health workers two doses. Measles is highly transmissible via respiratory droplets; initial symptoms resemble flu (fever, cough, coryza, conjunctivitis) then rash; complications include pneumonia, ear infection, encephalitis; death is possible in children.

triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ州の輸入麻疹例1件は国内伝播なく管理されているが、PAHO報告によると2025年南北アメリカ大陸全体で麻疹が急増（前年比32倍、14,891例・29死亡）しており地域的流行動向として継続監視が必要。ただし現時点で異常な重症度や国際的拡大リスクの直接的証拠は不足。
triage.notes: ブラジル単独例は輸入例で2022年6月以降国内伝播なし。PAHOデータで南北アメリカ大陸全体の麻疹急増（メキシコ6,428例、カナダ5,436例、米国2,242例）が背景にあり、ワクチン接種率低下地域での流行拡大リスクは存在。地域サーベイランス強化と続報確認が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Mulher de 33 anos morre por leptospirose após enchentes em Ubá (MG)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 33-year-old woman dies of leptospirosis after floods in Ubá, Minas Gerais.
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis death in Ubá, Zona da Mata, Minas Gerais: a 33-year-old woman died from confirmed leptospirosis by RT-qPCR after February floods; first Ubá fatality in the flood context. Ubá reports 41 suspected cases under epidemiological investigation; 37 cases notified in Sinan. Samples have been sent to Fundação Ezequiel Dias (Funed) in Belo Horizonte for laboratory analysis, with results pending. The Minas Gerais government has allocated about R$ 8.3 million in emergency funding to Ubá to strengthen health services and reorganize care, including new cold-storage chambers for medicines and vaccines. An epidemiological alert was issued on February 24 urging intensified surveillance, vector control, and community mobilization to prevent disease spread. Leptospirosis is bacteria shed in rat urine that can contaminate floodwater and mud; authorities urge seeking immediate medical evaluation for related symptoms. Local health teams received SUS support to speed diagnosis and care, with further updates anticipated.

triage.triage_reason: 洪水後のレプトスピラ症アウトブレイクで死亡例が発生し、41例の疑い例が調査中。環境汚染を伴う集団発生として公衆衛生上の影響が深刻であり、IHR基準2項目およびWPROスクリーニング基準複数項目に該当。
triage.notes: 洪水後のレプトスピラ症は予測可能な事象だがIHR基準の「異常性」は満たさない。しかし、死亡例1名、疑い例41例という規模、洪水水・泥を介した継続的曝露リスク、ヒト-環境-齧歯類サイクルによる流行性、州政府が830万レアルの緊急資金配分と疫学警報発令という対応規模から、WPROスクリーニング基準で重症度・長期曝露・流行しやすさの3項目に該当。政府の高い関心も確認される。国内事象で国際拡大リスクは低いが、洪水関連感染症の典型的なシグナルとしてフルRRA対象とすべき。検査結果待ちの37例の動向も注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta en Toronto: confirman dos casos de nueva variante Mpox
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Toronto alert: two cases of a new Mpox variant confirmed.
article.articleSummary: Two confirmed cases of mpox (monkeypox) due to a new clade Ib variant have been identified in Toronto, Ontario, Canada, with patients reporting recent international travel. The Toronto Public Health alert notes this clade, previously confined to Central and East Africa in the Congo Basin, may transmit more efficiently and potentially cause more severe disease than the 2022 outbreak strain (clade IIb). Transmission requires close skin-to-skin contact or contact with contaminated materials, and infectiousness spans from symptom onset until lesions heal. WHO-validated assessments align with concerns about urban transmission dynamics. Authorities urge eligible residents to complete Canada's Imvamune vaccination, with two-dose regimens recommended as a single dose may offer only partial protection against clade Ib. The report emphasizes vigilant surveillance, public awareness, and the ongoing impact of vaccine access disparities on variant emergence.

triage.triage_reason: 新規クレードIb型のMpoxがトロントで確認され、従来株より重症化・伝播効率が高い可能性があり、国際的拡大リスクとWHO評価済みの懸念事項に該当する。IHR基準3つ、WPRO基準4つに該当。
triage.notes: クレードIbは従来中央・東アフリカのコンゴ盆地に限定されていた株で、カナダでの検出は地理的拡大を示唆。患者は国際渡航歴あり。WHOが既に評価済みで都市部での伝播動態への懸念が表明されている。トロント公衆衛生当局がImvamune2回接種を推奨し、積極的サーベイランスを実施中。ワクチンアクセス格差が変異株出現に影響している可能性も指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Vaccine-carrying mosquitoes developed to immunise bats against rabies and Nipah
article.articleSummary: Chinese scientists at the Wuhan Institute of Virology developed vaccine-carrying mosquitoes to immunize bats against rabies and Nipah, a non-transmissible ecological vaccination strategy aimed at reducing spillover risk. In a Science Advances proof-of-concept, Aedes aegypti mosquitoes were engineered to carry vesicular stomatitis virus (VSV) expressing glycoproteins from rabies and Nipah viruses. Mosquitoes were fed on virus-containing blood and sterilized with X-rays to prevent spread; bats in enclosures cohabited with these mosquitoes, and four of six exposed bats developed detectable antibodies against both pathogens. Separately, vaccine-storing saline traps attracted bats and induced similar immune responses, suggesting field-applicable delivery via caves with wild bat colonies. The approach prioritizes biosafety with limited spread, avoiding bat-to-bat transmission, while cautioning about ecological risks and the need for rigorous oversight before any wildlife deployment.

article.articleHeadline: Fulvio Stefanini contrai infecção bacteriana e é internado no Rio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fulvio Stefanini contracts a bacterial infection and is hospitalized in Rio de Janeiro.
article.articleSummary: Fulvio Stefanini, an 86-year-old actor, is hospitalized in Rio de Janeiro for evaluation and treatment of a bacterial infection, with discharge expected next week. He has canceled performances of the play "O Pai" at Teatro TotalEnergies in Glória for March 13–15. Tickets may be revalidated for another session subject to availability; refunds are offered if a new date cannot be attended. In the production, Stefanini plays André, an elderly man who begins to face the effects of Alzheimer's disease, creating a caregiving dilemma for his daughter. This report documents a single recent bacterial infection requiring hospitalization and does not indicate any outbreak. No laboratory confirmation details or transmission sources are provided in the article. Location: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil; Date: published 2026-03-11.

triage.triage_reason: 個人の細菌感染症による入院事例であり、集団発生や公衆衛生上の懸念を示す情報は含まれていない。単発症例であり、アウトブレイクの兆候はない。
triage.notes: 86歳の俳優個人の細菌感染症による入院事例。演劇公演のキャンセルに関する芸能ニュースであり、疫学的情報（病原体の種類、感染源、伝播様式、他の症例の有無等）は一切記載されていない。公衆衛生上の監視対象となるシグナルではない。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Harrow TB cases 'likely to continue increasing' as action plan underway
article.articleSummary: TB in Harrow, England, is rising, with 44 per 100,000 residents having active TB and an average of 105 active cases per year (2023–2025), up from 69/year (2017–2019). About 95% of active cases are born outside the UK, with 69% from India; 58% had lived in the UK fewer than five years. Transmission occurs via droplets from those with active TB; symptoms include cough, fever, night sweats and weight loss, while latent TB can reactivate in about 1 in 10. Active TB is infectious, typically for ~two weeks after starting effective treatment. England-wide mortality among active TB is ~1 in 25 within 12 months (~150 deaths/year). High incidence in Harrow wards such as Edgware, Centenary, Kenton East/West, Wealdstone South, Headstone, Rayners Lane and Roxeth. A TB action plan is being developed, with recommendations for more screening, better screening-to-treatment conversion, GP registration, capacity, and awareness; latent-TB screening uptake is low (35% screened; 10% completed treatment).

triage.triage_reason: 英国Harrow地域における結核増加傾向は地域的な公衆衛生課題だが、国際的拡大リスクや異常性の評価には情報不足。既知の疾患パターンであり、対策計画が進行中。続報による重症化・拡大状況の監視が必要。
triage.notes: 年間105例（44/10万人）は英国全体の平均（8.2/10万人、2022年）より高いが、Harrowは既知の高リスク地域。95%が海外出生者（69%インド出身）という疫学的特徴は既知パターン。mortality 1/25（4%）は一般的な結核の致死率範囲内。アクションプラン策定中で管理体制は機能。ただし潜在性結核スクリーニング完遂率10%は低く、今後の活動性結核増加リスクあり。異常な薬剤耐性株や院内感染等の情報なし。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo registra primeiro caso de sarampo em 2026 em bebê não vacinado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo records first measles case in 2026 in an unvaccinated infant.
article.articleSummary: São Paulo reports the first measles case of 2026 in a six-month-old unvaccinated girl from the capital, with illness after travel to Bolivia. The infant developed fever and rash on February 8. Exposure likely occurred during travel from December 25, 2025 to January 25, 2026. The case was notified in February and lab-confirmed on March 4 through genomic sequencing by reference laboratories. SES-SP issued an alert on March 9 to monitor and implement a 30-day response including epidemiological investigation, vaccination blockade, intensified immunization, and contact tracing. In 2025 São Paulo recorded two imported measles cases; Bolivia outbreak near borders raises concern. Vaccination is the main prevention with the MMR vaccine; first dose at 12 months, second at 15 months. People aged 5–29 should receive two doses at least 30 days apart. Verify vaccination status and report suspected cases promptly.

triage.triage_reason: ワクチン未接種乳児の麻疹輸入症例1例であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は現時点で限定的。ただしボリビアでの流行と国境地域での懸念、接触者追跡・ワクチン接種ブロック等の対応実施中であり、続報を注視すべき状況。
triage.notes: 2026年サンパウロ州初の麻疹症例で、生後6ヶ月の未接種乳児がボリビア渡航後に発症。2025年12月25日〜2026年1月25日の渡航中に曝露、2月8日発症、3月4日に検査室確定。州保健局は3月9日に警報発出し30日間の対応（疫学調査、接触者追跡、予防接種強化）を実施中。ボリビア国境地域での流行が懸念材料。現時点では単発輸入例で二次感染の報告なし。麻疹は感染力が高いため接触者調査の結果と追加症例の有無を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Mulher morre por leptospirose após enchente em Ubá " BH 24 Horas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Woman dies from leptospirosis after flood in Ubá.
article.articleSummary: As of 11 March 2026, Ubá, Minas Gerais, reports its first death from leptospirosis after end-February floods. A 33-year-old woman died; RT-qPCR confirmation was provided by Fundação Ezequiel Dias (Funed) in Belo Horizonte. Forty-one suspected cases are under investigation, with samples sent and results pending. Leptospirosis, caused by bacteria in rat urine, contaminates floodwaters and mud; symptoms include fever, headache, body pains, nausea, and malaise, with severe cases risking respiratory distress, kidney failure, and hemorrhage. Health teams are intensifying surveillance in affected areas and urging prompt care. During cleanup, use boots and rubber gloves; if unavailable, double-plastic-bag protection is advised. Regional floods in Zona da Mata have caused 72 deaths (mostly in Juiz de Fora); Ubá has seven deaths, with one person still missing.

triage.triage_reason: 洪水後のレプトスピラ症による死亡例が発生し、41件の疑い例が調査中。災害関連感染症として公衆衛生上の影響が深刻であり、地域的な流行リスクと国際的な関心が認められる。
triage.notes: 洪水災害（72名死亡）に関連した二次感染症アウトブレイク。レプトスピラ症は洪水後の典型的な疾患であり異常ではないが、重症化リスク（呼吸不全、腎不全、出血）と継続的な曝露環境（洪水後の汚染水・泥）、感染しやすい状況（清掃作業）により、WPROスクリーニング基準4項目に該当。保健当局がサーベイランス強化と予防対策を実施中。疑い例41件の検査結果待ちであり、続報で規模拡大の可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: Campak en Indonesia: Brote, Casos y Campaña de Vacunación
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles in Indonesia: Outbreak, Cases, and Vaccination Campaign.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in Dompu district, Nusa Tenggara Barat, Indonesia, with 216 suspected cases across eight districts as of 11 March 2026, though no emergency declared yet. Dompu leads with 96 cases, followed by Woja 66, Manggelewa 18, Hu'u 10, Kilo 10, Pajo 8, Kempo 7, Pekat 1. Patients are treated at local health centers and at RSUD Dompu and RSU Pratama Manggelewa hospitals. Most affected are children under 6; no deaths reported to date. Dompu authorities have launched an outbreak response immunization (ORI) campaign targeting vulnerable populations, aiming for 95% vaccination coverage among children aged 9–59 months, with 4,000 measles vaccine doses available. The initiative seeks to curb transmission, reduce morbidity, and prevent deaths. In NTB province overall, nearly 1,000 children with suspected measles, including cases in Bima and Lombok Utara regions.

triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常事態・国際拡大リスク）。約1,000名の疑い例を含む大規模麻疹アウトブレイクで、ワクチン接種率向上キャンペーンが必要な状況。フルRRAによる詳細評価が必要。
triage.notes: 西ヌサトゥンガラ州全体で約1,000名の疑い例、Dompu地区単独で216例（8地区に分散）。6歳未満児童が主な影響対象で死亡例は報告されていないが、95%ワクチン接種率達成を目指す緊急予防接種キャンペーン（ORI）が実施中。4,000回分のワクチンが確保されている。BimaとLombok Utara地域にも症例あり。インドネシアにおける麻疹は予防接種プログラムの課題を示唆しており、地域的な免疫ギャップの可能性。国際的な関心対象となる規模と疾患特性（高い伝播性）を持つ。

article.articleHeadline: GeoVax Aktie: Mpox-Lage
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: GeoVax Stock: Mpox Situation
article.articleSummary: Mpox Clade Ib is spreading in North America, with health authorities in Toronto and Ontario confirming yesterday the first travel-related cases, a shift from Clade IIb that has circulated there since 2022. By early March, Ghana reported over 1,000 mpox infections. Clade Ib’s geographic footprint has already been documented in Central and East Africa and parts of Europe, influencing public health planning and potential vaccine demand. GeoVax sits amid a dynamic vaccine-market backdrop, currently described as having operational calm, but facing heightened interest in modern vaccine platforms as outbreaks evolve. The mpox news cycle and biotech sector signals may affect investor sentiment toward GeoVax. Separately, the CROI 2026 conference highlighted HIV prevention advances, emphasizing ultra-long-acting modalities like injectable therapies and implants and longer dosing intervals, reflecting broader industry drivers.

triage.triage_reason: Mpox Clade Ibの北米への拡大は地理的拡散と病原体の系統変化を示し、IHR基準（異常性・国際拡大リスク）とWPROスクリーニング基準（異常性・流行しやすさ）に該当。2022年以降流行していたClade IIbからの系統変化は公衆衛生上の重要な変化であり、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: Clade IbはClade IIbと比較してより高い伝播性や重症度を持つ可能性があり、北米での初の渡航関連症例の確認は監視強化の必要性を示唆。ガーナでは3月初旬までに1,000例超の感染が報告されており、中央・東アフリカおよび欧州の一部での地理的拡大も確認済み。ワクチン需要の増加や公衆衛生計画への影響が予想される。記事は主にGeoVax社の株価文脈だが、疫学的重要性は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Secretaria de Saúde realiza ações para combater o Aedes aegypti em Santa Cruz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Department carries out actions to combat Aedes aegypti in Santa Cruz.
article.articleSummary: On March 11, 2026, Santa Cruz's Municipal Health Department conducted Intradomiciliary Residual Spraying (BRI) in Pontos Estratégicos and Imóveis Especiais in Bairro Avenida, visiting 10 locations this week. BRI is a directed indoor insecticide application aimed at eliminating adult Aedes aegypti, the vector for dengue, chikungunya, and Zika. Pontos Estratégicos are sites with high potential for mosquito breeding, such as rubber shops, recyclable depots, junkyards, workshops, and storage areas; Imóveis Especiais are properties where contact with responsible parties is difficult, allowing provisional insecticide use while administrative and sanitary measures are pursued. Signs on properties indicate if they are Imóvel Vistoriado or Ponto Estratégico. Actions will continue in coming weeks in other neighborhoods as part of ongoing dengue and arboviruses control, and community participation is essential to keep properties free of water-holding containers that serve as Aedes aegypti habitats.

triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンタクルス市における定例的なAedes蚊対策活動の報告であり、異常なアウトブレイクや重症例の増加を示す情報はない。公衆衛生上の定期活動と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事内容は自治体保健局による屋内残留噴霧（BRI）の実施報告であり、疾患の発生状況や症例数に関する情報は含まれていない。デング熱・チクングニア・ジカウイルス感染症の媒介蚊対策としての予防的介入活動であり、アウトブレイク対応ではないと判断される。

article.articleHeadline: SP confirma primeiro caso de sarampo em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo confirms first measles case in 2026.
article.articleSummary: First measles case in 2026 confirmed in São Paulo: a 6-month-old girl, unvaccinated, who traveled to Bolivia in January; diagnosis detected in February. The state Health Secretariat notes ongoing measles surveillance and reinforces vaccination as the primary prevention. In 2025, two imported measles cases were recorded. Updated vaccination guidance: children should receive the first dose at 12 months and the second at 15 months (triple viral — measles, mumps, rubella; tetra viral — adds varicella). Individuals aged 5–29 should have two doses, with at least a 30-day interval; those with two doses of the triple viral vaccine are considered vaccinated. Individuals aged 30–59 should receive one dose; one dose of the triple viral vaccine confers vaccination status. Health workers should receive two doses of the triple viral vaccine, regardless of age, with vaccination status determined by prior doses.

triage.triage_reason: 単一の輸入麻疹症例（6ヶ月児1名）であり、既存のサーベイランス体制下で検出・管理されている。国際的拡大リスクや異常性は認められず、定期的な予防接種啓発の範囲内。
triage.notes: 2026年のサンパウロ州初の麻疹症例だが、ボリビア渡航歴のある未接種児の輸入例。2025年にも2例の輸入例が記録されており、散発的な輸入症例の範囲内。州保健局は既存のサーベイランスで対応し、ワクチン接種の重要性を再確認。集団感染や予想外の疫学パターンは報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Tem mosquitos aí? Região dos Lagos registra aumento de mosquitos após período de chuvas -- RC24H
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Are there mosquitoes there? Lakes Region records an increase in mosquitoes after the rainy season -- RC24H.
article.articleSummary: After heavy rains in the Lakes Region along the coast of Rio de Janeiro, municipalities report a surge in Aedes aegypti mosquitoes, the primary vector of dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. In Cabo Frio, Armação dos Búzios, Arraial do Cabo, Iguaba Grande, São Pedro da Aldeia, Araruama, Saquarema, and the Peró neighborhood of Cabo Frio, warm, humid conditions and standing water create ideal breeding sites. Authorities warn that March temperatures may shorten the mosquito development cycle to about seven days, accelerating reproduction and arbovirus transmission. Eggs in previously dry sites can hatch with heat and humidity, heightening adult mosquito activity, especially at dawn and dusk. The Health Secretariat urges weekly vector-control measures: inspect plant saucers, bottles, tires, and containers; keep gutters and drains clean; use screens and repellents as needed. Public health authorities seek community engagement.

triage.triage_reason: 蚊媒介感染症（デング、ジカ、チクングニア）のベクター増加報告だが、現時点で実際の症例数や重症度に関する情報がなく、主に環境・ベクター監視レベルの報告。情報が不足しているため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: ブラジル・リオデジャネイロ州の湖沼地域における雨季後のネッタイシマカ（Aedes aegypti）の増加報告。3月の気温上昇により蚊の発育サイクルが約7日に短縮され繁殖加速の可能性を指摘。保健当局が週次のベクターコントロール対策を呼びかけているが、実際の感染症症例数、入院数、死亡数などの疫学データは記載なし。ベクター監視段階の情報であり、今後の症例報告を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo confirma primeiro caso de sarampo neste ano em bebê de 6 meses
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo confirms first measles case this year in a 6-month-old baby.
article.articleSummary: Measles case confirmed in São Paulo, Brazil, first of 2026. A six-month-old infant with no prior vaccination was classified as imported after travel to Bolivia between late December 2025 and January 2026. Symptoms appeared February 8: high fever, cough, and a rash. Laboratory confirmation followed on March 4. Measles is an acute, highly contagious disease that can cause pneumonia, blindness, and encephalitis. After confirmation, epidemiological teams implemented a vaccine blockade, vaccinating all direct contacts to interrupt transmission; measles virus can remain airborne for up to 24 hours. The Ministry of Health emphasizes vaccination as prevention. The standard MMR schedule is at 12 and 15 months; however, infants 6–11.99 months may receive a dose zero during outbreaks or travel to areas with transmission. Dose zero does not replace official calendar doses. Brazil lost measles-free status in 2019; authorities aim for 95% vaccination to prevent imported cases from triggering local outbreaks.

triage.triage_reason: 輸入症例1例のみで現時点では限定的だが、麻疹の高い感染力と乳児への重症化リスク、ブラジルの麻疹排除認定喪失歴を考慮すると継続監視が必要。ワクチン接種率95%未満の可能性があり、二次感染の発生に注意が必要。
triage.notes: 現時点では輸入症例1例（ボリビアからの帰国後発症）のみで、接触者へのワクチン遮断対策が実施済み。ブラジルは2019年に麻疹排除認定を喪失しており、輸入症例から国内流行に発展するリスクがある。麻疹は空気感染し24時間空中に留まる高い感染力を持つため、二次感染例の発生有無を数週間監視する必要がある。ワクチン接種率95%達成が目標とされているが、現状の接種率は不明。続報で二次感染や集団発生が確認された場合はPICKUPへ格上げを検討。

article.articleHeadline: Ubá confirma primeira morte por Leptospirose após enchentes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ubá confirms first death from leptospirosis after floods
article.articleSummary: Ubá, Minas Gerais, Brazil, reports its first death from leptospirosis following February floods. The victim was a 33-year-old woman; diagnosis was confirmed by RT-qPCR at Fundação Ezequiel Dias (Funed) in Belo Horizonte. Authorities are investigating 41 additional suspected cases, with samples collected and sent for laboratory analysis as surveillance intensifies in flood-affected areas of Ubá and the Zona da Mata region. Leptospirosis is caused by bacteria shed in rat urine and transmitted through contact with contaminated water or mud via skin or wounds. Early symptoms mimic influenza—fever, headache, severe calf pain—and can progress to renal failure, hemorrhages, and severe respiratory distress if untreated. Prevention emphasizes protective gear and hygiene, including bleach-based cleaning. The Zona da Mata region has 72 flood-related deaths, seven in Ubá, with one person still missing; residents with symptoms should seek care at a UBS or emergency department.

triage.triage_reason: 洪水後のレプトスピラ症による初の死亡例であり、41件の疑い例が調査中。地域的な集団発生の可能性があるが、国際的拡大リスクや異常性の判断には続報が必要。
triage.notes: 洪水関連で72名の死亡（うちUbáで7名）が報告されており、レプトスピラ症はその一部。2月の洪水後の発生であり、洪水後レプトスピラ症としては想定される事象だが、41件の疑い例の確定診断結果や地域での発生規模の全容が不明。RT-qPCRによる確定診断体制があり、積極的サーベイランスが実施されている点は評価できる。続報で疑い例の確定数、地域内の発生動向、対策の有効性を確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Taylen came back from Bali with a sniffle. Then things got much worse
article.articleSummary: Measles remains a major concern in New South Wales, Australia, with 60 cases reported Jan 1, 2025–Mar 7, 2026; eight locally acquired cases were not linked to overseas infections, indicating community transmission. NSW Health warns the state could record its highest measles numbers in a decade if transmission is not contained. By Mar 11, 2026, 26 cases had been logged for the year, already exceeding early-2019 totals; 2019 ended with 62 cases. NSW is offering free measles vaccine for infants aged 6–11 months travelling overseas, a supplementary dose that does not replace routine 12- and 18-month immunisations. Overseas cases mostly trace to Southeast Asia tourist hotspots; all overseas travellers should vaccinate. Taylen, an 11‑month‑old from Sydney, contracted measles after a Bali trip, presenting runny nose, fever, and rash. About 77% of NSW measles patients since Jan 2025 have required hospital care.

triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準も複数該当し、地域内感染・高い入院率・乳幼児重症例など重大性が高い。10年ぶりの高水準となる可能性があり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 2025年1月〜2026年3月に60例、うち8例が海外渡航歴なし（地域内伝播）。2026年は3月時点で26例と2019年通年62例を超えるペース。入院率77%と高く、東南アジア旅行関連が多数。NSW州が6〜11か月児への渡航前追加接種を無償提供開始。麻疹は既知疾患だが発生規模・ペース・地域伝播の拡大が予想外。渡航勧告・ワクチン接種推奨が強化されており、貿易よりも人の移動への影響大。NSW州当局は封じ込め失敗時の更なる拡大を警告しており、政府レベルの関心は明確。

article.articleHeadline: Projeto Mobiliza TB leva ações comunitárias para prevenção da tuberculose em Porto Velho - News Rondônia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: TB Mobilization Project brings community actions to prevent tuberculosis in Porto Velho - News Rondônia.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis in Porto Velho, Rondônia, Brazil, is the focus of the Mobiliza TB project, aimed at expanding access to TB diagnosis and treatment. The initiative, supported by the Pan American Health Organization (OPAS) and Brazil’s Ministry of Health, operates in Porto Velho through Associação Beradeiro in partnership with the Federal University of Rondônia, the Municipal Health Secretariat, and the Rondônia Health Surveillance Agency. The project targets rural, forest, and riverine communities, delivering TB prevention information and guidance on signs and symptoms, prevention, diagnosis, and treatment. Activities include school workshops, health-focused sports events in rural areas, community information stops, educational and social TB prevention actions, and ongoing professional training. Initiated July 2025, it has reached over 620 people to date and seeks to broaden reach in coming months, aiming to reduce TB incidence and increase cure rates in the capital while cases persist.

triage.triage_reason: 既知の地域での結核対策プロジェクトの報道であり、異常事態や新たな集団発生の報告ではない。公衆衛生対策の取り組みに関する情報提供記事と判断される。

sociopolitical_concern.notes: 既にPAHO（米州保健機構）とブラジル保健省の支援を受けている既存プロジェクトであり、新たな国際支援の必要性は示されていない。

triage.notes: 本記事は2025年7月に開始された結核予防プロジェクト（Mobiliza TB）の活動報告であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではない。620人以上にリーチした予防活動の成果を報じるものであり、緊急性を要するシグナルには該当しない。通常の疾病対策プログラムの広報記事と評価される。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox no Espírito Santo: Estado confirma segundo caso em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox in Espírito Santo: State confirms second case in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Espírito Santo confirms its second mpox (monkeypox) case in 2026. The patient lives in Serra and is aged 20–29, marking the first mpox case in the Greater Vitória region this year. The state Health Secretariat (Sesa) reports 44 notifications to date, with 6 under investigation and 30 tests already ruled out. The first 2026 case in the state occurred in Colatina, after which authorities intensified epidemiological monitoring. Brazil totals 140 confirmed mpox cases in 2026, with no deaths reported so far. Mpox transmission occurs mainly through direct contact with infected people, and via contact with wildlife or contaminated objects; early diagnosis reduces transmission risk. Common symptoms include skin lesions, fever, headache, body pains, lymph node swelling, chills, and weakness. Suspected cases should seek medical care and avoid close contact until diagnosis is confirmed; Sesa will provide updates as needed.

triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでMpox症例が継続的に発生しているが、現時点では死亡例なし。2026年に140例確認されており疫学的監視が強化されている。クレード情報や重症度の詳細が不明であり、続報による情報更新を要する。
triage.notes: Espírito Santo州で2026年2例目のMpox確認。ブラジル全体で140例、死亡例なし。クレードI/IIの別が不明であり、クレードIの場合は重症度・国際的拡大リスクが高まる可能性がある。州保健局は疫学的監視を強化中。44件の通知中6件が調査中、30件は除外済み。ヒト-ヒト感染が主な伝播経路であり、早期診断により感染拡大リスク低減可能。続報でクレード情報・重症例の有無・地理的拡大状況を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Estado antecipa medidas para enfrentar aumento de vírus respiratórios
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: State Prepares Measures to Address Rise in Respiratory Viruses.
article.articleSummary: On 11 March 2026, Brazil's State Health Secretariat (SES) urges municipalities to heighten surveillance, vaccination, and care organization ahead of the April-July respiratory virus season, focusing on influenza-like illness (SG) and Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG). While influenza, RSV, and rhinoviruses traditionally circulate more during colder months, SARS-CoV-2 transmission remains high with year-round potential. Authorities call for proactive identification, specimen collection, and timely notification of SG and SRAG per State Technical Notes and the Integrated Surveillance Guide for COVID-19, Influenza, and other respiratory viruses. Vaccination against Influenza and COVID-19 is highlighted as the most effective protection, especially for older adults, children, pregnant women, and those with comorbidities. Early antiviral treatment for SRAG and high-risk influenza-like cases should begin promptly, without awaiting lab confirmation. Although no significant current records are reported, the SES reinforces preventive planning. Preventive planning and intersectoral coordination between primary care, urgent care, and hospitals are emphasized.

triage.triage_reason: ブラジル保健当局による季節性呼吸器ウイルスに対する定例的な事前準備・サーベイランス強化の通知。現時点で異常な増加や重症例の報告はなく、予防計画の段階であるため、緊急性の高いシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 4-7月の呼吸器ウイルスシーズンに向けた予防的な公衆衛生対応（サーベイランス強化、ワクチン接種推奨、早期抗ウイルス治療の準備）を通知する内容。記事中に「現時点で重大な記録はない（no significant current records are reported）」と明記されており、実際のアウトブレイクではなく準備段階の情報。季節性インフルエンザ、RSV、COVID-19に対する通常の公衆衛生対策の範囲内。

article.articleHeadline: होली पर बिहार लौटे प्रवासियों की जांच में 25 लोग मिले HIV संक्रमित, इलाज शुरू﻿  - arrah 25 migrant workers hiv positive after holi tests
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Arrah: 25 migrant workers HIV-positive after Holi tests; treatment started.
article.articleSummary: HIV-positive status detected in Arrah, Bhojpur district, Bihar, after Holi tests. During Feb 25–Mar 10, 2026, Bihar State AIDS Control Society directed special health screening camps across Bhojpur to protect migrant workers returning from abroad and their families. Twenty-five migrant workers tested HIV-positive; they were immediately linked to ART centers and started antiretroviral therapy. District AIDS Control Officer Dr. A. Ahmed emphasized that early diagnosis and regular medication allow people living with HIV to lead normal lives. The initiative illustrates proactive surveillance and rapid treatment initiation to curb transmission and safeguard household health. The report focuses on screening outcomes and treatment initiation; it does not specify infection sources or clinical symptoms.

triage.triage_reason: 25名のHIV陽性者が移住労働者の集団スクリーニングで検出されたが、これは積極的サーベイランス活動の結果であり、アウトブレイクを示すものではない。感染源・臨床症状・感染時期が不明であり、追加情報なしでは公衆衛生上の緊急性を判断できない。
triage.notes: これは計画的な健康スクリーニングキャンプ（2026年2月25日〜3月10日）での検出であり、自然発生的なアウトブレイクではない。全陽性者は直ちにARTセンターに接続され抗レトロウイルス療法が開始されており、管理体制は機能している。HIV感染は通常長期の潜伏期間を経るため、25名が同時期に感染したのか、以前からの感染を今回初めて検出したのかが不明。感染源（国外での感染か国内か）、疫学的リンク、地域でのHIV有病率のベースライン等の情報が必要。現時点では定期サーベイランスの成果として解釈でき、緊急の公衆衛生対応を要する新規イベントとは判断できない。

article.articleHeadline: 男子生吃凉拌猪血 竟让寄生虫钻进大脑：痛不欲生！
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Man Eats Raw Pig Blood Salad; Parasites Drill Into His Brain: Pain Beyond Words!
article.articleSummary: Neurocysticercosis caused by Taenia solium larvae was diagnosed in a Chinese man after consuming raw pig blood. He developed seizures and loss of consciousness in 2025; initial Shanwei hospital MRI suggested a brain mass. Guangzhou evaluations ruled out tumor and vascular disease, with a right frontal lesion suspected to be infectious. Because of prior work in Zhejiang, he sought care at Hangzhou Shulan Hospital, where a multidisciplinary team linked half-year exposure to raw pig blood with the brain lesion and diagnosed cerebral cysticercosis (larval Taenia solium entering the CNS). Targeted therapy reduced intracranial edema and shrank the lesion; a six-month follow-up confirmed improvement and treatment adjustment. China CDC data show human cysticercosis infection at 0.14%–3.2%, brain cysticercosis being the most common CNS parasitic disease; transmission occurs via undercooked meat or blood products containing cysticerci.

triage.triage_reason: 嚢虫症による脳感染の個別症例であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低いが、中国での感染率データ（0.14-3.2%）と生肉・生血製品摂取習慣の継続的リスクを考慮すると経過観察が必要。集団発生や新規流行の兆候は見られない。
triage.notes: 個別症例報道であり、集団発生ではない。脳嚢虫症は中国で最も一般的なCNS寄生虫疾患として既知であり、予想外の事象ではない。重症度は高い（発作・意識消失）が、適切な治療で改善が確認されている。生豚血製品の継続的摂取という文化的リスク因子が存在し、長期曝露リスクは認められる。しかし、ヒト-ヒト感染はなく、流行性は低い。メディア注目度はあるが（センセーショナルな見出し）、国際的拡大や通商制限のリスクはない。続報で複数症例の集積や食品汚染の広がりが報告された場合は再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: JJ: São Paulo registra primeiro caso de sarampo em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: JJ: São Paulo records first measles case in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Measles detected in São Paulo, Brazil — the first case of 2026. A six-month-old infant, unvaccinated, resident of São Paulo city, had traveled to Bolivia in January and developed fever with a rash on February 8. The São Paulo State Health Secretariat (SES-SP) confirmed the laboratory diagnosis on March 4, marking Brazil’s first measles case of 2026. In 2025, São Paulo reported two imported measles cases. Nationally, 38 measles cases were confirmed in 2025 across several states: Tocantins 25; Distrito Federal 1; Rio de Janeiro 2; São Paulo 2; Rio Grande do Sul 1; Maranhão 1; Mato Grosso 6.

triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで2026年初の麻疹症例が確認されたが、単発の輸入症例であり現時点で国際的拡大や異常な重症度の兆候は不明。2025年に38例の報告があり予想外とは言えないが、ワクチン未接種乳児の感染であり続報による二次感染の有無確認が必要。
triage.notes: ボリビアからの輸入症例。6ヶ月齢の乳児でワクチン未接種、1月にボリビア渡航後2月8日に発熱・発疹発症、3月4日に検査確認。麻疹は高い伝播性を持つため、接触者追跡と二次感染の有無が重要。2025年のブラジル全体で38例（主にトカンティンス州25例）の報告があり、サンパウロ州では2025年に2例の輸入例あり。現時点では単発輸入例だが、麻疹の感染力を考慮し続報を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Using mosquitoes to vaccinate bats could curb the spread of deadly diseases
article.articleSummary: China-based researchers used Aedes aegypti mosquitoes engineered to carry vaccines against Nipah virus or rabies to inoculate bats, aiming to curb bat-to-human spillover in Asia. In lab tests, mosquitoes fed on vaccine-containing blood; viruses reached salivary glands and could transfer to bats during feeding or when bats ate the insects. Mice and bats exposed to vaccine-carrying mosquitoes developed neutralizing antibodies; rabies exposure led to survival, and Nipah antibodies appeared in mice, hamsters, and bats. For fruit bats that do not eat mosquitoes, drinking stations with vaccines elicited antibodies. Beijing-based virologist Aihua Zheng notes no Nipah challenge trials due to lack of a high-containment lab. Nipah is a bat-borne virus with fatality up to 75% in humans; rabies is nearly 100% fatal once symptoms appear. Critics warn vector delivery raises ethical and practical concerns; real-world use would require extensive safety testing, regulatory approval, and work on bat-to-livestock spillover (pigs).
