article.articleHeadline: Sarampo: São Paulo registra primeiro caso importado de 2026 em bebê de 6 meses
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles: São Paulo records first imported case of 2026 in a 6-month-old baby.
article.articleSummary: São Paulo state, Brazil, reports the first imported measles case of 2026: a 6‑month‑old girl with recent travel to Bolivia; laboratory confirmation announced on 11 March 2026. The patient was unvaccinated; Brazil’s measles vaccination starts at 12 months, with a zero-dose option for high‑risk infants before then. Authorities launched a rapid investigation, including contact tracing, vaccination status assessment, neighborhood active surveillance, testing, and isolation of the case. There were two prior imported measles cases in São Paulo in 2025 (including a 27-year-old unvaccinated man). Measles is highly contagious and presents with fever, red maculopapular rash, cough, coryza, and conjunctivitis; severe outcomes include pneumonia, encephalitis, and death. PAHO reports 1,031 confirmed cases across seven Americas countries, up 43-fold from 2025, with 78% unvaccinated. Brazil’s public health system (SUS) provides measles vaccination free of charge.

triage.triage_reason: 輸入麻疹症例の報告だが単発例。ただしPAHO管轄地域で2025年比43倍増の大規模流行が背景にあり、未接種者への感染拡大リスクと周辺国への波及懸念から経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジル・サンパウロ州で2026年初の輸入麻疹例（6ヶ月児、ボリビア渡航歴、未接種）。当局は接触者追跡・積極的サーベイランス実施中。PAHO地域全体で麻疹が急増中（7ヶ国1,031例、前年比43倍、78%未接種）という疫学的背景が懸念材料。ブラジル国内での二次感染拡大や周辺国への逆輸出リスクを注視する必要がある。現時点では単発輸入例かつ対策実施中のためWATCH判定だが、続報（二次感染例、アウトブレイク化）があればPICKUPへ格上げを検討。

article.articleHeadline: Santa Maria dá início a vacinação de agentes de saúde e vigilância ambiental contra a dengue; outras ações ocorrem na sexta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Santa Maria begins vaccination of health agents and environmental surveillance against dengue; other actions occur on Friday.
article.articleSummary: Santa Maria, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, initiated dengue vaccination for public-health workers and environmental surveillance teams, with about 500 professionals targeted and 289 doses of the single-dose vaccine from Instituto Butantan already delivered. The rollout prioritizes staff of Vigilância em Saúde and vector-control roles, expanding to Primary Health Care workers per LIRAa infestation data. On Friday, March 13, a second vaccination shift from 17:00 to 20:00 will immunize children and adolescents aged 10–14 at ESF Wilson Paulo Noal, Rua Reinaldo Manoel Guidolin, 130, Camobi. The vaccine for this group is Qdenga, which requires two doses 3 months apart; about 1,000 people in the city have been immunized since its arrival on February 7. Guardians should bring vaccination card, CPF, and ID. Dengue transmission by Aedes aegypti emphasizes eliminating standing water.

triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンタマリアでのデング熱対策としての定期的ワクチン接種活動であり、異常な流行や予想外の事態ではなく、通常の公衆衛生対応と判断される。
triage.notes: 本記事は定期的な予防接種キャンペーン（医療従事者約500名、10-14歳児童・青少年約1,000名への接種）の実施を報じるものであり、アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではない。Qdenga（武田薬品）およびButantan研究所製ワクチンの通常展開であり、Aedes aegypti媒介デング熱への標準的な公衆衛生対応と評価される。症例数・重症度・流行動向に関する具体的情報は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Cambé começa a vacinar profissionais de saúde contra a dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cambé begins vaccinating healthcare professionals against dengue.
article.articleSummary: As of 11 March 2026, Cambé, in the Metropolitan Region of Londrina, Paraná, Brazil, began vaccinating frontline healthcare workers against dengue. The municipality has received 193 doses of the Instituto Butantan dengue vaccine, a single-dose regimen considered complete immunization. The strategy prioritizes frontline staff, including community health agents, endemic-control workers, and vaccinators, with about 190 of 300 Primary Health Care (APS) professionals targeted initially. The vaccine is recommended for individuals aged 15–59. Expansion will occur as new doses arrive, but there is no forecast for general population rollout. Distribution is coordinated by the Ministry of Health in partnership with Sesa-PR (Secretaria da Saúde do Paraná). The vaccine helps prevent severe dengue, such as dengue hemorrágica, amid ongoing efforts to curb transmission by Aedes aegypti.

triage.triage_reason: 通常のワクチン接種キャンペーン開始に関する報告であり、異常事態や深刻な公衆衛生影響を示唆する情報は含まれていない。デング熱流行への予防対策として妥当な範囲内の活動と判断される。
triage.notes: ブラジル・パラナ州Cambé市における医療従事者向けデング熱ワクチン接種開始の報告。Instituto Butantan製単回接種ワクチン193回分を使用し、プライマリヘルスケア従事者約190名を優先接種対象としている。通常の公衆衛生対策の一環であり、アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではない。重症例や死亡例の記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Testicoli di tacchino tra Italia e Francia: epidemia aviaria blocca l'esportazione, contratto risolto senza risarcimento
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Turkey Testicles Between Italy and France: Avian Influenza Outbreak Blocks Exports, Contract Terminated Without Compensation.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza outbreak in Vendée, western France, during 2022–2023 forced the euthanasia of turkeys and a ban on export to Hong Kong. An Italian company from Reggio Emilia had ordered 20 tonnes of turkey testicles from a French farm for €57,000, intended for resale to Hong Kong for €70,000. When delivery did not occur, the Italian firm sued the French breeder and Italian distributor. The Reggio Emilia Court of First Civil Section, led by Judge Monica Kumbasar, ruled the contract terminated due to force majeure and rejected all compensation claims. The court found the French breeder unable to fulfill obligations without fault because the avian influenza outbreak necessitated culling and export prohibition, thus absolving liability. No damages were payable. This case highlights how animal disease outbreaks can disrupt international meat trade and trigger contract impossibility defenses.

triage.triage_reason: 2022-2023年に発生した過去の鳥インフルエンザアウトブレイクに関する法廷判決のニュースであり、現在進行中の公衆衛生イベントではない。ヒト感染の報告もなく、貿易紛争の法的解決に関する記事である。
triage.notes: 本記事は2022-2023年に発生した鳥インフルエンザによる七面鳥の殺処分と輸出禁止措置が原因で、イタリア企業とフランス生産者間の商取引契約が不可抗力により解除されたという法廷判決を報じるもの。疾患名に「Human Infection with Avian Influenza」が含まれているが、記事中にヒト感染の記述はなく、動物（七面鳥）のみが影響を受けた過去の事例。現在の公衆衛生リスクを示すものではないため、シグナルトリアージの対象外と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Ator Fulbio Stefanini é internado após contrair infecção bacteriana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Actor Fulbio Stefanini is hospitalized after contracting a bacterial infection.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-03-11, Brazilian actor Fulvio Stefanini (86) was hospitalized after contracting a bacterial infection. The illness led to the cancellation of performances of the play O Pai in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, with the production confirming the news through a statement from the show's communications team. No pathogen type, symptom details, or laboratory confirmation were disclosed, and there is no mention of an outbreak or additional cases. The article notes the production’s premise—about a woman facing decisions after her father’s Alzheimer’s diagnosis—though this context is unrelated to the infection. This event affects live theater in Rio de Janeiro and highlights health risks for elderly performers during infectious illnesses.

triage.triage_reason: 単一の高齢俳優の細菌感染による入院事例であり、病原体・症状・アウトブレイクの情報が一切なく、公衆衛生上の影響は極めて限定的。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準のいずれにも該当せず、社会的関心も芸能ニュースレベルに留まる。
triage.notes: 病原体特定なし・症状詳細なし・検査確認なし・追加症例なしの個別事例。演劇公演中止という社会的影響はあるが感染症サーベイランス上の意義は認められない。高齢者（86歳）の細菌感染は一般的であり異常性なし。

article.articleHeadline: Hace seis años el COVID-19 fue declarado como pandemia global
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Six years ago, COVID-19 was declared a global pandemic.
article.articleSummary: Six years after the World Health Organization declared COVID-19 a global pandemic, WHO commemorated the anniversary on March 11, 2026. Originating in Wuhan, China, in late 2019, COVID-19 has caused more than seven million confirmed deaths worldwide. The disease is now considered endemic, with low incidence and mortality but continuing risk to vulnerable populations. About 10–20% of those infected report persistent symptoms (long COVID). Beyond clinical effects, the pandemic has produced lasting mental health impacts and educational setbacks, which health authorities and institutions are addressing in the post-pandemic era.

triage.triage_reason: 6周年の振り返り記事であり、新規の感染症イベントや異常事態を報告するものではない。現在COVID-19は流行性が低く死亡率も低い風土病（endemic）段階にあると記載されており、公衆衛生上の新たな脅威は示されていない。
triage.notes: これは2026年3月11日時点でのパンデミック宣言6周年記念記事。現在の状況として「風土病化」「低い発生率・死亡率」「脆弱層へのリスク継続」「長期症状（Long COVID）の存在」が言及されているが、新たな集団発生や異常事態の報告ではない。歴史的回顧と現状整理を目的とした記事であり、リアルタイムのシグナルトリアージ対象とはならない。

article.articleHeadline: Raiva em morcegos: SP confirma 15 ocorrências e fundação emite alerta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies in bats: São Paulo confirms 15 cases and a foundation issues an alert.
article.articleSummary: Rabies in bats in São Paulo state, Brazil: a French foundation dedicated to studying microorganisms, infectious diseases, and vaccines has issued an alert regarding bat rabies in São Paulo. This year, fifteen occurrences have been confirmed. The alert signals ongoing bat-associated rabies activity in the state, with laboratory confirmation noted in the report, though no details on clinical symptoms, human exposures, or case-by-case data are provided. The piece is reported by Nathalia Cassiano and Antônio Matos. No information is given about infection sources, imported or exported cases, or specific municipalities within São Paulo. The alert underscores potential public health implications for residents and animal health authorities, emphasizing awareness and preventive measures. Published March 11, 2026.

triage.triage_reason: 動物での狂犬病確認だが人への曝露情報なし。情報不足のため続報を注視すべき。
triage.notes: コウモリでの狂犬病15件確認、財団による警報発出。ヒトへの曝露・症例・臨床症状の詳細なし。感染源・感染経路・自治体詳細も不明。動物衛生および予防措置強化の段階だが、ヒト健康影響が明らかになれば評価変更の可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo confirma o primeiro caso de sarampo em 2026 | Exame
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo confirms the first measles case in 2026 | Exame.
article.articleSummary: Measles confirmed in São Paulo, first case of 2026. A six-month-old female, unvaccinated, with travel to Bolivia in January was diagnosed with measles in February. In 2025, São Paulo reported two imported measles cases. The Secretaria de Saúde states it continuously monitors the epidemiological situation and reiterates that vaccination is the main form of prevention. The vaccination schedule remains in effect with recommendations from the health secretariat, though the article does not detail the doses. The infection is linked to international travel, underscoring the importation risk for the region and the need to vaccinate to protect infants and prevent further importations.

triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の輸入症例1例のみであり、IHR基準では1つのみ該当。ワクチン未接種乳児の輸入症例として異常性は低く、現時点では国際的拡大や深刻な公衆衛生影響の証拠不足。ただし麻疹の感染力の高さから続報監視が必要。
triage.notes: 2026年サンパウロ州初の麻疹症例。生後6ヶ月の未接種乳児がボリビア渡航後に発症。2025年も輸入症例2例あり。単発の輸入症例であり二次感染の報告なし。ブラジルは麻疹排除認定国であり、サーベイランス・ワクチン接種体制は機能している模様。epidemic_proneをYesとしたのは麻疹の高い感染力による潜在的リスクを考慮。現時点では国内伝播の証拠なく、深刻度は低いが、続報で接触者調査結果や追加症例の有無を確認すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Fulvio Stefanini cancela apresentações de teatro após contrair infecção bacteriana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fulvio Stefanini cancels theatre performances after contracting a bacterial infection.
article.articleSummary: On March 11, 2026, 86-year-old actor Fulvio Stefanini was hospitalized after contracting a bacterial infection, undergoing tests and treatment. He will not perform the weekend shows of O Pai at Teatro TotalEnergies in Rio de Janeiro (March 13–15). The production called the cancellation unfortunate and unpredictable. Stefanini is expected to be discharged next week and return to the stage on March 20. Audience members with tickets for this weekend can revalidate for another session or request refunds. O Pai portrays an elderly man diagnosed with Alzheimer’s disease; in this Brazilian production, the cast includes Stefanini alongside his son, Deo Patricio, Carol Mariottini, Leo Stefanini, and Lara Cordula. The piece is based on Florian Zeller’s work, which also spawned a 2021 film adaptation.

triage.triage_reason: 86歳の俳優個人の細菌感染症による入院事例。公衆衛生上の集団発生や異常事象の兆候はなく、国際的拡大リスクも認められない。
triage.notes: 単一の個人症例（著名人の入院）であり、疾患名も「Unknown Illness」と特定されていない。集団発生、アウトブレイク、または公衆衛生上の懸念を示す情報は含まれていない。演劇公演のキャンセルは個人の健康問題に起因する興行上の事象であり、感染症サーベイランスの対象とはならない。

article.articleHeadline: Dentro de casa: os objetos que podem transmitir mpox sem você perceber
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: At Home: The Objects That Can Transmit mpox Without You Realizing
article.articleSummary: Mpox can spread in households via fomites—shared towels (bath/face), bed linens (sheets, blankets), razors, toothbrushes, and fabric surfaces (sofas, chairs). The mpox virus is highly resistant on porous materials and can remain active on fibers when used by an infected person. Contamination occurs when lesion fluids or secretions contact objects; others touching these items can acquire the virus. Transmission is mainly via contaminated fomites. Home isolation requires rigorous cleaning to prevent spread. Prevention includes monitoring all residents for mpox symptoms, seeking prompt medical evaluation if symptoms appear, and isolating until the cause of lesions is confirmed. Emphasize strict hygiene to neutralize the virus in most environments and consult health authorities for regional updates as of 11 March 2026.

triage.triage_reason: 家庭内での接触感染予防に関する一般的な健康教育記事であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事象の報告ではない。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクを示す情報は含まれていない。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジルにおけるmpoxの家庭内感染予防に関する啓発記事であり、タオル・寝具・剃刀等の共用によるfomite感染のリスクと予防策（厳格な衛生管理、症状モニタリング、隔離）を説明している。特定のアウトブレイク発生や症例数増加、異常な臨床像等の疫学的シグナルは記載されておらず、通常の感染症教育コンテンツと判断される。

article.articleHeadline: WHO swiftly delivers botulism antitoxin to Vietnam
article.articleSummary: On March 11, 2026, the World Health Organization delivered five vials of botulism antitoxin to Da Nang, Vietnam, to treat three critically ill patients suspected of botulism poisoning. After a health-authority alert, WHO activated resources from its Geneva stockpile and arranged immediate shipment, coordinating with Vietnam’s Ministry of Health, local agencies, and airport/logistics partners to ensure rapid, safe delivery. Angela Pratt, WHO Representative in Vietnam, underscored urgent care and partnerships, noting the response reflects preparedness and strengthens health security. Botulism antitoxin is rare but critical and can improve recovery when administered promptly. Vietnam is also collaborating with WHO to guard against Nipah virus. Separately, WHO donated 9,000 rabies vaccine doses to high-risk provinces Phu Tho and Tuyen Quang on Oct 22 to aid exposure prevention.

triage.triage_reason: ボツリヌス中毒3例への緊急対応として国際支援が実施されたが、事例の詳細（原因、感染源、追加症例の有無）が不明。続報により人数拡大や食品由来アウトブレイクの可能性を確認する必要がある。
triage.notes: 3例の重症患者に対しWHOがジュネーブ備蓄から抗毒素を緊急供給。ボツリヌス症は稀だが致命的で早期投与が重要。患者背景（食品由来か創傷性か）、疫学的リンク、追加症例の有無が不明なため現時点ではWATCH判定。なお記事後半の狂犬病ワクチン供与（2025年10月）とニパウイルス協力は別件。

article.articleHeadline: Productores granjeros advierten por riesgo de ingreso de gripe aviar ante "creciente" contrabando en fronteras
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Farmers Warn of the Risk of Avian Influenza Entering Amid Increasing Border Smuggling
article.articleSummary: Uruguay's Confederación Granjera del Uruguay (CGU) warns that rising border smuggling of plant and animal products threatens trade and health, including the risk of avian influenza entering the country. The CGU, uniting about 10 farm associations, urged Customs to act and proposed an interagency working group with Aduanas, the Ministry of Livestock, MGAP, and the UAM. They report smuggling concentrates in departments north of the Río Negro and in Maldonado and Rocha, undermining domestic producers and raising the risk of pests and plant diseases. Poultry and egg smuggling is of particular concern, with fears of avian influenza from Argentina or Brazil. In February, Salud Pública declared a national emergency for highly pathogenic H5 avian influenza, though no farm outbreaks have been reported yet. Authorities are increasing border controls (calls for armed forces at crossings) and aiming to develop risk-analysis systems; 2025 seizure value rose versus 2024.

triage.triage_reason: 鳥インフルエンザ（H5亜型）の国境を越えた密輸による侵入リスクが警告されているが、現時点でヒト感染や家禽農場での発生は報告されていない。ウルグアイ政府は既に国家緊急事態を宣言し監視体制を強化中であり、情報が限定的なため続報の注視が必要。
triage.notes: 本事例は実際の疾病発生ではなく、密輸による高病原性鳥インフルエンザ（H5亜型）侵入リスクの警告。ウルグアイは2月に国家緊急事態を宣言済みだが、農場での発生は未報告。アルゼンチン・ブラジルからの家禽製品密輸が懸念されており、国境管理強化と省庁間作業部会設置が提案されている。ヒト感染リスクは記事からは不明だが、高病原性H5の特性上、潜在的リスクとして監視継続が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Laudo revela presença de norovírus em amostras de fezes de alunos e professores que passaram mal e tiveram aulas suspensas em escola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lab report reveals presence of norovirus in stool samples from students and teachers who fell ill and had classes suspended at a school
article.articleSummary: Norovirus has been confirmed in stool samples from students and teachers at EMEI Prof. Octávio Dezan Sobrinho in Macaubal, São Paulo, after an outbreak that sickened 79 people (56 children, 23 adults) and led to school closures from February 11–13. Laboratory analysis, with samples partly sent to reference laboratories in São José do Rio Preto, identified norovirus as the causative agent of acute gastroenteritis. Water and food samples were collected, but analyses did not detect contamination; the local health department noted the outsourced school meal program supplies another school, yet only one campus reported cases, arguing against food poisoning. Norovirus is highly transmissible in collective settings like schools and daycares, spreading via direct person-to-person contact. Initial suspicion was virose; the investigation confirms viral gastroenteritis linked to this outbreak.

triage.triage_reason: 学校でのノロウイルス集団感染（79名発症）だが、地域限定的で既に学校閉鎖等の対策実施済み。死亡例なし、国際拡大リスクは低いが、アウトブレイク規模と感染力の高さから経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 学校という閉鎖的環境での典型的なノロウイルス集団感染。79名（児童56名、成人23名）発症で規模はやや大きいが、重症例・死亡例の記載なし。2月11-13日に学校閉鎖済みで対応完了。食品・水検査で汚染検出されず、ヒト-ヒト感染が主体。地域の保健当局が適切に対応しており、外部支援不要。ノロウイルスとしては典型的なアウトブレイクパターンで異常性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Terneros centinela: Eficaz herramienta de vigilancia epidemiológica de la fiebre aftosa - NoticiasFormosa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sentinel calves: An effective tool for epidemiological surveillance of foot-and-mouth disease - NoticiasFormosa.
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) sentinel-calf surveillance in Argentina shows sustained absence of viral circulation within a vaccination-zone. In January–February 2026, SENASA veterinarians serologically sampled over 700 bovines from 51 farms across Buenos Aires Norte and Sur, Córdoba, Corrientes–Misiones, Cuyo, Chaco–Formosa, Entre Ríos, La Pampa–San Luis, Metropolitano, NOA Norte and Sur, and Santa Fe. Sentinel calves aged 6–12 months, unvaccinated, are tested to certify absence of FMD circulation in the zone free with vaccination; after sampling they are vaccinated per regional plan. Since 2018, over 41,000 samples have been negative, underpinning continuous surveillance. May 2025, Argentina ratified its FMD-free status with the World Organisation for Animal Health (OMSA) and merged Centro-Norte with Cordón Fronterizo as a single vaccination-zone. SENASA Resolution 711/2025 (2026) updates vaccination: halts second-campaign vaccination for vaquillonas, novillos, novillitos and toritos. These measures support safe exports and domestic food safety.

triage.triage_reason: アルゼンチンにおける口蹄疫の定期サーベイランス活動の報告であり、ウイルス循環が認められず陰性結果が継続していることを示す。新規発生や異常事態ではなく、通常の疾病監視体制の成果報告である。
triage.notes: 本記事は疾病発生ではなく、サーベイランス陰性結果の報告。2018年以降41,000検体超が陰性であり、2025年5月にOMSAがアルゼンチンの口蹄疫清浄国ステータスを再確認済み。動物のみに影響する疾患であり、ヒト健康への直接的リスクなし。定期監視の良好な実施状況を示すポジティブニュースであり、シグナルとしての価値はない。

article.articleHeadline: Barbeiros são encontrados em 21 cidades de MS; estado não registra casos de Chagas em humanos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kissing bugs are found in 21 cities in Mato Grosso do Sul; the state does not report human cases of Chagas disease.
article.articleSummary: In 2025, Mato Grosso do Sul detected 262 triatomine bugs (kissing bugs) across 21 municipalities, including 49 in Campo Grande. Two specimens from Anastácio tested positive for Trypanosoma cruzi, the parasite that causes Chagas disease, but there are no human cases currently reported in the state. Surveillance via the Coordinadoria Estadual de Controle de Vetores confirms that vector presence does not equal transmission; monitoring includes species identification and laboratory testing. Transmission occurs through insect feces or urine, not by bite, and can also occur from contaminated food or blood transfusion. The most common vector in MS is Triatoma sordida, with Triatoma infestans more typical in other regions. Public health maintains active surveillance across 79 municipalities, with laboratories and units in Campo Grande, Dourados, Jardim, and Três Lagoas. Chagas can affect the heart and digestive system; treatment exists but late-stage damage can be difficult to reverse.

triage.triage_reason: ベクター（サシガメ）の検出とT. cruzi陽性検体の確認があるが、現時点でヒト症例は報告されていない。ベクターサーベイランスは機能しており、予防的監視段階にある。情報は比較的明確だが、ヒトへの健康影響が未発生のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 2025年にマット・グロッソ・ド・スル州21市でサシガメ262匹検出、うちAnastácio産2検体がT. cruzi陽性。しかしヒト症例はゼロ。州は79市で積極的サーベイランスを実施中。ベクター存在＝伝播ではないことを当局が明言。治療法は存在し、late-stage以外は対応可能。地域的には風土病エリアであり、現時点では通常のベクターサーベイランスの範囲内と判断。続報で急性ヒト症例や集団感染が報告された場合はPICKUPに格上げを検討。

article.articleHeadline: Kala campak mengintai balita
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles Lurk Among Toddlers
article.articleSummary: Measles (morbilli) outbreaks persist in Nusa Tenggara Barat (NTB), Indonesia, as of early 2026. In Dompu Regency, suspected measles cases reach 216 among children, not including those in intensive care. In Bima Regency, a declared measles outbreak (KLB) records 306 cases and one death. Mataram City reports zero cases due to aggressive immunization efforts. Measles is highly contagious, spreading via droplets, with incubation up to three weeks. Symptoms include high fever, red maculopapular rash, cough, runny nose, and conjunctivitis, with risks of pneumonia, severe diarrhea, and encephalitis. Behind the numbers lie parental uncertainty, health workers’ perseverance, and systemic immunization challenges. Emphasizes vaccination and ongoing outreach to all villages to prevent re-emergence in NTB.

triage.triage_reason: 麻疹アウトブレイクが複数地域で発生し、死亡例を含む重症例が多数報告されている。WHOのIHR基準で2つ以上該当し、社会的関心も高い。フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: インドネシア・西ヌサトゥンガラ州で麻疹アウトブレイクが継続中。Dompu県で216例の疑い例、Bima県でKLB宣言済み（306例、死亡1例）。麻疹は高度に伝染性が高く、肺炎・脳炎等の重症合併症リスクあり。ワクチン接種の課題が示唆されており、複数村への継続的なアウトリーチが強調されている。集中治療を要する症例も存在。WPROスクリーニング基準で4項目該当し、政府レベルでの対応（KLB宣言）が確認されているため、PICKUPと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Estado confirma primeiro caso de sarampo - O Diário Interativo Online
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: State confirms first measles case - The Online Interactive Daily
article.articleSummary: Measles case confirmed in 2026 in São Paulo state, Brazil. A six-month-old infant from São Paulo capital had traveled to Bolivia in January and had no immunization history. Notification occurred in February; laboratory confirmation in March classifies the case as imported. Barretos currently reports no suspected or confirmed measles cases, but surveillance remains active. Measles is highly contagious and can cause pneumonia, encephalitis, and death, especially in unvaccinated children. The national triple viral vaccine (measles, mumps, rubella) remains the primary preventive measure and is provided free by the Unified Health System (SUS). In the municipality, vaccination is available at Basic Health Units and the Specialties Outpatient Clinic (Postão), Monday–Friday, 7:30–16:00, with guidance to keep vaccination records up to date. Emphasizes vaccination to prevent importation and transmission.

triage.triage_reason: 輸入性麻疹の単発例であり、現時点では国際的拡大や重大な公衆衛生影響は限定的。ただし麻疹の高い感染力と、6ヶ月児の未接種による脆弱性、ボリビアからの輸入という国際移動の要素があるため、続報と周辺での二次感染発生を注視すべき。
triage.notes: 2026年サンパウロ州初の麻疹確定例（輸入性）。6ヶ月児、ボリビア渡航歴あり、未接種。1月渡航、2月届出、3月検査確定。バレットス市では疑い例・確定例なし。麻疹は高い感染力を持ち、肺炎・脳炎・死亡リスクがあるが、現時点では単発輸入例で地域伝播の証拠なし。サーベイランス継続中、予防接種推奨が強調されている。記事に死亡・重症化・集団発生の記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ministério da Saúde confirma primeiro caso de sarampo no país em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health Confirms the Country's First Measles Case in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Brazil confirms its first measles (sarampo) case of 2026: a 6‑month‑old infant from São Paulo who had traveled to Bolivia; child was not vaccinated, notification in February, laboratoryly confirmed. Last year, São Paulo recorded two imported measles cases; Brazil totaled 38 confirmed measles cases in 2025, with 25 in Tocantins. Vaccination remains the best protection: measles vaccine is in the National Immunization Schedule, first dose at 12 months and second at 15 months. For those 5–29 years without childhood vaccination records, two doses are recommended at least 30 days apart; ages 30–59 require a single dose. Measles is highly contagious, causing dry cough, eye irritation, runny nose, and malaise, followed by a red, itchy rash; transmission via cough, sneeze, talk, or breathing, with about 9 in 10 non‑immune exposed becoming infected. The WHO warned 13 American countries of a 32‑fold rise in 2025 versus 2024.

triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでの2026年初の麻疹輸入例であり、WHOが米州での32倍増を警告している背景があるが、現時点では単一の輸入症例であり二次感染の報告なし。ワクチン未接種の乳児という脆弱層への影響と地域での伝播リスクを監視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 2025年にブラジル全体で38例、トカンティンス州で25例の麻疹が確認されており、WHOが米州全体で2024年比32倍増を警告している背景がある。今回は6ヶ月齢のワクチン未接種乳児による輸入例（ボリビアから）で、現時点では散発例だが、麻疹の高い感染力（非免疫者の9割が感染）を考慮すると、続報での二次感染の有無、ワクチン接種率、接触者追跡の状況を注視する必要がある。サンパウロ州では2025年に2例の輸入例があった。

article.articleHeadline: Ubá confirma primeira morte por leptospirose após enchentes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ubá confirms first death due to leptospirosis after floods.
article.articleSummary: Ubá, in Zona da Mata, Minas Gerais, Brazil, confirmed the first death from leptospirosis linked to the February floods. The city also reported 41 suspected cases under epidemiological investigation; samples were sent to Fundação Ezequiel Dias (Funed) in Belo Horizonte, with results pending. Seven deaths have occurred in the region, and one person remains missing. The Minas Gerais State Health Secretariat maintains ongoing monitoring, with laboratory analyses and epidemiological investigations in Ubá. Leptospirosis is caused by Leptospira and is transmitted when skin or mucous membranes contact water, mud, or soil contaminated with urine from infected animals, especially rats. Incubation ranges 1–30 days, typically 7–14. The Minas Gerais Fire Department reported ongoing searches for the missing Luciano Franklin Fernandes, with 33 soldiers, drones, thermal cameras, dogs, and an excavator working along the Ubá River.

triage.triage_reason: 洪水後のレプトスピラ症アウトブレイクで死亡例が発生し、41例の疑い例が調査中。洪水による汚染水への曝露が継続し、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と地域内での拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 洪水災害後の典型的なレプトスピラ症アウトブレイク。死亡1例、疑い例41例、地域全体で7名の死亡（レプトスピラ症以外も含む可能性）。州保健局が疫学調査・検査を実施中。汚染された河川水・土壌への曝露が継続しており、追加症例発生のリスクが高い。消防隊が行方不明者の捜索を継続中であり、救助活動従事者への曝露リスクも懸念される。ブラジル国内の地域的問題であり国際的拡大の可能性は低いが、WPROスクリーニング基準4項目該当および社会的関心の高さからPICKUP判定とする。

article.articleHeadline: Telaah - Kala campak mengintai balita
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Analysis - When Measles Threaten Toddlers.
article.articleSummary: Measles (morbilli) is resurging in Nusa Tenggara Barat (NTB), Indonesia. As of early 2026, Dompu reports 216 suspected cases; Bima declares a Public Health Emergency (KLB) with 306 cases and one death. Mataram city maintains zero cases through aggressive immunization and proactive outreach. The outbreak traces to immunization gaps; in Central Lombok, August 2025 coverage was 49%, far below the herd immunity target (>94%). Globally post-COVID-19 disruptions reduced vaccination rates. Dompu implements Outbreak Response Immunization (ORI) for 9–59 month olds to reach ~95% coverage, with epidemiological investigations; Mataram emphasizes birth-based data, frontline mobilization, and risk communication. Challenges persist: health literacy gaps, misinformation, and geographic barriers. Solutions include culturally tailored risk communication with community leaders, expanded outreach beyond clinics, and digital monitoring for immunization and outbreak control.

triage.triage_reason: 麻疹アウトブレイクが公衆衛生緊急事態（KLB）として宣言され、306例・1死亡を記録。予防接種率の大幅低下（49%）により国際拡大リスクがあり、IHR基準3つ該当。
triage.notes: COVID-19パンデミックによるワクチン接種率低下（集団免疫目標94%に対し49%）が背景。複数の州でアウトブレイク発生中（Dompu 216例疑い、Bima 306例・1死亡でKLB宣言）。麻疹は感染力が極めて高く、ワクチン未接種集団での国際拡大リスクが高い。Outbreak Response Immunization実施中だが、健康リテラシー不足・誤情報・地理的障壁により対応に課題。フルRRAで周辺国への波及リスク・ワクチン供給状況・渡航者への影響を評価すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Expansão de javalis no Rio Grande do Sul gera crise agrícola e sanitária
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Expansion of wild boars in Rio Grande do Sul generates an agricultural and public health crisis.
article.articleSummary: Expansion of wild boars in Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, creates an agricultural and public-health crisis. In Fronteira Sul, Campanha, and Campos de Cima da Serra, losses reach up to 40% in maize, soy, and orchards; Ibama (2025) notes impact across about 200 municipalities, with Alegrete as the outbreak epicenter. Introduced in South America in the early 20th century and spreading since the 1980s, wild boars lack natural predators in Brazil; a sow can have up to 25 piglets per year, making them one of the world’s 100 worst invasive species. Hybrid 'javaporco' (boar-pig cross) is more adaptable and aggressive. To curb spread in 2026, agro groups estimate the culled population must exceed 1.2 million. Boars are vectors for diseases such as foot-and-mouth disease, classical swine fever, leptospirosis, and toxoplasmosis; consumption of wild boar meat is not recommended. Control follows Ibama Normative No. 12. A new invader, the chital deer, observed near Vacaria, also threatens crops and native fauna.

triage.triage_reason: 野生イノシシの拡大による農業被害と複数の人獣共通感染症リスクが確認されているが、現時点でヒトへの実際の感染事例や流行の報告がなく、主に動物衛生・農業問題として扱われている。ヒト症例の発生動向について続報の注視が必要。
triage.notes: 本イベントは主に野生イノシシ（invasive species）の個体数拡大による農業被害と、それに伴う複数の人獣共通感染症（口蹄疫、豚熱、レプトスピラ症、トキソプラズマ症）の潜在的リスクを扱っている。約200自治体に影響があり、Alegretoが中心。年間120万頭以上の駆除が必要とされる深刻な状況だが、記事にはヒトへの実際の感染事例や公衆衛生上の発生報告は含まれていない。野生イノシシ肉の消費は推奨されないとの記載あり。現時点では動物衛生・農業・生態系問題が主体であり、ヒト公衆衛生への直接的影響は不明確。ただし、長期曝露リスクと感染症媒介の可能性から、ヒト症例発生の監視が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Που ξεκίνησε ο Κορωνοϊός; - Googlareis.gr
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Where did the coronavirus start?
article.articleSummary: Origin of SARS-CoV-2 is natural, not lab-engineered, according to a Cell study led by virologist Joel Wertheim. Investigating seven major outbreaks (Ebola, influenza, monkeypox) to see if prior to spillover viruses carried suspicious genetic changes, researchers found no evidence of artificial manipulation in SARS-CoV-2. The virus appears to have evolved naturally in animals and jumped to humans without laboratory help, with its high human-to-human transmissibility driving rapid global spread from late 2019 in Wuhan, China. A sole historical exception linked to a lab accident is the 1977 Russian Flu; in all other pandemics, natural origins predominate. The study underscores understanding natural spillover as the key to predicting and preventing future health crises, as noted by The New York Times in summarizing the Cell findings.

triage.triage_reason: SARS-CoV-2の起源に関する回顧的研究報告であり、現在進行中の新規アウトブレイクではない。2019年の武漢での発生を振り返る学術研究の紹介記事であり、新たな公衆衛生上の脅威は示されていない。
triage.notes: 本記事はCell誌に掲載されたSARS-CoV-2の自然起源を支持する研究論文の紹介であり、過去7つの主要アウトブレイク（エボラ、インフルエンザ、mpoxなど）を分析した学術的内容。現在進行中の感染症イベントではなく、2019年武漢での発生に関する回顧的分析。疾患名リストに複数の疾患が含まれているのは研究対象として言及されたためと推測される。リアルタイムの公衆衛生対応を要する新規シグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de coqueluche aumentam em RR e Duda Ramos busca apoio e encaminha soluções em Brasília | Roraima em Foco
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cases of pertussis are increasing in Roraima, and Duda Ramos seeks support and proposes solutions in Brasília | Roraima in Focus
article.articleSummary: Pertussis (whooping cough) cases are rising in Roraima, Brazil, with the first reports in January 2026. The Santo Antônio Children’s Hospital identified infections in the Terra Indígena Yanomami. The latest bulletin confirms 20 cases, mainly in Surucucu (Alto Alegre) and three in Boa Vista. Three pediatric deaths have occurred among children hospitalized there. Pertussis is a highly contagious respiratory infection that primarily affects infants and can become severe if not treated promptly. Yanomami Association (URIHI) officials warn seven indigenous communities in Surucucu and Boa Vista are at risk, calling for urgent medical support and protection. Federal Deputy Duda Ramos has traveled to Brasília to seek Ministry of Health aid for treatment, prevention, and rapid response for vulnerable Yanomami populations, as health authorities coordinate to curb transmission and prevent further fatalities.

triage.triage_reason: 小児3名の死亡を伴う百日咳のアウトブレイクで、先住民コミュニティという脆弱な集団に影響。IHR基準3つ該当、WPRO基準4つ該当し、政府レベルでの対応（連邦議員が保健省支援要請）も行われている。
triage.notes: 2026年1月に最初の報告があり、3月時点で20症例・小児3名死亡。Yanomami先住民居住区(Terra Indígena)のSurucucuおよびBoa Vistaの7コミュニティがリスク下。百日咳は予防接種で対策可能な疾患だが、先住民コミュニティでの医療アクセス不足・ワクチン接種率が懸念される。連邦議員がBrasíliaで保健省支援を要請中であり、国家レベルでの対応が進行している。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue Fever Cases Skyrocket in Maldives, But Tourism Boom Continues, Here's What You Need to Know! - Travel And Tour World
article.articleSummary: January 2026 dengue surge in Maldives with 631 confirmed cases, up nearly sixfold from January 2025. Outbreak concentrated in Vaavu Atoll, Kaafu Atoll, and Gaafu Alif Atoll. Dengue remains endemic year-round in the Maldives, transmitted by mosquitoes; regional context shows Sri Lanka reporting 5,471 cases and India 3,019 this year. Despite health risks, tourism is buoyant with a projected 2.5 million visitors in 2026. A globally available vaccine (Qdenga) is not part of Maldives’ national immunization program, and no immediate rollout is planned. CDC issues a Level 1 travel notice; travelers should implement mosquito-bite precautions (repellents, long sleeves, air-conditioned or netted accommodations). Travelers should consult healthcare providers before travel and stay informed via WHO/CDC advisories. Public health authorities continue awareness and control measures while dengue maintains endemic status.

triage.triage_reason: モルディブでのデング熱症例が前年同月比約6倍に急増しており、異常な増加パターンを示す。ただし、重症度・死亡数・国際拡大の具体的データが不明であり、現時点ではフルRRAに進むには情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 631例という数値は前年比約6倍の急増だが、入院数・死亡数の具体的データなし。デングはモルディブで通年流行（風土病）のため「異常」の判断が難しい。CDCレベル1（最低警戒レベル）であり渡航制限なし。観光業は継続中で2026年250万人来訪予測。周辺国（スリランカ5,471例、インド3,019例）でも発生中。ワクチン（Qdenga）は国家プログラム外。続報で重症例・死亡例・医療体制逼迫の有無を確認要。

article.articleHeadline: Alberta sees measles upswing with dozens of cases reported over the weekend
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in Alberta: 36 new infections over the weekend, pushing the 2026 total to more than 150. Most cases in the South Zone, with additional infections in Edmonton, Calgary, and the North Zone. Alberta and Manitoba account for the vast majority of measles cases in Canada this year; Manitoba reports 269 infections, the largest outbreak. Over 90% of 2026 cases are unvaccinated. Outbreak appears concentrated in small groups and families rather than widespread community transmission; exposure advisories issued and outreach expanded. Alberta has administered over 191,000 measles vaccine doses in the past year, with the “Don’t Get Measles, Get Immunized” campaign and extended clinic hours. Health experts urge easier, barrier-free vaccination, noting risk of severe complications including pneumonia, encephalitis, and death. Saskatchewan reports 5 and British Columbia 18 cases this year for comparison.

triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性）。カナダ複数州での麻疹アウトブレイク（2026年150例超）、ワクチン未接種者中心の拡大、重症合併症リスクあり。WHO通知相当の事象。
triage.notes: アルバータ州150例超、マニトバ州269例と2026年カナダで大規模麻疹アウトブレイク進行中。90%超がワクチン未接種。肺炎・脳炎・死亡リスクあり重症度高い。小集団・家族内伝播中心だが曝露拡大中。19万回超のワクチン接種実施と啓発キャンペーン展開中。国内対応は機能しているが、複数州跨ぐ規模と未接種集団での持続的伝播から国際的監視必要。ブラジル・中国の地域情報も含まれるが詳細不明。

article.articleHeadline: سحب منتجات محار من الأسواق الأمريكية لتلوث محتمل بفيروس شديد العدوى
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Oyster products recalled from U.S. markets due to potential contamination with a highly infectious virus.
article.articleSummary: FDA recalls Manila oysters harvested by the Lummi Indian Business Council after potential contamination with highly contagious norovirus. Oysters distributed across Arizona, California, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Nevada, New York, Oregon, and Washington are affected. A Washington state alert warns consumers who bought raw oysters from Drayton Harbor Oyster Company to not eat them and to dispose of them immediately. Harvest dates span February 23–March 3, 2026, from Drayton Harbor, Washington. Norovirus spreads via contaminated food or contact with contaminated surfaces, with symptoms typically 12–48 hours after exposure, including nausea, diarrhea, and vomiting, and poses a dehydration risk, especially for the elderly and those with underlying conditions. Annual US estimates include about 20 million infections, ~2 million medical visits, and around 2,500 outbreaks. Retailers and consumers should avoid raw oysters implicated and thoroughly clean/disinfect touched surfaces and utensils.

triage.triage_reason: ノロウイルス汚染による牡蠣のリコール事案。通常の食品安全管理の範囲内であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準いずれも該当せず、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 本事案は米国FDAによる通常の食品リコール措置（2026年2月23日〜3月3日収穫の牡蠣）。ノロウイルスは米国で年間約2000万感染、2500件のアウトブレイクが発生する既知の食中毒病原体であり、今回の事案に異常性は認められない。影響範囲は米国内9州に限定され、既に適切な公衆衛生対応（リコール・廃棄勧告）が実施されている。重症例・死亡例の報告なし。フィリピン（マニラ）が発生地域に含まれているが、記事内容は米国内のリコールのみを扱っており、国際的拡大の証拠はない。通常の食品安全サーベイランスの範囲内と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox: veja quais estados já confirmaram casos da doença - 11/03/2026 - Equilíbrio e Saúde - Folha
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox: see which states have already confirmed cases of the disease
article.articleSummary: Brazil reported 149 mpox (monkeypox) cases in 2026 with no deaths as of March 9, per the Ministry of Health’s surveillance panel. São Paulo accounts for 93 cases, followed by Rio de Janeiro (18), Rondônia (11), Minas Gerais (11), and single cases in Rio Grande do Norte, Rio Grande do Sul, Santa Catarina, Paraná (2), Amazonas, Ceará, Distrito Federal, Pará, and Sergipe (1 each). The Ministry says the situation is not a crisis and SUS remains prepared for diagnosis, treatment, epidemiological investigation, and contact tracing, with active surveillance ongoing. Two January São Paulo cases belong to clade 1b; in February the WHO noted two recombinant cases (1b/2b) in India and the UK. Transmission is mainly human-to-human via lesions, fluids, droplets, or contaminated objects; vaccination prioritizes HIV patients with CD4 100–200, PrEP users, and health workers, though supply is limited. In 2025 Brazil had 1,079 mpox cases and two deaths.

triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで2026年149例のmpox症例が報告されているが、死亡例なし。サンパウロでクレード1b症例2例が確認され、インド・英国で組み換え型（1b/2b）も報告されている。クレード1の国内伝播の可能性と組み換え型の出現は懸念材料だが、現時点では保健省が「危機的状況ではない」と評価しており、情報不足のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: クレード1b症例の南米での検出は疫学的に重要。また、インド・英国での組み換え型（1b/2b）出現も新たな懸念。ただし、症例数149例（死亡0）は2025年の1,079例（死亡2）と比較して低水準。ワクチン供給が限定的である点、HIV患者への優先接種が行われている点は注目に値する。続報で重症化率、クレード1bの伝播範囲、組み換え型の特性に関する情報を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Minuto JR: Bebê de seis meses é o primeiro caso confirmado de sarampo de 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: JR Minute: Six-month-old baby is the first confirmed measles case of 2026.
article.articleSummary: Measles, São Paulo state, Brazil: a six-month-old infant has the first laboratory-confirmed measles case of 2026 in the state. Symptoms appeared in February. The child was unvaccinated and had traveled to Bolivia in January, making the case imported. Bolivia is identified as the exposure source, with importation status indicating no presumed local transmission at the time of report. This single confirmed case underscores vulnerability of unimmunized infants to imported measles and highlights the year’s outset of measles activity in São Paulo. The article does not describe any secondary cases or additional details beyond this imported case. No other cases described.

triage.triage_reason: 輸入症例1例のみで二次感染の記載なし。ただし、ブラジル・サンパウロ州での2026年初の麻疹確定例であり、未接種乳児の脆弱性と輸入リスクを示唆するため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 単一の輸入症例（ボリビアからブラジルへ）。6ヶ月齢の未接種乳児。2月に発症、実験室確認済み。二次感染・接触者情報の記載なし。現時点では国内伝播の証拠なし。麻疹は感染力が高いため、接触者調査と予防接種状況の続報に注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Cidade de Ubá confirma primeira morte por leptospirose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: City of Ubá confirms first death due to leptospirosis.
article.articleSummary: Ubá, Minas Gerais, Brazil, reports the first death from leptospirosis on 11 March 2026 after floods and floods last month. The municipal Health Department says 41 suspected leptospirosis cases are under investigation; samples were sent to Fundação Ezequiel Dias in Belo Horizonte for laboratory confirmation. The deceased is a woman estimated to be 30–35 years old. Leptospirosis is transmitted through water or mud contaminated with rat urine, a risk amplified by flooding. Authorities urge vigilance for fever, headache, severe muscle pain (calves), nausea and vomiting, and to seek care promptly if symptoms worsen. The floods caused 72 deaths in Zona da Mata, including 65 in Juiz de Fora and seven in Ubá, with Matias Barbosa displaced. INMET issued a “great danger” rainfall alert for Zona da Mata until Mar 12, plus alerts for southern São Paulo coast, the São Paulo and Curitiba metropolitan areas; other states face heavy rains and storms.

triage.triage_reason: 洪水後のレプトスピラ症発生は予測可能な事象だが、41例の疑い例調査中で確定情報が不足。死亡例1件あり重症度は中等度以上。国際拡大リスクは低いが、続報による確定診断と規模の把握が必要。
triage.notes: 洪水災害（72名死亡）に伴う二次的な感染症発生。レプトスピラ症は洪水後の典型的疾患であり異常事象ではない。41例が検査中で確定例数不明のため規模評価困難。死亡1例（30-35歳女性）あり重症度は懸念材料。曝露源（汚染水・泥）は継続的に存在し、大雨警報も継続中（3月12日まで）。ブラジル国内対応可能で国際支援不要と判断されるが、確定診断結果と症例数推移の続報監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Seis anos depois, Covid-19 ainda pede atenção e vacinação segue essencial em Teresina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Six years later, COVID-19 still requires attention and vaccination remains essential in Teresina.
article.articleSummary: Six years after the World Health Organization declared COVID-19 a pandemic, Teresina authorities stress vaccination remains essential. The Municipal Health Foundation (FMS) urges continued immunization for groups: children 6 months to under 5 years, pregnant people, older adults, health professionals, individuals with comorbidities, permanent disabilities or immunocompromised status, Indigenous peoples, quilombolas, riverside communities, residents of long-term care facilities, detainees and prison staff, socio-educational adolescents, and people experiencing homelessness. In 2025, Teresina recorded 853 COVID-19 cases, considered low compared with pandemic peaks. Since 2021, about 2,736,000 vaccine doses have been administered in the capital, contributing to reductions in deaths, hospitalizations, and severe cases, easing hospital strain and enabling safer social and economic activities. Emanuelle Dias, FMS vaccination coordinator, stated that every dose is collective care and vaccination remains essential to protect lives.

triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の定常的な予防接種推奨活動の報告であり、異常事態や新たなリスクは示されていない。2025年の症例数853件はパンデミック時と比較して低水準であり、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響は認められない。
triage.notes: パンデミック宣言から6年後の定期的な予防接種啓発記事。2025年のテレジーナ市における症例数は853件と低水準で、2021年以降約273万回のワクチン接種により死亡・入院・重症例が減少している通常のサーベイランス報告。新規の異常事象や公衆衛生上の脅威は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ubá confirma primeira morte por leptospirose no município após inundações | CNN Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ubá confirms first death from leptospirosis in the municipality after the floods | CNN Brasil.
article.articleSummary: Ubá, Minas Gerais, Brazil, reports its first death from leptospirosis following floods. The victim is a woman aged 30–35. The municipal Health Secretariat says 41 suspected cases remain under epidemiological investigation, with samples sent to Fundação Ezequiel Dias (Funed) in Belo Horizonte for laboratory analysis; results are pending. Leptospirosis is transmitted through contact with water or mud contaminated by rat urine, a risk heightened after flooding. Common symptoms include fever, headache, severe body pains (notably calves), and nausea or vomiting. Health teams are intensifying prevention efforts and monitoring the situation in Ubá. No further details on exposure or infection source were provided, and authorities continue surveillance of suspected cases amid ongoing flood-related exposure.

triage.notes: 洪水後のレプトスピラ症は予測可能な事象。死亡1例（30-35歳女性）と疑い例41件が報告されているが、検査結果が未確定のため実際の規模は不明。地方自治体が予防活動と監視を強化中。ブラジル・ミナスジェライス州の地域的イベントで、現時点では国際的な拡大リスクは低い。疫学調査の結果と検査確定例数の続報で再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Nipah virus: a regional threat south Asia keeps underestimating
article.articleSummary: As of 12 March 2026, Nipah virus remains a regional threat across South Asia and Southeast Asia, with recurrent outbreaks since the 1999 Malaysia origin, high mortality, and frequent hospital transmission. Recent cases in India and Bangladesh illustrate ongoing transmission; there is no approved vaccine or targeted treatment. Reservoirs are fruit bats; spillover occurs when bats contaminate food or surfaces, with pigs acting as amplifying hosts in some settings. Ecological and social changes—deforestation, urban expansion, agricultural intensification—increase human–bat contact and spillover risk. Cross-border movement and informal animal trade raise regional spillover risk to Cambodia, Thailand, and the Philippines. Health systems, especially rural facilities, often lack diagnostics, PPE, and trained personnel, risking nosocomial amplification and limited laboratory capacity. A continuous One Health approach with stable funding, surveillance, ecological monitoring, cross-border communication, and accelerated development of vaccines and therapeutics is essential to prevent escalation.

triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルスの南アジア・東南アジアでの継続的流行リスクと国際拡大懸念。高い致死率、院内感染の頻発、承認済みワクチン・治療法の不在、複数国にまたがる生態学的リスク要因から、IHR基準3つ（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）およびWPRO基準複数項目に該当。
triage.notes: 1999年以降継続する地域的脅威であり「異常」ではないがエンデミックリスクは高い。致死率が高く、院内感染頻発、ワクチン・治療法なし、果実コウモリ保有宿主、森林破壊等による接触機会増加、国境を越えた動物取引によりカンボジア・タイ・フィリピンへの拡大リスクあり。農村部の医療施設では診断能力・PPE・訓練が不足しており、院内感染増幅リスクが高い。One Healthアプローチによる継続的監視と国際協力の必要性が明示されており、国際支援を要する。記事本文が空白のため詳細は不明だが、サマリーから十分なリスク情報を抽出可能。

article.articleHeadline: Emerging Mpox Strain Sparks Interest in Vaccine Developers Like GeoVax
article.articleSummary: Mpox Clade Ib travel-associated mpox cases were confirmed in Toronto, Ontario, marking the region's first travel-related cases; the area had previously seen Clade IIb activity since 2022. Ghana reported over 1,000 mpox infections by early March. Clade Ib has been identified in Central and East Africa and parts of Europe, and its North American arrival is likely to influence future public health needs and vaccine development. The report notes a dynamic vaccine market, with GeoVax and other developers watching demand for advanced, long-acting platforms. Conference discussions at CROI 2026 highlighted ultra-long-acting HIV prevention methods, signaling a broader industry shift toward extended-dosing technologies that could align with adaptable mpox vaccines. The article frames current conditions as potentially affecting investor sentiment—whether to buy or sell GeoVax—while noting fresh GeoVax information and a new independent report on market trends.

triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（異常性、国際拡大、深刻な影響の可能性）。Mpox Clade Ibの北米初確認はWHO通知相当の事象であり、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: Mpox Clade Ibのトロントでの渡航関連症例確認は北米初。ガーナで1,000件超の感染、中央・東アフリカ及び欧州での拡大が確認済み。Clade Ibは従来のClade IIbより病原性が高い可能性があり、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念事項。ワクチン開発動向への言及があり社会的関心も高い。重症度・死亡率等の詳細情報が不足しているため、続報での疫学データ収集が重要。

article.articleHeadline: ABC reforça vacinação após primeiro caso de sarampo em SP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ABC Steps Up Vaccination After First Measles Case in São Paulo
article.articleSummary: First measles case in the State of São Paulo in 2026 prompts ABC region to intensify vaccination to prevent reintroduction. No cases under investigation among responding municipalities. Despite stability, several towns have not met Ministry of Health targets, keeping transmission risk. In Santo André, SCR vaccine coverage exceeds targets: 119.43% first dose and 111.56% second for one-year-olds; 2025–2026 doses total 202,999. In Diadema, under-one-year coverage is 87.75% first dose and 86.32% second. Rio Grande da Serra reports 100% first-dose coverage for 12–15 months, but 72.5% second dose (22 children incomplete). Mauá reports about 64% vaccination among its population, higher uptake among youths aged 11–29. Strategies include campaigns, active case finding, school- and unit-based immunization, and mobile units; Rio Grande da Serra runs the Semana do Dia S (Day S Week) active search. Vaccination is free year-round at Basic Health Units; schedule: first dose at 12 months with MMR, second at 15 months with tetraviral. Measles is highly contagious via respiratory droplets; vaccination remains key to prevent outbreaks.

triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ州で2026年初の麻疹症例が確認され、ABC地域で予防接種強化が実施されている。症例数は1例のみで国際的拡大リスクは現時点で低いが、複数の自治体でワクチン接種率が目標未達であり、伝播リスクが残存。続報による症例数増加や感染源の特定を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 麻疹は空気感染する高感染性疾患であり、ワクチン未接種集団では急速に拡大する可能性がある。サンパウロ州は人口密集地域であり、複数自治体（Diadema 87.75%、Rio Grande da Serra 72.5%二回目、Mauá 64%）で接種率が保健省目標未達。現時点では単発症例だが、感染源（輸入例か国内伝播か）、接触者追跡結果、追加症例の有無について続報が必要。ブラジルは2016年に麻疹排除認定を受けたが、近年輸入例からの再導入事例があり、地域のワクチン接種率が重要な監視指標となる。

article.articleHeadline: Wie können wir Menschen mit einem Fledermaus-Coronavirus infizieren? Wissenschaftler stellten diese Frage lange vor COVID
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How can we infect humans with a bat coronavirus? Scientists asked this question long before COVID.
article.articleSummary: New NIH documents reveal that, years before SARS-CoV-2 emerged, a loose network of US-funded researchers proposed modifying bat coronavirus spike proteins to test binding to human receptors and altering cleavage sites—molecular switches that help viruses enter cells. The DEFUSE initiative, backed by EcoHealth Alliance and partners including UNC virologist Ralph Baric and Wuhan Institute of Virology's Zhengli Shi, sketched spike swaps and cleavage-site insertions in bat coronaviruses, but was never funded. Critics say the DEFUSE proposal resembled a blueprint for SARS-CoV-2; defenders note the project did not proceed. Internal NIH reviews flagged potential hazards as early as 2016, while other pre-2019 projects circulated similar concepts. SAGO/WHO urged caution, arguing that SARS-CoV-2 did not necessarily arise from DEFUSE. The documents show an interconnected US-funded research ecosystem exploring how bat coronaviruses could gain human transmissibility, long before COVID-19.

triage.triage_reason: 過去の研究提案に関する文書公開の報道であり、現在進行中の感染症アウトブレイクではない。COVID-19パンデミックの起源に関する歴史的考察であり、新たな公衆衛生上の脅威を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は2019年以前のNIH文書とDEFUSE提案に関する歴史的な情報開示であり、現在の感染症イベントではない。COVID-19の起源論争に関連する内容だが、新たなアウトブレイクや公衆衛生リスクを報告するものではないため、EBSシグナルとしての要件を満たさない。

article.articleHeadline: Bahaya Campak, Jangan asal Sentuh Anak saat Lebaran
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Danger of Measles: Don't Touch Children Carelessly During Eid al-Fitr.
article.articleSummary: As of 12 March 2026, measles and “super flu” outbreaks are rising in several regions, prompting pediatrician Leonirma Tengguna to warn against physical interactions during Eid al-Fitr. Children have developing immune systems, making them more susceptible to pathogens transmitted through touch, kissing, or feeding. The doctor urges asking parents for permission before touching or feeding a child, especially with foods that could trigger allergies or health issues. Emphasize hand hygiene with soap or sanitizer and consider masking for those feeling unwell to keep gatherings safe. She notes that affection can be shown without physical contact and that giving THR (holiday money) may suffice as a sign of care. The advisory emphasizes preventing measles and influenza spread by reinforcing PHBS (Healthy Living Behaviors), given transmission risk when contact occurs without cleanliness across current regional outbreaks.

triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで麻疹と「スーパーインフルエンザ」の同時流行が複数地域で発生しており、小児科医が祝祭期間中の接触を控えるよう警告。異常性と国際的拡大リスクの観点から、IHR基準2項目該当。
triage.notes: 麻疹とインフルエンザの同時流行が複数地域で発生。「スーパーインフルエンザ」という表現は異常性を示唆。イスラム教の祝祭レバラン（断食明け大祭）期間中の人的交流増加により感染拡大リスクが高い。小児科医が公的に警告を発している点で重症度と公衆衛生への影響が懸念される。インドネシアは人口約2.7億人の大国で国際的な人の移動も多く、周辺国への拡大リスクあり。具体的な患者数・死亡数は不明だが、医療専門家による公式警告がメディアで報道されている状況から、フルRRAによる詳細評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: WHO mobilises global stockpile to support Việt Nam's botulinum poisoning response
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-03-12, three Vietnamese patients in Đà Nẵng City are in critical condition with suspected botulinum poisoning. The World Health Organization delivered five vials of botulinum antitoxin to Đà Nẵng to support treatment. WHO activated emergency mechanisms across its Việt Nam country office, the regional office, and headquarters to locate antitoxin from the global stockpile in Geneva and arrange rapid transport to Vietnam. Authorities coordinated with the Ministry of Health, local health authorities, airport partners, and logistics providers to ensure fast, safe delivery. Botulinum antitoxin is a scarce drug that halts toxin effects and can significantly improve recovery when administered promptly. WHO expressed concern for the patients and praised medical teams providing round-the-clock intensive care. The operation highlights partnerships and readiness to respond to health emergencies; KDCA was thanked for ongoing cooperation in the Western Pacific region, supporting Việt Nam's health security.

triage.triage_reason: 重症ボツリヌス中毒の集団発生でWHOが緊急対応を実施。国際的な医薬品在庫動員と複数国間調整が必要となる異常事態であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: WHO本部・地域事務所・国事務所の三層で緊急メカニズムを発動し、ジュネーブの世界備蓄からボツリヌス抗毒素を緊急輸送。ベトナム保健省、地方保健当局、空港、物流事業者との多機関連携が必要となった稀少医薬品を要する重症例。集団発生の原因（食品汚染等）は記事では不明だが、3名が重篤という点で公衆衛生上の重大懸念あり。KDCA（韓国疾病管理庁）との西太平洋地域での協力体制も言及されており、地域的な健康安全保障の文脈でも重要。

article.articleHeadline: Terpopuler: Jejak hidup dan warisan dokter Jack, kasus campak, hingga jadwal buka puasa di NTB
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Most Popular: The life story and legacy of Dr. Jack, a measles case, and the iftar schedule in NTB.
article.articleSummary: Dompu District, Nusa Tenggara Barat (NTB), Indonesia, recorded 216 suspected measles cases across eight subdistricts in 2026, with officials stating the rise is higher than in previous years but not yet an outbreak (KLB). The health department links the increase to persistently low childhood immunization coverage, undermining herd protection and enabling transmission. Authorities urge that immunization not be delayed, stressing the importance of routine vaccination to prevent further spread. The report portrays measles as an ongoing threat in NTB amid immunization gaps and calls for strengthened surveillance and timely vaccination campaigns to avert an actual outbreak. No laboratory-confirmed outbreak status is reported for Dompu as of 2026, with data referring to suspected cases.

triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（公衆衛生への影響深刻、国際拡大リスク、異常事象）かつWPROスクリーニング基準4項目該当。麻疹216疑い例は前年比で顕著増加、ワクチン接種率低下による集団免疫崩壊が背景にあり、国際的に懸念される予防可能疾患の再興事例としてフルRRA対象と判定。
triage.notes: Dompu地区における麻疹216疑い例（8地区）は前年比顕著増加。当局はKLB（outbreak）未宣言だが、小児定期接種率の持続的低下により集団免疫が機能せず伝播継続と評価。麻疹は感染力極めて高く（R0=12-18）、ワクチン接種率<95%で流行リスク急上昇。インドネシアは麻疹排除目標国であり、本事例は予防可能疾患の再興として国際的関心対象。実験室確定例数・年齢分布・ワクチン接種歴・合併症詳細は不明のためWATCH要素もあるが、疫学的文脈（接種率低下+感染拡大）から即座のRRA着手が妥当。WHO WPROへの通知義務該当性検討要。

article.articleHeadline: Edison Parra propõe medidas de prevenção contra a Mpox em São Caetano - Diário do Grande ABC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Edison Parra proposes Mpox prevention measures in São Caetano.
article.articleSummary: Mpox confirmed in 2026 in Santo André and Mauá (Grande ABC, São Paulo) — one case in each city. In São Caetano, councilor Edison Parra (Podemos) proposes municipal Mpox preparedness and prevention measures in light of confirmed countrywide cases. The State Health Secretariat dashboard, updated March 6, shows eight additional suspected cases under investigation in the region; 13 have been ruled out and no deaths reported. Mpox, an Orthopoxvirus formerly called monkeypox, transmits by close contact, bodily fluids, or contaminated objects; symptoms include fever and skin eruptions. Parra calls for a municipal protocol for suspected cases, training for all local health teams to enable early identification, and a public information campaign via local media, official social networks, and other channels. Nationally, Brazil has 88 confirmed Mpox cases in 2026, with 62 in São Paulo state.

triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで2026年に確認された比較的限定的なMpox症例報告。国内88例、州内62例と数は限定的だが、clade情報や重症度、国際的拡大リスクの詳細が不明。地方議員が予防措置を提案している点で地域的関心はあるが、WHOまたはWPRO基準を満たすかは現時点で判断困難。続報による疫学情報の確認が必要。
triage.notes: 2026年の記事だが配信日時が未来日付のため情報の真正性に留意。Mpox clade I/IIの両方がタグ付けされているがcladeの特定情報が本文にない。死亡例なし、入院情報なし、疑い例8例が調査中。地方議員レベルでの予防対策提案があり地域的関心は確認できるが、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念事象（PHEIC）レベルの情報は不足。症例数の推移、clade情報、重症度の詳細情報が得られれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 放假回越南！交換生妹子激戰男友　返台確診梅毒「診間大崩潰」 | ETtoday生活新聞 | ETtoday新聞雲
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Back from vacation in Vietnam! Exchange student girl has hot sex with her boyfriend, returns to Taiwan diagnosed with syphilis, "the exam room in chaos" | ETtoday Life News | ETtoday News Cloud
article.articleSummary: A Vietnamese exchange student in Taiwan was diagnosed with syphilis after returning from Vietnam; she had unremarkable symptoms initially and tested positive about three weeks after reuniting with her partner, prompting treatment and follow-up. Taiwan CDC data show 2025 syphilis cases rose 2% to 9,935 nationwide, with the 15–24 age group gaining 1,892 cases (up 8% from 2024). Other 2025 figures: HIV infections 879 (down 12% from 2024), gonorrhea 6,417 (down 16%), and mpox 521 cumulative since 2023, with seven local cases in 2026 to date. Preventive guidance emphasizes condom use and stable partnerships, and timely post-exposure measures: HIV post-exposure prophylaxis within 72 hours followed by 28 days of therapy; doxycycline post-exposure prophylaxis may reduce syphilis risk, though these do not replace safe sex and routine screening. The patient is being treated and monitored.

triage.triage_reason: 台湾における梅毒の散発例の報告であり、IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準のいずれにも該当しない。2025年の梅毒症例数は前年比2%増（9,935例）と微増にとどまり、異常な増加や重症化は認められない。既知の性感染症の通常の疫学動向の範囲内である。
triage.notes: 個別症例報道であり、公衆衛生上の重大なシグナルではない。台湾CDCの2025年データでは梅毒2%増、HIV 12%減、淋病16%減と、性感染症全体としては改善傾向。15-24歳の梅毒が8%増加しているが、予防啓発の範囲内で対応可能。mpoxは2023年以降累計521例、2026年は7例と限定的。通常のサーベイランス情報として扱うべき事例。

locations.name: Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka

article.articleHeadline: 屈公病境外移入創六年新高　醫：防蚊措施是關鍵 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Imported chikungunya cases reach a six-year high; doctors say mosquito prevention measures are the key - Minshi News Network
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya virus infections imported into Taiwan surged to a six-year high in 2025 with 39 laboratory-confirmed cases, all imported from abroad—primarily Indonesia, the Philippines, Guangdong Province (China), and Sri Lanka. In early 2026, two more imported cases were reported; no local community transmission to date. The disease, spread by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus, presents after a 2–12 day incubation with fever, severe arthralgia (hands, wrists, knees, ankles), myalgia, headache, nausea, and rash in about half of patients. There is no specific antiviral treatment; care is supportive. Older adults, pregnant women, and individuals with chronic diseases may experience more severe or prolonged joint pain. Prevention focuses on mosquito avoidance and environmental control. Travelers should monitor health for 14 days after return and follow the 4 Ds—drain standing water, discard containers, clean, and scrub potential breeding sites—to reduce transmission risk.

triage.triage_reason: 輸入症例の増加傾向は認められるものの、地域内伝播はなく、既知の流行地域からの輸入例。情報が限定的なため経過観察が適切。続報で地域内感染や重症化の動向を注視すべき。
triage.notes: 台湾における2025年のチクングニア輸入症例39例は過去6年で最高だが、全て既知の流行国（インドネシア、フィリピン、中国広東省、スリランカ）からの輸入例。地域内伝播は報告されておらず、媒介蚊対策が実施されている。高齢者・妊婦・慢性疾患患者での重症化リスクは既知の情報。2026年初頭に2例追加報告されているが、異常な増加パターンや新規の臨床所見は記載なし。現時点では定期的なサーベイランス対象として経過観察が妥当。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H3N2

article.articleHeadline: В России завершилась эпидемия гонконгского гриппа
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Hong Kong flu epidemic has ended in Russia
article.articleSummary: Russia's Hong Kong flu epidemic (Influenza A(H3N2)) has ended, according to the Smorodintsev Research Institute of Influenza. The decline in the share of influenza PCR testing to 3.1% signals the end of the A(H3N2) outbreak in Russia, as stated by Svetlana Vakhruscheva, candidate of medical sciences and director of clinical medicine at the Far Eastern Federal University. In early March 2026, Rospotrebnadzor reported about 678,000 cases of ARVI and influenza nationwide. The article notes that Russians had previously been advised on identifying Hong Kong flu symptoms. It emphasizes ongoing surveillance; no details on deaths or laboratory confirmations beyond the PCR testing rate change are provided.

triage.triage_reason: ロシアにおける香港型インフルエンザ（A(H3N2)）の流行が終息したという情報。季節性インフルエンザの通常の流行パターンであり、異常性・重症度・国際的拡大リスクのいずれも認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザA(H3N2)の流行終息報告。PCR陽性率が3.1%まで低下し、流行が収束したことを示す。約67.8万例のARVI/インフルエンザ症例が報告されたが、これは通常の季節性流行の範囲内。死亡例の記載なし。新規の懸念事項は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chuyển khẩn cấp thuốc giải độc botulinum đến Đà Nẵng cứu 3 bệnh nhân nguy kịch
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO urgently dispatches botulinum antitoxin to Da Nang to save three critically ill patients
article.articleSummary: Botulism toxin exposure suspected in Da Nang, Vietnam, prompting urgent WHO intervention. The World Health Organization dispatched five vials of botulinum antitoxin from its global stock in Geneva to support three patients in critical condition being treated for suspected botulinum poisoning. The rapid deployment followed information from national health authorities, with WHO coordinating across country, regional, and headquarters levels and working closely with the Ministry of Health to ensure safe, swift delivery to Da Nang. The antitoxin, a scarce treatment that halts toxin activity and improves recovery when given early, was transported immediately. WHO emphasized ongoing partnership with Vietnam to strengthen rapid-response capacity, and thanked Korea's KDCA for continued support in regional health emergency response. Suspected botulism remains the provisional diagnosis pending laboratory confirmation.

triage.triage_reason: WHOが緊急介入し、スイスから抗毒素を緊急輸送する事態は異常かつ深刻。3名が重症で、ボツリヌス中毒の疑いがあり、国際的支援が必要な状況。IHR基準3つ、WPRO基準4つに該当。
triage.notes: WHOが世界ストックから緊急輸送、韓国KDCAも支援に関与。ボツリヌス中毒は稀な疾患で、3名が重症という規模は公衆衛生上の懸念。曝露源・感染経路は不明で、実験室確定待ち。食品由来か医原性かの情報なく、追加症例発生の可能性も評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Sebaran Campak Mengkhawatirkan, Dinkes Cimahi Dorong Imunisasi Lengkap Pada Anak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Worrisome Measles Spread, Cimahi Health Office Urges Full Immunization for Children.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases in Indonesia have surged, with the country ranking second globally in measles outbreaks according to the Indonesian Pediatric Society (IDAI). In Cimahi, West Java, 11 children tested positive for measles from January through week 9 of 2026, prompting the local Health Office to boost preventive measures and vaccination efforts. Measles is a highly contagious viral infection, and authorities emphasize vaccination as the most effective defense against transmission and complications, especially in children with underdeveloped immunity. Cimahi’s MR1 (Measles-Rubella) immunization coverage already exceeded the West Java target at 98.5% (target 95%), indicating generally good uptake, but gaps remain where vaccination is incomplete. Cimahi lies in the Bandung Raya area, where high mobility could facilitate spread; authorities urge complete vaccination to safeguard the population.

triage.triage_reason: インドネシアが世界第2位の麻疹流行国となっており、国際的な拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が懸念される。IHR基準3項目該当、WPRO基準4項目該当で、シグナルとして識別すべき事例。
triage.notes: インドネシア小児科学会が世界第2位の麻疹流行国と認定。Cimahi市では2026年1-9週で11例の陽性例を確認。麻疹は高度に感染性が高く、MR1ワクチン接種率98.5%と目標を上回るものの接種の空白地帯が残存。Bandung Raya地域の高い人口移動性により国際的拡大のリスクあり。当局が緊急の予防接種強化を呼びかけている状況から、公衆衛生上の重要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo tem primeiro caso de sarampo em 2026 - O PROGRESSO
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo records its first measles case in 2026 - O PROGRESSO
article.articleSummary: Measles in São Paulo marks first case of 2026. A six-month-old girl, unvaccinated, contracted measles during a January trip to Bolivia; infection confirmed in February by laboratory tests. This represents the first measles case in São Paulo in 2026; in 2025 the state had two imported cases. Public health authorities emphasize vaccination as the best protection. Measles vaccination is part of Brazil's National Immunization Schedule: first dose at 12 months, second at 15 months. Booster doses recommended for ages 5–29 (two doses at least 30 days apart); individuals 30–59 should receive an additional dose. The World Health Organization warned in February about a 32-fold increase in measles transmissions in the Americas during 2024–2025, highlighting cross-border importation risks and the need for high coverage.

triage.triage_reason: 輸入症例による単発例で、現時点では国際拡大や深刻な公衆衛生影響は確認されていないが、WHOが米州地域での麻疹感染32倍増加を警告している背景があり、未接種の脆弱集団への拡大リスクを監視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 2026年サンパウロ州初の麻疹症例。生後6ヶ月の未接種乳児がボリビア渡航中に感染し2月に確認された輸入例。2025年も2例の輸入例があった。WHOが2024-2025年に米州地域で麻疹感染が32倍増加したと警告しており、ワクチン接種率の維持と国境を越えた感染リスクへの注意喚起が重要。単発輸入症例だが、麻疹は感染力が非常に高く（epidemic_prone=Yes）、未接種集団での二次感染リスクがあるため経過観察が必要。現時点では国内伝播や重症例の報告はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Urgent warning as contagious virus spreads in Australia's biggest city
article.articleSummary: Measles is spreading in Sydney, NSW, after a newborn contracted the disease on a December flight from Bali. Taylen Mather developed high fever (39–40°C), a full-body rash, and red eyes; his vaccinating parents and sibling remained well. NSW Health reports 60 measles cases in NSW from 1 Jan 2025 to 7 Mar 2026, with 26 this year. On 12 Mar 2026, two new Sydney cases were confirmed: one locally acquired, the other with no known contact, indicating community transmission. Measles is highly contagious and spreads by droplets. NSW Health lists 60 infectious locations with dates and times; visitors should monitor symptoms for 18 days and seek care if signs appear. Immunisation is free for children 12–18 months and for those born after 1965 who have not completed two doses.

triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）かつWPROスクリーニング基準4項目該当。バリ島からの航空機内感染による国際伝播と、シドニーでの市中感染確認により、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が明確。
triage.notes: NSW州で2025年1月〜2026年3月に60例の麻疹症例が報告され、2026年だけで26例。バリ島からの国際フライトで新生児が機内感染し、シドニーで接触歴不明の市中感染例も確認。60か所の感染性のある場所がリスト化され、18日間の症状監視が必要。麻疹は極めて感染力が強く、飛沫感染するため国際的な拡大リスクが高い。NSW Healthが積極的なサーベイランスと公衆啓発を実施中。

article.articleHeadline: Chuvas e terrenos sujos favorecem infestação de caramujos | Diario de Cuiabá
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rain and dirty grounds promote snail infestation
article.articleSummary: Rainy weather in Cuiabá, Brazil, promotes the invasive African snail (Achatina fulica). The Municipal Health Secretariat warns that, although overall disease transmission risk is low, these snails can host parasites causing eosinophilic meningitis (Angiostrongylus cantonensis) and abdominal angiostrongyliasis (Angiostrongylus costaricensis). Transmission occurs mainly by ingesting snail mucus on inadequately washed vegetables or by handling the snail without protection. Do not touch or eat the mollusk. Snails multiply in moist conditions; eggs can remain dormant up to six months, explaining sudden post-rain emergence. Salt on soil is not recommended. Control measures: manually collect snails with disposable gloves or bags, preferably morning or evening; place in a sealed container with water and salt (5 tablespoons per liter) for about 3 hours, then crack shells before disposal. For produce, wash with running water and soak 15–30 minutes in a chlorine solution (1 tablespoon per liter), then rinse. Maintain clean yards and report sightings to Sorp.

triage.triage_reason: 既知の環境性寄生虫疾患（広東住血線虫症）に関する公衆衛生啓発記事。雨季に伴う予測可能な外来種カタツムリの増加に対する定型的な注意喚起であり、異常な流行や国際的拡大のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: クイアバ市保健局による定型的な季節性予防啓発。疾患伝播リスク自体は低いと明示されており、具体的な症例報告もなし。外来種アフリカマイマイ（Achatina fulica）の雨季後の増加は予測可能な環境現象であり、住民への手洗い・野菜洗浄等の標準的な衛生指導が中心。緊急性・異常性なし。

article.articleHeadline: Lâm Đồng giám sát người tiếp xúc gần sau ca bệnh viêm màng não mô cầu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lam Dong Province monitors close contacts after a case of meningococcal meningitis.
article.articleSummary: Lam Dong Province monitors close contacts after a meningococcal meningitis case. A 14-year-old student from Dong Da hamlet, Nam Ban Commune, Lâm Hà District tested positive for Neisseria meningitidis group B by CSF PCR, presenting with fever and headache, followed by meningitis-like symptoms. He was treated at Lam Dong Obstetrics and Pediatrics Hospital with cefotaxime and amikacin, then transferred to Children’s Hospital 2 in HCMC. The patient is now stable, afebrile, with waning rash and normal appetite. In the community, 69 close contacts were identified; 14 took prophylaxis. At Lam Dong Obstetrics and Pediatrics Hospital, 16 healthcare workers received ciprofloxacin 500 mg prophylaxis. Authorities urge enhanced surveillance, infection control, and rapid isolation of suspected cases; watch for sudden fever, headache, vomiting, neck stiffness, and rash. The patient studied at Phung Hung Secondary-High School, District 12, HCMC, and had returned home for Tet before illness.

triage.triage_reason: 髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎の散発例1件であり、接触者追跡・予防投与が実施されている。現時点では集団発生や国際拡大のエビデンスはないが、患者が学校に通学しており複数地域を移動していたため、続報による感染拡大の有無を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 患者は14歳学生で、ホーチミン市の学校に通学後、テト休暇で帰省してラムドン省で発症。髄液PCRで髄膜炎菌B群陽性確認。接触者69名特定、14名に予防投与実施、医療従事者16名にもシプロフロキサシン予防投与済み。患者は現在安定・解熱。散発例として適切に管理されているが、髄膜炎菌は流行性があり（epidemic_prone: Yes）、学校環境での二次感染リスクを考慮し経過観察が妥当。Classical Swine Fever（豚熱）も疾患名に含まれているが記事本文では言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Campak di Jawa Barat Melonjak, Warga Diminta Waspada Penularan Saat Mudik Lebaran 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles cases in West Java surge, residents urged to be vigilant about transmission during Lebaran 2026 homecoming.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases surge in West Java ahead of Lebaran 2026 homecoming. West Java Health Office data show 2025 measles cases reached 1,785, up from 271 the prior year. By February 2026, 252 cases had been recorded. Measles is a highly contagious respiratory illness caused by the measles virus (rubeola), spreading via coughing or sneezing, direct contact, or contaminated surfaces, with one case potentially infecting 12–18 people. Authorities warn that the Eid al-Fitr mudik (homecoming) period increases transmission risk due to high mobility and gatherings. Prevention emphasizes completing measles immunization up to the second dose before Eid, especially for children aged 9–59 months. West Java is conducting Catch-Up Campaigns (CUC) for 9–59-month-olds and urges vaccination at health facilities, along with promoting hygiene to curb spread.

triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・予想外の急増・国際的拡大リスク）。2025年は前年比6.6倍の1,785例、2026年2月時点で252例と急増継続中。高い感染力（1例→12-18例）と大規模人口移動（レバラン帰省）により国際的拡大リスクあり。
triage.notes: 2025年の麻疹症例数1,785例は前年271例から558%増加。麻疹の基本再生産数（R0=12-18）は非常に高く、2026年レバラン（イスラム最大の祝祭）における大規模人口移動により東南アジア地域への国際的拡大リスクが高い。西ジャワ州は9-59ヶ月児対象のCatch-Up Campaignを実施中だが、2026年2月時点で既に252例発生しており対策の効果は不明。風疹との混合流行の可能性も示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: 新疆昌吉市多举措防控校园春季传染病 护航学生健康成长
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Xinjiang's Changji City Implements Multiple Measures to Prevent and Control Spring Infectious Diseases on Campus, Safeguarding Students' Healthy Growth.
article.articleSummary: Spring is peak season for infectious diseases; Changji City, Xinjiang, implemented campus-focused measures to protect students. On March 11, 2026, Changji CDC staff visited Changji City Third Primary School to explain influenza, infectious diarrhea, varicella, and hand, foot and mouth disease—transmission, main symptoms, and home- and school-based prevention. Students learned cough etiquette, ventilation, regular exercise, and adequate sleep. A health deputy-principal mechanism was expanded: community health centers appoint professionals to serve as health deputies for primary and secondary schools and kindergartens to conduct disease prevention, student health monitoring, and health education. The Second Kindergarten reported training teachers and using school broadcasts to disseminate prevention knowledge; rapid response in case of illness. Authorities also highlighted vaccination as a preventive measure, promoting influenza, varicella, and HFMD vaccines. As of now, campuses have enhanced morning/midday checks and environmental disinfection to safeguard children’s health.

triage.triage_reason: 通常の季節性感染症対策活動の報道であり、異常事態や重症例の発生を示唆する情報はない。予防教育・ワクチン接種推進等の定期的な公衆衛生活動の範囲内。
triage.notes: 春季に学校で一般的な感染症（インフルエンザ、水痘、手足口病等）に対する予防啓発活動の報道。新規アウトブレイクや異常な感染拡大ではなく、定期的な公衆衛生キャンペーンと判断。症例数・重症度・死亡例等の具体的疫学データの記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: DDC warns influenza still spreading: 137,276 cases, 8 deaths recorded so far this year
article.articleSummary: Influenza remains widespread in Thailand in early 2026. From January 1 to March 9, Thailand recorded 137,276 influenza cases and 8 deaths, an illness rate of 211.48 per 100,000. Hospitalisations total 15,041 (10.96%). Provinces with the highest illness rates were Phayao, Lampang, Phitsanulok, Chiang Mai, and Ubon Ratchathani. Most deaths occurred among people aged 60 and above with underlying conditions such as kidney disease, immunodeficiency, or cancer; most decedents did not have a history of influenza vaccination. Surveillance shows seasonal patterns, with cases typically rising early in the year and peaking mid-year. In 2025 Thailand reported 1,194,342 cases and 129 deaths; 2026 could be higher than last year, especially around mid-year. Public health guidance emphasizes vigilance and vaccination.

triage.triage_reason: タイにおける季節性インフルエンザの流行報告。死亡者数は限定的だが症例数が多く、昨年を上回る可能性が示唆されている。現時点では通常の季節性パターンの範囲内だが、中盤のピーク時期に向けた継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの通常パターンに沿った流行。入院率10.96%、致死率0.006%は季節性インフルエンザとして標準的。死亡者の多くは60歳以上で基礎疾患あり、ワクチン未接種。2025年比で症例増加傾向にあるため、年央のピーク時期における動向監視が推奨される。新規ウイルス株や異常な重症化パターンの報告はなし。

article.articleHeadline: 日本麻疹疫情持續　醫提醒出遊先補強保護力 | 生活 | 中央社 CNA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles outbreak in Japan continues; doctor reminds travelers to bolster immunity before traveling | Lifestyle | CNA
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in Japan continues at seven-year high, with Tokyo and Osaka bearing the largest case counts and additional cases in Chiba, Niigata, Saitama, and Tochigi. International context shows a persistent global measles spread, with Asia including Malaysia, Vietnam, Singapore, Japan, Indonesia, India, Mongolia, and Kazakhstan reporting cases since last year. In Taiwan, 4 measles cases have been recorded by March 4, 2026: 2 domestically acquired and 2 imported, from Vietnam and Malaysia. Measles is highly contagious; early symptoms mimic a cold—fever, cough, runny nose, red eyes—followed by a rash several days later. The article emphasizes immunization gaps: Taiwan has had universal infant vaccination since 1978, so those born after 1981 may lack lasting protection, and travelers to endemic regions should consider boosters. Advice extends to workers with frequent foreign contact and infants under 1 year; consult travel clinics to evaluate vaccination needs.

triage.triage_reason: 日本国内で麻疹が7年ぶりの高水準で継続的に発生し、複数都道府県に拡大。アジア地域でも広域流行が継続しており、国際的拡大リスクと渡航制限の可能性がある。IHR基準3つ該当、WPRO基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: 日本で麻疹が7年ぶりの高水準（東京・大阪が最多、千葉・新潟・埼玉・栃木でも発生）。アジア広域（マレーシア、ベトナム、シンガポール、インドネシア、インド、モンゴール、カザフスタン）で昨年来継続。台湾でも2026年3月4日時点で4例（国内感染2例、輸入例2例：ベトナム・マレーシア由来）。麻疹は極めて感染力が強く、免疫ギャップ人口（1981年以降出生者）への感染拡大懸念あり。渡航者・医療従事者への追加接種勧奨が報道されており、公衆衛生上の関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: DKI adakan imunisasi kejar penyakit campak pada Maret ini
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DKI Jakarta to conduct catch-up measles immunization this March.
article.articleSummary: Measles catch-up immunization campaign (IKS) in March 2026 targets children aged 9-59 months in Jakarta, Indonesia (DKI Jakarta) to boost Measles-Rubella vaccination (MR1), addressing ongoing transmission after 2025, when suspected cases reached 6,930 with 1,514 confirmed. Early 2026 suspected cases total 1,236, higher than 2024. Suspected cases are spread across Jakarta, highest in West Jakarta (398), Central Jakarta (276), and South Jakarta (226); North 179, East 155, Kepulauan Seribu 2. Most suspected cases occur among 1-4 years and under 1 year, many not fully immunized. In 2025, MR1 and MR2 coverage exceeded targets: 143,374 (100.6%) and 144,842 (100.5%). Back-to-School Immunization Month (BIAS) for 1st-grade SD reached 89.6%. Vaccination services at health facilities and puskesmas will vaccinate healthy or mildly symptomatic children, with aims to curb spread before Ramadan and Idul Fitri.

triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の継続的な伝播と高い症例数（2025年疑い例6,930件、確定1,514件）が確認されており、2026年初頭も1,236件と2024年を上回る。IHR基準では公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常性が認められ、WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性の観点から懸念がある。首都ジャカルタでの大規模追加予防接種キャンペーン実施は政府の高い関心を示しており、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 2025年から継続する麻疹伝播で、首都ジャカルタ全域に拡大（西ジャカルタ398件が最多）。主な感染層は1-4歳と1歳未満で多くが未接種・不完全接種。MR1・MR2接種率は目標超過（100%超）も、BIAS（小学1年生対象）は89.6%に留まる。ラマダン・イードルフィトル前の感染拡大抑制を目的とした緊急キャンペーン実施は、状況の深刻さを反映。風疹も疾患リストに含まれているが本文では言及なし。国際的拡大リスクは記事から不明だが、首都での持続的伝播は周辺国への波及懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: Vụ ngộ độc botulinum vì ăn cá ủ chua: Các bệnh nhi được truyền thuốc giải độc
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Case of botulism from eating fermented fish: The pediatric patients were given botulinum antitoxin.
article.articleSummary: Three children from the same family in Phước Năng, Phước Sơn, Quảng Nam, developed botulinum toxin poisoning after eating fermented fish on March 7. By March 7–8, they exhibited abdominal pain, vomiting and fatigue; the most severe patient, H.N.T (15), developed coma, respiratory distress, dilated pupils and required intubation and mechanical ventilation, with plasmapheresis discussed after consult with Ho Chi Minh City's Cho Rẫy Hospital. A cluster of suspected botulism cases was reported by a regional hospital in Quảng Nam on March 9. Two of the children were in intensive care at Da Nang's Obstetrics and Pediatrics Hospital as of March 12. After urgent delivery facilitated by WHO, botulinum antitoxin was administered at 20:45 on March 11. By March 12, all three had received antidotes and showed improving consciousness and muscle strength, though continued monitoring and rehabilitation were needed. Botulism antidote is expensive (~$8,000 per vial) and not routinely stocked.

triage.triage_reason: ボツリヌス中毒の家族内集団発生で重症例あり。小児3名が発酵魚摂取後に発症し、1名は昏睡・呼吸不全で人工呼吸管理を要する重篤な状態。WHOを通じた抗毒素緊急輸送が必要となった点から国際的支援が実施されており、IHR基準2つ（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際支援の必要性）とWPROスクリーニング基準複数（重症度、管理可能性）に該当。フルRRAによる詳細評価が必要。
triage.notes: WHOを通じた抗毒素の緊急輸送が実施されており、国際支援が既に発動している点が重要。食品媒介性ボツリヌス中毒は散発的だが、同一食品による家族内集団発生であり、地域の伝統的食品（発酵魚）に関連する公衆衛生上の課題。抗毒素の高コスト（約8,000ドル/バイアル）と備蓄不足が管理上の課題として明示されている。続報で感染源食品の流通範囲や他の曝露者の有無を確認する必要あり。
